claims.statement: The chupacabra (chupacabras), literally 'goat-sucker', from Spanish chupa 'sucks' and cabras 'goats', is a legendary creature or cryptid in the folklore of parts of the Americas.
claims.statement_id: Chupacabra (chupacabras), secara harfiah 'penghisap kambing', dari kata Spanyol chupa 'menghisap' dan cabras 'kambing', adalah makhluk legendaris atau kriptid dalam cerita rakyat sebagian wilayah Amerika.
claims.quote: literally meaning 'goat-sucker', from Spanish: chupa , 'sucks', and cabras , 'goats') is a legendary creature, or cryptid, in the folklore of parts of the Americas.

claims.statement: It is said to prey on livestock, particularly goats, although reports also attribute attacks to sheep, chickens and other domesticated animals.
claims.statement_id: Konon ia memangsa ternak, terutama kambing, meski laporan juga menyebut serangan terhadap domba, ayam, dan hewan piaraan lain.
claims.quote: It is said to prey on livestock, particularly goats, although reports also attribute attacks to sheep, chickens and other domesticated animals.

claims.statement: According to accounts, the chupacabra kills its victims by puncturing the neck and consuming their blood, a trait that gave rise to its enduring association with vampirism.
claims.statement_id: Menurut laporan, chupacabra membunuh korbannya dengan melubangi leher dan menghisap darahnya, ciri yang melahirkan kaitannya yang bertahan lama dengan vampirisme.
claims.quote: According to accounts, the chupacabra kills its victims by puncturing the neck and consuming their blood, a characteristic that gave rise to its enduring association with vampirism.

claims.statement: Descriptions of the creature vary considerably by region.
claims.statement_id: Penggambaran makhluk ini sangat beragam menurut daerah.
claims.quote: Descriptions of the creature vary considerably by region.

claims.statement: In Puerto Rico and much of Hispanic America it is commonly portrayed as reptilian or extraterrestrial-looking, about the size of a small bear, with a row of spines from the neck to the base of the tail.
claims.statement_id: Di Puerto Riko dan sebagian besar Amerika Hispanik, ia umumnya digambarkan mirip reptil atau makhluk asing, seukuran beruang kecil, dengan deretan duri dari leher hingga pangkal ekor.
claims.quote: In Puerto Rico and much of Hispanic America, it is commonly portrayed as reptilian or extraterrestrial-looking, about the size of a small bear, and with a distinctive row of spines extending from the neck to the base of the tail.

claims.statement: In contrast, reports from the Southwestern United States typically describe it as a hairless, canine animal with pronounced fangs.
claims.statement_id: Sebaliknya, laporan dari Amerika Serikat bagian barat daya umumnya menggambarkannya sebagai hewan mirip anjing tanpa bulu dengan taring menonjol.
claims.quote: In contrast, reports from the Southwestern United States typically describe the creature as a hairless, canine animal with pronounced fangs.

claims.statement: The first widely publicized sightings and descriptions of the chupacabra emerged in Puerto Rico in 1995.
claims.statement_id: Penampakan dan penggambaran pertama yang tersiar luas muncul di Puerto Riko pada 1995.
claims.quote: The first widely publicized sightings and descriptions of the chupacabra emerged in Puerto Rico in 1995.

claims.statement: Since then, alleged encounters have been reported throughout the Americas, from Maine to Chile, and also outside the region, in places such as Russia and the Philippines.
claims.statement_id: Sejak itu, perjumpaan yang diklaim dilaporkan di seluruh benua Amerika, dari Maine hingga Chile, juga di luar kawasan itu seperti Rusia dan Filipina.
claims.quote: Since then, alleged encounters have been reported throughout the Americas, ranging from Maine to Chile, as well as in countries outside the region, including Russia and the Philippines.

claims.statement: The name Chupacabras literally translates to 'goat-sucker', from the Spanish words chupar ('to suck') and cabras ('goats').
claims.statement_id: Nama Chupacabras secara harfiah berarti 'penghisap kambing', dari kata Spanyol chupar ('menghisap') dan cabras ('kambing').
claims.quote: The name Chupacabras literally translates to 'goat-sucker', deriving from the Spanish words chupar ('to suck') and cabras ('goats').

claims.statement: In 1975, a series of unexplained livestock deaths in Moca, Puerto Rico, came to be attributed to a mysterious entity dubbed el vampiro de Moca ("the vampire of Moca").
claims.statement_id: Pada 1975, serangkaian kematian ternak tak terjelaskan di Moca, Puerto Riko, dikaitkan dengan sosok misterius yang dijuluki el vampiro de Moca ("vampir dari Moca").
claims.quote: In 1975, a series of unexplained livestock deaths in the municipality of Moca, Puerto Rico, came to be attributed to a mysterious entity dubbed el vampiro de Moca ('the vampire of Moca').

claims.statement: The name is generally attributed to Puerto Rican comedian Silverio Pérez, who coined the term in 1995 while discussing the reported livestock attacks on his radio program in San Juan.
claims.statement_id: Nama itu umumnya dikaitkan dengan komedian Puerto Riko Silverio Pérez, yang mencetuskan istilah itu pada 1995 saat membahas serangan ternak dalam programa radionya di San Juan.
claims.quote: The name is generally attributed to Puerto Rican comedian Silverio Pérez, who coined the term in 1995 while discussing the reported livestock attacks during his radio program in San Juan.

claims.statement: Reports of alleged sightings of the creature proliferated in the mid-1990s in various locations.
claims.statement_id: Laporan penampakan makhluk ini merebak pada pertengahan 1990-an di berbagai lokasi.
claims.quote: Reports of alleged sightings of the creature proliferated in the mid-1990s in various locations.

claims.statement: In April 2000, in the mining city of Calama in northern Chile, approximately one hundred farm animals were reportedly found drained of blood or mutilated under unusual circumstances.
claims.statement_id: Pada April 2000, di kota tambang Calama di Chile utara, sekitar seratus hewan ternak dilaporkan ditemukan kehabisan darah atau termutilasi dalam keadaan tak lazim.
claims.quote: In April 2000, in the mining city of Calama in northern Chile, approximately one hundred farm animals were reportedly found drained of blood or mutilated under unusual circumstances.

claims.statement: During the first half of 2002, reports of mutilated cattle emerged from several areas of Argentina.
claims.statement_id: Pada paruh pertama 2002, laporan ternak termutilasi muncul dari beberapa wilayah di Argentina.
claims.quote: During the first half of 2002, reports of mutilated cattle emerged from several areas of Argentina

claims.statement: In July 2004, a rancher killed a creature resembling a hairless dog that he found attacking his livestock near San Antonio, Texas.
claims.statement_id: Pada Juli 2004, seorang peternak membunuh makhluk mirip anjing tanpa bulu yang ia temukan menyerang ternaknya di dekat San Antonio, Texas.
claims.quote: In July 2004, a rancher killed a creature resembling a hairless dog, which he discovered attacking his livestock near San Antonio, Texas.

claims.statement: These reports remain anecdotal and unsupported by verifiable evidence; investigations of purported sightings in northern Mexico and the Southern United States instead identified the animals as canids afflicted by severe mange.
claims.statement_id: Laporan-laporan itu tetap berupa cerita dan tidak didukung bukti yang dapat diverifikasi; penyelidikan atas penampakan di Meksiko utara dan Amerika Serikat bagian selatan justru mengidentifikasi hewannya sebagai canid yang menderita kudis parah.
claims.quote: However, these reports remain anecdotal and have not been supported by verifiable evidence. Investigations of purported sightings in northern Mexico and the Southern United States have instead identified the animals involved as canids afflicted by severe mange.

claims.statement: Both chupacabras and chupacabra are used throughout the Americas; the former is the original Spanish term, while the latter emerged later as a regularized singular form.
claims.statement_id: Chupacabras dan chupacabra sama-sama dipakai di seluruh Amerika; yang pertama adalah istilah Spanyol asli, sedangkan yang kedua muncul belakangan sebagai bentuk tunggal yang diregulerkan.
claims.quote: Both chupacabras and chupacabra are used throughout the Americas; the former is the original Spanish term, while the latter emerged later as a regularized singular form.

claims.statement: The first reported attack later associated with the chupacabras phenomenon occurred in Puerto Rico in March 1995: eight sheep were found dead, each reportedly with three puncture wounds to the chest and alleged to have been completely drained of blood.
claims.statement_id: Serangan pertama yang kemudian dikaitkan dengan fenomena chupacabras terjadi di Puerto Riko pada Maret 1995: delapan domba ditemukan mati, masing-masing konon dengan tiga luka tusuk di dada dan diklaim kehabisan darah sepenuhnya.
claims.quote: The first reported attack later associated with the chupacabras phenomenon occurred in Puerto Rico in March 1995. Eight sheep were found dead, each reportedly bearing three puncture wounds to the chest and alleged to have been completely drained of blood.

claims.statement: In August, a resident named Madelyne Tolentino reported a sighting of the creature in the municipality of Canóvanas.
claims.statement_id: Pada Agustus, seorang warga bernama Madelyne Tolentino melaporkan penampakan makhluk itu di kotapraja Canóvanas.
claims.quote: Several months later, in August, a resident named Madelyne Tolentino reported a sighting of the creature in the municipality of Canóvanas.

claims.statement: A five-year investigation by Benjamin Radford, documented in his 2011 book Tracking the Chupacabra, concluded that the description given by the original Puerto Rican eyewitness, Madelyne Tolentino, was based on the creature Sil in the 1995 science-fiction horror film Species.
claims.statement_id: Penyelidikan lima tahun Benjamin Radford, yang dibukukan dalam Tracking the Chupacabra (2011), menyimpulkan bahwa deskripsi saksi asli di Puerto Riko, Madelyne Tolentino, didasarkan pada makhluk Sil dalam film fiksi ilmiah horor Species (1995).
claims.quote: A five-year investigation by Benjamin Radford, documented in his 2011 book Tracking the Chupacabra, concluded that the description given by the original eyewitness in Puerto Rico, Madelyne Tolentino, was based on the creature Sil in the 1995 science-fiction horror film Species.

claims.statement: Dr. David Morales, a Puerto Rican veterinarian with the Department of Agriculture, analyzed 300 reported victims of the chupacabra and found they had not been bled dry.
claims.statement_id: Dr. David Morales, dokter hewan Puerto Riko di Departemen Pertanian, menganalisis 300 korban yang dilaporkan dan menemukan bahwa mereka tidak kehabisan darah.
claims.quote: Dr. David Morales, a Puerto Rican veterinarian with the Department of Agriculture, analyzed 300 reported victims of the chupacabra and found that they had not been bled dry.

claims.statement: In 2010, University of Michigan biologist Barry O'Connor concluded that all chupacabra reports in the United States were simply coyotes infected with the parasite Sarcoptes scabiei.
claims.statement_id: Pada 2010, biolog Universitas Michigan Barry O'Connor menyimpulkan bahwa semua laporan chupacabra di Amerika Serikat sekadar koyote yang terinfeksi parasit Sarcoptes scabiei.
claims.quote: In 2010, University of Michigan biologist Barry O'Connor concluded that all the chupacabra reports in the United States were simply coyotes infected with the parasite Sarcoptes scabiei

claims.statement: The most common description is a reptile-like creature with leathery or scaly greenish-gray skin and a row of sharp spines or quills along its back, about 3 to 4 feet tall and able to stand and hop like a kangaroo.
claims.statement_id: Deskripsi yang paling umum adalah makhluk mirip reptil berkulit abu-abu kehijauan yang berkulit liat atau bersisik dengan deretan duri atau bulu tajam di punggung, setinggi sekitar 3 hingga 4 kaki, dan mampu berdiri serta melompat seperti kanguru.
claims.quote: The most common description of the chupacabra is that of a reptile-like creature with leathery or scaly greenish-gray skin and a row of sharp spines or quills extending along its back. It is described as approximately 3 to 4 feet (0.9 to 1.2 m) tall and capable of standing and hopping in a manner resembling a kangaroo.

claims.statement: Another common portrayal is of an unusual breed of wild dog, typically described as mostly hairless with a pronounced spinal ridge, prominent eye sockets, fangs and claws.
claims.statement_id: Penggambaran umum lain adalah anjing liar yang tak lazim, umumnya digambarkan hampir tanpa bulu dengan punggung berpunuk, rongga mata menonjol, taring, dan cakar.
claims.quote: Another common portrayal of the chupacabra is as an unusual breed of wild dog. This form is typically described as mostly hairless with a pronounced spinal ridge, prominent eye sockets, fangs, and claws.

claims.statement: Accounts of this dog type began emerging in the early 2000s, initially from areas north of the Yucatán Peninsula and northern Mexico before spreading to the United States, and it subsequently became the predominant depiction.
claims.statement_id: Laporan jenis anjing ini mulai muncul pada awal 2000-an, semula dari kawasan di utara Semenanjung Yucatán dan Meksiko utara sebelum menyebar ke Amerika Serikat, dan kemudian menjadi penggambaran yang dominan.
claims.quote: Accounts of this type began emerging in the early 2000s, initially from areas extending northward from the Yucatán Peninsula and northern Mexico, before spreading into the United States. It subsequently become the predominant depiction of the chupacabra.

claims.statement: Unlike conventional predators, the creature is said to drain blood and sometimes eat the organs of its victims, typically through three puncture wounds in a downward-pointing triangle, although some accounts describe only one or two wounds.
claims.statement_id: Tidak seperti pemangsa biasa, makhluk ini dikatakan menguras darah dan kadang memakan organ korban, biasanya lewat tiga luka tusuk berbentuk segitiga menunjuk ke bawah, walau sebagian laporan hanya menyebut satu atau dua luka.
claims.quote: Unlike conventional predators, the creature is said to drain the blood, and sometimes consume the organs of its victims, typically through three puncture wounds arranged in a downwards-pointing triangle, although some accounts describe only one or two wounds.

claims.statement: After the story gained national attention, experts from Texas State University-San Marcos offered DNA testing, and the analysis identified the creature as a coyote.
claims.statement_id: Setelah kisahnya menarik perhatian nasional, pakar Texas State University-San Marcos menawarkan uji DNA, dan analisis itu mengidentifikasi makhluk tersebut sebagai koyote.
claims.quote: After the story gained national attention, experts from Texas State University-San Marcos offered to conduct DNA testing. The analysis identified the creature as a coyote.

claims.statement: Unsatisfied, Canion contacted experts at the University of California, Davis for a second analysis, which determined that the creature was a hybrid: a cross between a coyote and a Mexican wolf.
claims.statement_id: Karena tidak puas, Canion menghubungi pakar University of California, Davis untuk analisis kedua, yang menetapkan bahwa makhluk itu hibrida koyote dan serigala Meksiko.
claims.quote: Unsatisfied, Canion contacted experts at the University of California, Davis for a second analysis, which determined that the creature was specifically a hybrid: a cross between a coyote and a Mexican wolf.

claims.statement: In the Philippines, another legendary creature called the sigbin shares many of the features in descriptions of the chupacabra.
claims.statement_id: Di Filipina, makhluk legendaris lain bernama sigbin memiliki banyak ciri yang mirip dengan deskripsi chupacabra.
claims.quote: In the Philippines, another legendary creature called the sigbin shares many of the features

claims.statement: The Peuchens of Chile also share similarities in their supposed habits, but instead of being dog-like they are described as winged snakes.
claims.statement_id: Peuchen dari Chile juga memiliki kemiripan dalam kebiasaan yang dikatakan, tetapi digambarkan sebagai ular bersayap, bukan mirip anjing.
claims.quote: The Peuchens of Chile also share similarities in their supposed habits, but instead of being dog-like they are described as winged snakes.

claims.statement: Stories of El Chupacabra first surfaced in March 1995 in Puerto Rico, when dead, blood-drained goats began showing up (El Chupacabra translates to "goat sucker").
claims.statement_id: Kisah El Chupacabra pertama muncul pada Maret 1995 di Puerto Riko, ketika kambing-kambing mati yang kehabisan darah mulai ditemukan (El Chupacabra berarti "penghisap kambing").
claims.quote: Stories of El Chupacabra first surfaced in March 1995 in Puerto Rico, Radford said, when dead, blood-drained goats began showing up (El Chupacabra translates to "goat sucker").

claims.statement: That August a newspaper printed an eyewitness description of a bipedal creature 4 to 5 feet tall with spikes down its back, long thin arms and legs, and an alien-like oblong head with red or black eyes.
claims.statement_id: Pada Agustus itu, sebuah surat kabar memuat deskripsi saksi mata tentang makhluk berkaki dua setinggi 4 sampai 5 kaki dengan duri di punggung, lengan dan kaki panjang kurus, serta kepala lonjong mirip makhluk asing dengan mata merah atau hitam.
claims.quote: That August, a newspaper printed an eyewitness description of a bipedal creature, 4 to 5 feet tall with spikes down its back, long, thin arms and legs, and an alienlike oblong head with red or black eyes.

claims.statement: The Texas carcasses looked nothing like the Puerto Rico original, and DNA tests later revealed that they were actually coyotes with a severe case of mange.
claims.statement_id: Bangkai-bangkai di Texas tidak mirip sosok asli Puerto Riko, dan uji DNA kemudian menunjukkan bahwa mereka sebenarnya koyote yang menderita kudis parah.
claims.quote: The frenzy had died down slightly by 2000, but picked back up in 2004 when something began attacking livestock in Texas. ... They looked nothing like the Puerto Rico original, though, and DNA tests later revealed that they were actually coyotes with a severe case of mange.

claims.statement: Radford said that a necropsy of the chickens and goats that were attacked showed normal blood levels; they were not, in fact, "vampirized".
claims.statement_id: Radford menyatakan bahwa dalam nekropsi ayam dan kambing yang diserang, semuanya memiliki kadar darah normal; mereka tidak benar-benar "divampirisasi".
claims.quote: "When you did a necropsy of the chickens and goats that they attacked, they all had normal blood levels," Radford told Life's Little Mysteries. "They were not, in fact, vampirized."

claims.statement: Radford dug through every El Chupacabra mention and traced the physical description of the monster to a single event in the second week of August 1995, when a sketch from an eyewitness named Madelyne Tolentino ran in a Puerto Rican newspaper.
claims.statement_id: Radford menelusuri setiap sebutan El Chupacabra dan melacak deskripsi fisik monster itu pada satu peristiwa di pekan kedua Agustus 1995, ketika sketsa dari saksi bernama Madelyne Tolentino dimuat di surat kabar Puerto Riko.
claims.quote: Radford dug through every El Chupacabra mention and traced the physical description of the monster to a single event in the second week of August 1995, when a sketch from an eyewitness named Madelyne Tolentino ran in a Puerto Rican newspaper.

claims.statement: According to Radford, El Chupacabra was one of the first mythical beasts discovered in the Internet age, and its image and story spread around the world, especially to Spanish-speaking countries, in a matter of weeks.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Radford, El Chupacabra adalah salah satu makhluk mitos pertama yang ditemukan pada era internet, dan gambaran serta kisahnya menyebar ke seluruh dunia, terutama ke negara berbahasa Spanyol, dalam hitungan pekan.
claims.quote: Radford says it's the result of a perfect storm of urban legend-brewing conditions. El Chupacabra was one of the first mythical beasts discovered in the Internet age, and its image and story spread around the world - and especially to Spanish-speaking countries - in a matter of weeks.

claims.statement: Radford said that by the mid-2000s anything weird was being called El Chupacabra: mangy coyotes, dead raccoons, even a dried fish in New Mexico.
claims.statement_id: Radford mengatakan bahwa pada pertengahan 2000-an apa pun yang aneh disebut El Chupacabra: koyote berkudis, rakun mati, bahkan ikan kering di New Mexico.
claims.quote: "By the mid-2000s, anything weird was being called El Chupacabra," he said. "Mangy coyotes. Dead raccoons. Even a dried fish in New Mexico, which looks nothing like El Chupacabra."

claims.statement: In the summer of 1995 a wave of livestock killings rocked the towns of rural Puerto Rico; the victims were found with wounds at their throats, seemingly empty of blood.
claims.statement_id: Pada musim panas 1995, gelombang pembunuhan ternak mengguncang kota-kota pedesaan Puerto Riko; para korban ditemukan dengan luka di leher dan tampak tanpa darah.
claims.quote: In the summer of 1995, a wave of livestock killings rocked the towns of rural Puerto Rico. The victims were found with wounds at their throats, seemingly empty of blood.

claims.statement: In the 21 years since the first supposed sightings, the creature has been a spine-backed alien, a winged kangaroo or a goblin, a predatory monkey or an unusually ambitious mongoose.
claims.statement_id: Dalam 21 tahun sejak dugaan penampakan pertama, makhluk ini pernah menjadi alien berpunggung duri, kanguru bersayap atau goblin, monyet pemangsa, atau musang yang luar biasa ambisius.
claims.quote: In the 21 years since the first supposed sightings of the creature, it has been a spine-backed alien, a winged kangaroo or a goblin, a predatory monkey or an unusually ambitious mongoose.

claims.statement: The chupacabra did not exist before 1995 and has no folkloric predecessors to fall back on.
claims.statement_id: Chupacabra tidak ada sebelum 1995 dan tidak punya pendahulu dalam cerita rakyat yang dapat dijadikan sandaran.
claims.quote: the chupacabra did not exist prior to 1995; it has no folkloric predecessors to fall back on.

claims.statement: After Tolentino's account, reports of bipedal, spiny and red-eyed creatures proliferated, over 200 in Puerto Rico alone.
claims.statement_id: Setelah laporan Tolentino, laporan makhluk berkaki dua, berduri, dan bermata merah membanjir, lebih dari 200 di Puerto Riko saja.
claims.quote: In the wake of Tolentino's account, aided by a sketch she later produced with local UFO researcher Jorge Martin, reports of bipedal, spiny and red-eyed creatures proliferated - over 200 in Puerto Rico alone.

claims.statement: In 2000, Radford said, a Nicaraguan rancher shot and wounded something attacking his goats; a few days later its carcass was found, a hairless, rangy-looking canid.
claims.statement_id: Pada 2000, kata Radford, seorang peternak Nikaragua menembak dan melukai sesuatu yang menyerang kambingnya; beberapa hari kemudian bangkainya ditemukan: canid kurus tanpa bulu.
claims.quote: In 2000, Radford said, a Nicaraguan rancher shot and wounded something attacking his goats. A few days later a ranch hand found the carcass - a hairless, rangy-looking canid.

claims.statement: In 2004, 2007 and 2009 several chupacabra carcasses turned up in the central part of the state; all were DNA-tested with the same result: mangy, sickly coyotes or dogs.
claims.statement_id: Pada 2004, 2007, dan 2009, beberapa bangkai "chupacabra" muncul di bagian tengah negara bagian itu; semuanya diuji DNA dengan hasil sama: koyote atau anjing yang berkudis dan sakit.
claims.quote: In 2004, 2007 and 2009, several chupacabra carcasses popped up in the central part of the state, many with warty skin and protruding teeth. All of them, including Canion's, have been subjected to DNA testing, and the results have been the same: mangy, sickly coyotes or dogs.

claims.statement: Domestic dogs often kill with a bite to the neck and then leave the carcass; by the time it is found the blood has settled to the bottom, with a rip or puncture at the neck the only sign of attack.
claims.statement_id: Anjing peliharaan sering membunuh dengan gigitan di leher lalu meninggalkan bangkai; saat ditemukan, darahnya sudah mengendap di bagian bawah, dan robekan atau tusukan di leher menjadi satu-satunya tanda serangan.
claims.quote: But domestic dogs often kill with a bite to the neck and then leave the carcass. By the time the kill is found, its blood has settled to the bottom - with a rip or puncture at the neck the only sign of attack.

claims.statement: On July 7, 1995, a month before the Tolentino sighting, the sci-fi thriller Species was released across the United States and Puerto Rico.
claims.statement_id: Pada 7 Juli 1995, sebulan sebelum penampakan Tolentino, film fiksi ilmiah Species dirilis di Amerika Serikat dan Puerto Riko.
claims.quote: On July 7, 1995 - a month before the Tolentino sighting that sent the chupacabra rocketing to stardom - the sci-fi thriller Species was released across the United States and Puerto Rico.

claims.statement: This diagnosis does not satisfy Canion, who said she had done DNA tests at five universities, all coming back identical and matching no animal in the archive.
claims.statement_id: Diagnosis itu tidak memuaskan Canion, yang berkata telah melakukan uji DNA di lima universitas dengan hasil identik dan tidak cocok dengan hewan mana pun dalam arsip.
claims.quote: This diagnosis doesn't satisfy Canion. "I have now done DNA at five different universities. All of them came back identical. They do not match any animal in the archive," she said.

claims.statement: But she is adamant that it is not a normal, mangy coyote.
claims.statement_id: Namun ia berkeras bahwa makhluk itu bukan koyote berkudis yang biasa.
claims.quote: But she's adamant that it isn't a normal, mangy coyote.

claims.statement: Kurma is the second avatar of the Hindu preserver deity, Vishnu.
claims.statement_id: Kurma adalah avatar kedua dari dewa pemelihara Hindu, Wisnu.
claims.quote: is the second avatar of the Hindu preserver deity, Vishnu.

claims.statement: Kurma originates in Vedic texts and is associated with the Samudra Manthana.
claims.statement_id: Kurma berakar dari literatur Weda dan dikaitkan erat dengan legenda Samudra Manthana.
claims.quote: Originating in Vedic literature such as the Yajurveda as being synonymous with the Saptarishi called Kashyapa, Kurma is most commonly associated in post-Vedic literature such as the Puranas. He prominently appears in the legend of the churning of the Ocean of Milk, referred to as the Samudra Manthana.

claims.statement: He prominently appears in the legend of the churning of the Ocean of Milk.
claims.statement_id: Ia tampil menonjol dalam legenda pengadukan lautan susu Samudra Manthana.
claims.quote: He prominently appears in the legend of the churning of the Ocean of Milk, referred to as the Samudra Manthana.

claims.statement: Kurma is synonymous with Akupara, the World-Turtle supporting the Earth.
claims.statement_id: Kurma disinonimkan dengan Akupara, kura-kura penopang bumi, sebagai awatara Wisnu.
claims.quote: Along with being synonymous with Akupara, the World-Turtle supporting the Earth, Kurma is listed as the 2nd avatar in the Dashavatara, which are the ten principal incarnations of Vishnu.

claims.statement: The Sanskrit word Kurma literally means tortoise and turtle.
claims.statement_id: Kata Sanskerta Kurma secara harfiah bermakna kura-kura atau penyu.
claims.quote: The Sanskrit word 'Kurma' (Devanagari: कूर्म) means 'Tortoise' and 'Turtle'.

claims.statement: The tortoise incarnation of Vishnu is also called Kacchapa, Kamaṭha, Akupara and Ambucara-Atmana in post-Vedic literature such as the Bhagavata Purana, all meaning "tortoise" or "form of a tortoise".
claims.statement_id: Inkarnasi kura-kura Wisnu juga disebut Kacchapa, Kamaṭha, Akupara, dan Ambucara-Atmana dalam sastra pasca-Weda seperti Bhagavata Purana; semuanya berarti "kura-kura" atau "wujud kura-kura".
claims.quote: The tortoise incarnation of Vishnu is also referred to in post-Vedic literature such as the Bhagavata Purana as 'Kacchapa' (कच्छप), 'Kamaṭha' (कमठ), 'Akupara' (अकूपार), and 'Ambucara-Atmana' (अम्बुचर-आत्मना), all of which mean 'tortoise' or 'form of a tortoise'.

claims.statement: Kurmasana (Tortoise Posture) is a Yoga posture.
claims.statement_id: Kurmasana adalah postur kura-kura dalam disiplin yoga.
claims.quote: Kurmasana (Tortoise Posture) is a Yoga posture.

claims.statement: In the Dashavataras, Kurma represents the amphibian stage following Matsya.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Dashavataras, Kurma melambangkan tahap evolusi amfibi setelah ikan Matsya.
claims.quote: The Dashavataras are compared to evolution; Kurma - the amphibian - is regarded the next stage after Matysa, the fish.

claims.statement: The Shatapatha Brahmana is the earliest extant text to mention Kurma.
claims.statement_id: Kitab Shatapatha Brahmana adalah teks tertua yang mencatat Kurma sang kura-kura.
claims.quote: The Shatapatha Brahmana is the earliest extant text to mention Kurma, the tortoise.

claims.statement: The Shatapatha Brahmana equates Kurma with the creator deity Prajapati.
claims.statement_id: Kitab Shatapatha Brahmana menyamakan Kurma dengan dewa pencipta Prajapati.
claims.quote: The Shatapatha Brahmana equates the tortoise - Kurma to the creator of all creatures. The god Prajapati assumes the form of Kurma to create all creatures (praja).

claims.statement: The Shatapatha Brahmana also records the origins of Matsya the Fish.
claims.statement_id: Kitab Shatapatha Brahmana juga memuat asal-usul awatara ikan Matsya.
claims.quote: The Shatapatha Brahmana also has the origins of Matsya, the Fish.

claims.statement: Though Kurma is absent in the Rigveda, seer Kashyapa appears in hymns.
claims.statement_id: Meski nama Kurma tidak ada di Rigveda, resi Kashyapa yang disamakan dengan Kurma disebut dalam himne.
claims.quote: Though Kurma is not found in the oldest Hindu scripture Rigveda, the seer Kashyapa (who is equated with Kurma) appears in hymns in the scripture.

claims.statement: In post-Vedic literature, including the Puranas, Kurma is closely tied to the Samudra Manthana legend.
claims.statement_id: Dalam sastra pasca-Weda, termasuk Purana, Kurma terkait erat dengan legenda Samudra Manthana (pengadukan Lautan Susu).
claims.quote: In post-Vedic literature, including the Puranas, Kurma is inextricably linked with the legend of the churning of the Ocean Of Milk, known as the Samudra Manthana.

claims.statement: There are five temples dedicated to this incarnation of Vishnu in India, including Kurmai (Chittoor District, Andhra Pradesh) and Sri Kurmam (Srikakulam District, Andhra Pradesh).
claims.statement_id: Ada lima kuil yang dipersembahkan bagi inkarnasi Wisnu ini di India, termasuk Kurmai (Distrik Chittoor, Andhra Pradesh) dan Sri Kurmam (Distrik Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh).
claims.quote: There are five temples dedicated to this incarnation of Vishnu in India: Kurmai (Chittoor District of Andhra Pradesh) Sri Kurmam (Srikakulam District of Andhra Pradesh)

claims.statement: Other temples for this incarnation include Gavirangapura (Chitradurga District, Karnataka) and Swarupnarayan (Goghat village, Hooghly district, West Bengal).
claims.statement_id: Kuil lain bagi inkarnasi ini mencakup Gavirangapura (Distrik Chitradurga, Karnataka) dan Swarupnarayan (desa Goghat, distrik Hooghly, Benggala Barat).
claims.quote: Gavirangapura (Chitradurga District of Karnataka) Swarupnarayan (Goghat village in Hooghly district of West Bengal).

claims.statement: The god Prajapati assumes the form of Kurma to create all creatures (praja); since he "made" (kar) all, Prajapati's form was called Kurma.
claims.statement_id: Dewa Prajapati mengambil wujud Kurma untuk menciptakan semua makhluk (praja); karena ia "membuat" (kar) segalanya, wujud Prajapati disebut Kurma.
claims.quote: The god Prajapati assumes the form of Kurma to create all creatures (praja). Since he "made" (kar) all, Prajapati's form was called Kurma.

claims.statement: Kurma is equated with Kashyapa (literally "tortoise"), so all creatures are called "children of Kashyapa"; Kurma is also called Surya (the sun).
claims.statement_id: Kurma disamakan dengan Kashyapa (secara harfiah "kura-kura"), sehingga semua makhluk disebut "anak Kashyapa"; Kurma juga disebut Surya (matahari).
claims.quote: Kurma is equated with Kashyapa (literally "tortoise"), thus all creatures are called "children of Kashyapa". Kurma is also called Surya (the sun).

claims.statement: The Taittiriya Samhita suggests a ritual of burying a live tortoise at the base of the sacrificial fire altar; by this act the sacrificer earns the merit of reaching heaven.
claims.statement_id: Taittiriya Samhita menyarankan ritual mengubur kura-kura hidup di dasar altar api kurban; dengan itu pemberi kurban memperoleh pahala mencapai surga.
claims.quote: The Taittiriya Samhita suggests a ritual of burying a live tortoise at the base of the sacrificial fire altar (uttar-vedi). By this act, the sacrificer earns the merit of reaching heaven.

claims.statement: The Vajasaneyi Samhita of the white Yajurveda describes the tortoise as the "lord of the waters".
claims.statement_id: Vajasaneyi Samhita dari Yajurveda putih menggambarkan kura-kura sebagai "penguasa perairan".
claims.quote: the Vajasaneyi Samhita of the white Yajurveda describes the tortoise as the "lord of the waters".

claims.statement: In the Adi Parva book of the Mahabharata, the god Narayana (identified with Vishnu) suggests that the devas and asuras churn the ocean to obtain amrita because both seek immortality; the gods choose Mount Mandara as the churning rod and the serpent Vasuki-Ananta as the rope.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kitab Adi Parva epos Mahabharata, dewa Narayana (diidentifikasi dengan Wisnu) menyarankan para dewa dan asura mengaduk samudra untuk memperoleh amrita karena keduanya mendambakan keabadian; para dewa memilih Gunung Mandara sebagai tongkat pengaduk dan ular Vasuki-Ananta sebagai tali.
claims.quote: In the Adi Parva Book of the epic Mahabharata, the god Narayana (identified with Vishnu) suggests the gods (devas) and the demons (asuras) churn the ocean to obtain amrita (ambrosia) as both of them seek immortality. The gods select Mount Mandara as the churning rod and the serpent Vasuki-Ananta as the rope.

claims.statement: They then approach Kurma-raja, the king of tortoises, to support the mount on its back, and it consents.
claims.statement_id: Mereka lalu mendekati Kurma-raja, raja para kura-kura, agar menopang gunung itu di punggungnya, dan ia menyetujui.
claims.quote: Then they approach Kurma-raja, the king of tortoises to support the mount on its back, which it consented.

claims.statement: In this narrative Kurma is not related to Vishnu; the critical edition of the epic does not call Kurma an avatar of Vishnu, though some later insertions in manuscripts associate Kurma as a pradurbhava (manifestation) of Vishnu.
claims.statement_id: Dalam narasi ini Kurma tidak dikaitkan dengan Wisnu; edisi kritis epos itu tidak menyebut Kurma sebagai avatar Wisnu, meski beberapa sisipan belakangan pada naskah mengaitkannya sebagai pradurbhava (perwujudan) Wisnu.
claims.quote: In this narrative, Kurma is not related with Vishnu. Though the critical edition of the epic does not refer to Kurma as an avatar of Vishnu, some latter insertions in manuscripts of the epic associate Kurma as a pradurbhava (manifestation) of Vishnu.

claims.statement: The Kurma Purana is one of four Puranas that bear the names of Vishnu's avatars.
claims.statement_id: Kurma Purana adalah salah satu dari empat Purana yang memakai nama avatar Wisnu.
claims.quote: The Kurma Purana is one of four Puranas that bear the names of Vishnu's avatars.

claims.statement: Aiyangar surmises that the legend of the Samudra Manthana symbolises churning the mind through meditation to achieve liberation (moksha).
claims.statement_id: Aiyangar menduga legenda Samudra Manthana melambangkan pengadukan pikiran lewat meditasi untuk mencapai pembebasan (moksha).
claims.quote: Meditation / Churning the Mind: Aiyangar also surmises that the legend of the Samudra Manthana symbolises churning the mind through Meditation to achieve liberation (Moksha).

claims.statement: Kashyapa, also meaning 'tortoise', is considered the progenitor of all living beings with his thirteen wives, including vegetation.
claims.statement_id: Kashyapa, yang juga berarti "kura-kura", dianggap leluhur semua makhluk hidup bersama tiga belas istrinya, termasuk tumbuh-tumbuhan.
claims.quote: Kashyapa - also meaning 'Tortoise' - is considered the Progenitor of all living beings with his thirteen wives, including vegetation

claims.statement: A tortoise is also called a-kupa-ara because it does not move in a well (on account of its shallowness).
claims.statement_id: Kura-kura juga disebut a-kupa-ara karena tidak bergerak dalam sumur (karena dangkalnya).
claims.quote: A tortoise is also called a-kupa-ara, because it does not move in a well [On account of its shallowness].

claims.statement: 'Panikacchapika', meaning 'Hand Tortoise', is a special positioning of the fingers during worship rituals to symbolise Kurma.
claims.statement_id: 'Panikacchapika', yang berarti 'kura-kura tangan', adalah posisi jari khusus dalam ritual pemujaan untuk melambangkan Kurma.
claims.quote: meaning 'Hand Tortoise', is a special positioning of the fingers during worship rituals to symbolise Kurma.

claims.statement: The article infobox lists Vaishnavism as affiliation, abode in Bharata Khanda, Vaikuntha and Srikurmam, the mantra Om Kurmaya Namah, no weapon, the festival Kurma Jayanti, and Lakshmi as Sindhusuta for consort.
claims.statement_id: Kotak info Wikipedia mencantumkan afiliasi Waisnawa, tempat tinggal di Bharata Khanda, Vaikuntha, dan Srikurmam, mantra Om Kurmaya Namah, tanpa senjata, perayaan Kurma Jayanti, dan pasangan Lakshmi sebagai Sindhusuta.
claims.quote: Affiliation Vaishnavism Abode Bharata Khanda, Vaikuntha, Srikurmam Mantra Om Kurmaya Namah Weapon None Festivals Kurma Jayanti Consort Lakshmi as Sindhusuta

claims.statement: Notable depictions include the relief at Angkor Wat with Vishnu and Kurma in the centre and the gods and demons on either side churning the ocean.
claims.statement_id: Penggambaran terkenal mencakup relief di Angkor Wat dengan Wisnu dan Kurma di tengah serta para dewa dan iblis di kedua sisi mengaduk samudra.
claims.quote: Notable depictions include the relief at Angkor Wat with Vishnu and Kurma in the centre and the gods and demons on either side churning the ocean.

claims.statement: Srikurmam was initially a Shiva temple, which was converted into a Vaishnava one by the Vaishnava saint Ramanuja.
claims.statement_id: Srikurmam semula kuil Siwa yang diubah menjadi kuil Waisnawa oleh santo Waisnawa Ramanuja.
claims.quote: Srikurmam was initially a Shiva temple, which was converted into a Vaishnava one by the Vaishnava saint Ramanuja.

claims.statement: Nanditha Krishna suggests that a tribal tortoise god could have been assimilated into the Hindu fold by identifying him with Kurma.
claims.statement_id: Nanditha Krishna menduga bahwa dewa kura-kura suku dapat diserap ke dalam lingkungan Hindu dengan mengidentifikasikannya sebagai Kurma.
claims.quote: Nanditha Krishna suggests that a tribal tortoise god could have been assimilated in the Hindu fold by identifying him with Kurma.

claims.statement: Vishnu has ten avatars or worldly appearances, which are people, animals or a mix of both.
claims.statement_id: Wisnu memiliki sepuluh avatar atau penampakan duniawi, yang berupa manusia, hewan, atau campuran keduanya.
claims.quote: Vishnu has ten avatars or worldly appearances, which are people, animals or a mix of both.

claims.statement: In the list of avatars, Kurma is named as the tortoise, alongside Matsya (the fish) and Varaha (the boar).
claims.statement_id: Dalam daftar avatar, Kurma disebut sebagai kura-kura, bersama Matsya (ikan) dan Varaha (babi hutan).
claims.quote: Matsya (the fish) Kurma (the tortoise) Varaha (the boar)

claims.statement: In the Bhagavata Purana, an epic poem collecting many Vaishnavite stories, Vishnu is also credited with giving all the other gods the gift of immortality.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Bhagavata Purana, puisi epik yang menghimpun banyak kisah Waisnawa, Wisnu juga dikatakan memberi semua dewa lain karunia keabadian.
claims.quote: In the Bhagavata Purana, an epic poem that collects together many Vaishnavite stories, Vishnu is also credited with giving all the other gods the gift of immortality.

claims.statement: To mix the ocean they used the holy Mt. Mandara with the giant serpent Vasuki (or Ananta) as a rope, one end pulled by the demons and the other by the gods.
claims.statement_id: Untuk mengaduk samudra mereka memakai Gunung Mandara yang suci dengan ular raksasa Vasuki (atau Ananta) sebagai tali; satu ujung ditarik para iblis dan ujung lain oleh para dewa.
claims.quote: To mix the ocean they decided to use the holy Mt. Mandara with the giant serpent Vasuki (or Ananta) as a turning rope; one end to be pulled by Demons and the other by the gods.

claims.statement: Neither group could handle such a weight, so they called for Vishnu to hold it; he did so in the form of Kurma, the giant tortoise, supporting the mountain on his shell.
claims.statement_id: Namun tak satu pun pihak sanggup menanggung beban itu sehingga mereka memanggil Wisnu untuk menahannya; ia melakukannya dalam wujud Kurma, kura-kura raksasa, menopang gunung di cangkangnya.
claims.quote: However, neither group could handle such a weight and they called for Vishnu to hold it. This he did in the form of Kurma, the giant tortoise, supporting the mountain on his shell.

claims.statement: The nectar was created from the foaming sea but the demons tried to make off with it; Vishnu intervened as the beautiful Maya and, with the demons distracted, gave the nectar to the gods, allowing them the possibility of immortality.
claims.statement_id: Nektar tercipta dari laut berbusa, tetapi para iblis mencoba membawanya kabur; Wisnu turun tangan dalam wujud Maya yang cantik dan, karena para iblis terkecoh, nektar itu diberikan kepada para dewa sehingga mereka berpeluang abadi.
claims.quote: The nectar was duly created from the foaming sea but the Demons, true to character, tried to make off with it. Fortunately, Vishnu interceded in the form of the beautiful Maya (the personification of Illusion) and, suitably distracted, the Demons relinquished the nectar which Vishnu graciously gave to the gods, allowing them the possibility of immortality.

claims.statement: In Hinduism Kurma (Sanskrit: "Tortoise") is the second avatar of Vishnu, the preserver god in the Hindu Trimurti, who appeared in the Satya Yuga as a giant turtle to save the earth from destruction.
claims.statement_id: Dalam agama Hindu, Kurma (Sanskerta: berarti "kura-kura") adalah avatar kedua Wisnu, dewa pemelihara dalam Trimurti Hindu, yang muncul pada Satya Yuga sebagai kura-kura raksasa untuk menyelamatkan bumi dari kehancuran.
claims.quote: In the Hindu religion, Kurma (Sanskrit: meaning "Tortoise") is the second avatar of Vishnu, the preserver god in the Hindu Trimurti (trinity), who appeared in the Satya Yuga as a giant turtle to save the earth from destruction.

claims.statement: His enormous back was said to provide a foundation for the mythical Mount Mandara, used by the gods (and demons) as a churning rod to stir the primordial milk-ocean and obtain the nectar of immortality.
claims.statement_id: Punggungnya yang besar dikatakan menjadi landasan bagi Gunung Mandara yang mitis, yang dipakai para dewa (dan iblis) sebagai tongkat pengaduk samudra susu purba untuk memperoleh nektar keabadian.
claims.quote: His enormous back was said to have provided a foundation for the mythical Mount Mandara, which was used by the gods (and demons) as a churning rod to stir the primordial milk-ocean thereby obtaining the purported nectar of immortality.

claims.statement: It is said that the ancient sage Durvasa gave Indra a garland of flowers; Indra placed it upon his elephant Airavata, who threw it down and trampled it; the short-tempered Durvasa cursed Indra and the devas so that they would lose their strength.
claims.statement_id: Konon resi kuno Durvasa memberi Indra kalung bunga; Indra menaruhnya pada gajahnya Airavata, yang melemparkan dan menginjaknya; Durvasa yang pemarah mengutuk Indra dan para dewa agar kehilangan kekuatan.
claims.quote: It is said that Durvasa, an ancient sage, gave a garland of flowers to Indra. Indra placed this garland upon his elephant Airavata, who promptly threw it on the ground and trampled it. Having witnessed this desecration of his gift, the short-tempered Durvasa cursed Indra and all the other devas (benevolent gods) so that they would lose their strength.

claims.statement: As the churning continued Mt. Mandara began to sink into the mud at the bottom of the milk-ocean; so it would sink no further, Vishnu took the form of Kurma, the tortoise, and supported the mountain upon his broad back.
claims.statement_id: Seiring pengadukan, Gunung Mandara perlahan tenggelam ke lumpur dasar samudra susu; agar tidak tenggelam lebih dalam, Wisnu mengambil wujud Kurma, sang kura-kura, dan menopang gunung di punggungnya yang lebar.
claims.quote: As the churning continued, Mt. Mandara began to gradually sink into the mud at the bottom of the milk-ocean. In order to provide support for the mountain so it would not sink any further, Vishnu took the form of Kurma, the tortoise, and supported the mountain upon his broad back.

claims.statement: The asuras promptly commandeered the elixir, but thanks to another trick by Vishnu appearing as Mohini, the devas obtained the elixir of immortality for themselves.
claims.statement_id: Para asura segera merebut ramuan itu, tetapi berkat tipuan Wisnu yang menjelma sebagai Mohini, para dewa memperoleh ramuan keabadian untuk diri mereka.
claims.quote: The asuras promptly commandeered the elixir, however, thanks to another trick on the part of Vishnu in which he appeared as the female Mohini in order to dumbfound the asuras by way of seduction, the devas attained the elixir of immortality for themselves.

claims.statement: In Hindu iconography Kurma is depicted as a tortoise, or as a human being with a tortoise head or body; his colour is black, although sometimes he is shown as golden.
claims.statement_id: Dalam ikonografi Hindu, Kurma digambarkan sebagai kura-kura, atau sebagai manusia berkepala atau bertubuh kura-kura; warnanya hitam, meski kadang digambarkan keemasan.
claims.quote: In Hindu iconography, Kurma is depicted as a tortoise, or else as a human being with a tortoise head or a tortoise body. His colour is black, although sometimes he is depicted as golden in colour.

claims.statement: Kurma is commonly pictured with his consorts Sri and Bhumi, or else with Sri and the Pusti tree.
claims.statement_id: Kurma lazim digambarkan bersama pasangannya Sri dan Bhumi, atau bersama Sri dan pohon Pusti.
claims.quote: Kurma is commonly pictured with his consorts Sri and Bhumi, or else with Sri and the Pusti tree.

claims.statement: Although Kurma is not widely worshiped in modern Hinduism, he is still acknowledged as an important figure in Hindu cosmology.
claims.statement_id: Meskipun Kurma tidak banyak dipuja dalam Hindu modern, ia tetap diakui sebagai tokoh penting dalam kosmologi Hindu.
claims.quote: Although Kurma is not widely worshiped in modern Hinduism, he is still acknowledged as an important figure in Hindu cosmology.

claims.statement: It is because of Kurma that Vishnu met his wife, the beloved Lakshmi.
claims.statement_id: Karena Kurma-lah Wisnu bertemu istrinya, Lakshmi yang dicintai.
claims.quote: it is because of Kurma that Vishnu met his wife, the beloved Lakshmi

claims.statement: The story of the Kurma Avatar, said to be found in the Kurma Purana, reflects the usurping of the early Vedic deities (such as Indra and Varuna) by the popular gods of Classical Hinduism such as the Trimurti.
claims.statement_id: Kisah Avatar Kurma, yang disebut terdapat dalam Kurma Purana, mencerminkan tergesernya dewa-dewa Weda awal (seperti Indra dan Varuna) oleh dewa-dewa populer Hindu Klasik seperti Trimurti.
claims.quote: The story of the Kurma Avatar, found in the Kurma Purana, reflects the usurping of the early Hindu Vedic deities (such as Indra and Varuna) with the popular gods of Classical Hinduism such as the Hindu Trimurti.

claims.statement: The detailed tale of the Samudra Manthana is absent from this Purana, which alludes to Kurma only as the one who supported Mount Mandara.
claims.statement_id: Kisah rinci Samudra Manthana tidak terdapat dalam Purana ini, yang hanya menyinggung Kurma sebagai penopang Gunung Mandara.
claims.quote: The detailed tale of the Samudra Manthana is absent from the Purana and alludes to Kurma as the one who supported Mount Mandara.

claims.statement: In the anthropomorphic form the upper half resembles Vishnu and wears the traditional ornaments and the kirita-mukuta (tall conical crown) as worn by Vishnu.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bentuk antropomorfik, bagian atasnya menyerupai Wisnu dan mengenakan perhiasan tradisional serta kirita-mukuta, mahkota kerucut tinggi seperti yang dikenakan Wisnu.
claims.quote: The upper half resembles Vishnu and wears the traditional ornaments and the kirita-mukuta (tall conical crown) as worn by Vishnu.

claims.statement: In the anthropomorphic form, the upper half is that of the four-armed man and the lower half is a fish.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bentuk antropomorfik, bagian atas berupa pria berlengan empat dan bagian bawah berupa ikan.
claims.quote: In the anthropomorphic form, the upper half is that of the four-armed man and the lower half is a fish.

claims.statement: Tláloc is the god of rain in Aztec religion.
claims.statement_id: Tláloc adalah dewa hujan dalam agama Aztec.
claims.quote: is the god of rain in Aztec religion.

claims.statement: He was also a deity of earthly fertility and water, worshipped as a giver of life.
claims.statement_id: Ia adalah dewa kesuburan tanah dan air yang dipuja sebagai pemberi kehidupan.
claims.quote: He was also a deity of earthly fertility and water, and worshipped as a giver of life and sustenance; many rituals and sacrifices predicated upon these aspects were held in his name.

claims.statement: He was feared for his power over hail, thunder, and lightning.
claims.statement_id: Ia ditakuti karena kekuasaannya atas hujan es, guntur, dan kilat.
claims.quote: He was feared—albeit not as a malicious figure—for his power over hail, thunder, lightning, and rain.

claims.statement: He is also associated with caves, springs, and mountains.
claims.statement_id: Ia diasosiasikan dengan gua, mata air, dan puncak gunung tinggi.
claims.quote: He is also associated with caves, springs, and mountains, most specifically the sacred mountain where he was believed to reside.

claims.statement: Tláloc is one of the most important and formidable gods of the Aztec pantheon, considered the god of rain, water, lightning and agriculture.
claims.statement_id: Tláloc adalah salah satu dewa terpenting dan paling menakutkan dalam jajaran dewa Aztec, dianggap dewa hujan, air, petir, dan pertanian.
claims.quote: is one of the most important and formidable gods in the Aztec pantheon. He was considered the god of rain, water, lightning and agriculture.

claims.statement: Tlaloc was seen both as a benevolent god providing life-giving rain and as an unforgiving, destructive deity when he sent storms and drought.
claims.statement_id: Tlaloc dipandang sebagai dewa yang murah hati karena memberi hujan penghidupan, tetapi juga sebagai dewa yang tak kenal ampun dan merusak ketika mengirim badai dan kekeringan.
claims.quote: Tlaloc was seen as both a benevolent god providing life-giving rain but also as an unforgiving and destructive deity when he sent storms and drought.

claims.statement: The name Tláloc derives from the Nahuatl words tlali, meaning 'earth', and oc, meaning 'something on the surface'.
claims.statement_id: Nama Tláloc berasal dari kata Nahuatl tlali yang berarti 'bumi' dan oc yang berarti 'sesuatu di permukaan'.
claims.quote: The name Tláloc derives from the Nahuatl words tlali meaning 'earth' and oc meaning 'something on the surface'.

claims.statement: From the jar of the East Tláloc gave out the rains essential for life, whereas from the other jars he dispensed drought, disease and frost, deadly for mankind and crops.
claims.statement_id: Dari kendi di arah timur, Tláloc mengirim hujan yang penting bagi kehidupan, sedangkan dari kendi-kendi lain ia menurunkan kekeringan, penyakit, dan embun beku yang mematikan bagi manusia dan tanaman.
claims.quote: From the jar of the East Tláloc gave out the rains so essential for life whilst from the other jars the god dispensed the terrible scourges of drought, disease and frost so deadly for mankind and crops.

claims.statement: Rain was also thought to come when the Tlálocs used sticks to smash the water jars inside mountains, and the sound of thunder was believed to be the noise of these jars being smashed.
claims.statement_id: Hujan juga dipercaya turun ketika para Tláloc memukul kendi air di dalam gunung dengan tongkat, dan suara guntur dipercaya sebagai bunyi pecahnya kendi-kendi itu.
claims.quote: Alternatively, rain was thought to come when the Tlálocs used sticks to smash the water jars which were inside mountains. Indeed, the sound of thunder was believed to be the noise made when these water jars were smashed.

claims.statement: Tláloc was also considered the ruler of the Tlaloque, a motley group of rain, weather and mountain gods.
claims.statement_id: Tláloc juga dianggap penguasa para Tlaloque, sekelompok dewa hujan, cuaca, dan gunung yang beragam.
claims.quote: Tláloc was also considered the ruler of the Tlaloque - a motley group of rain, weather and mountain gods

claims.statement: At the Aztec capital Tenochtitlán, two twin temples were set up on the Templo Mayor pyramid, one for Huitzilopochtli (the dry season) and one for Tláloc, who was given equal status.
claims.statement_id: Di ibu kota Aztec, Tenochtitlán, dua kuil kembar didirikan di piramida Templo Mayor: satu untuk Huitzilopochtli (musim kemarau) dan satu untuk Tláloc, yang diberi kedudukan setara.
claims.quote: At the Aztec capital of Tenochtitlán two twin temples were set up on the Templo Mayor pyramid, one dedicated to the great god Huitzilopochtli (representing the dry season) and the other to Tláloc who was given equal status.

claims.statement: To appease the god, sacrificial victims were offered, including children, whose tears were seen as a favourable sign and linked to drops of rain from Tláloc himself.
claims.statement_id: Untuk menenangkan dewa ini dipersembahkan korban, termasuk anak-anak, yang tangisnya dianggap pertanda baik dan dikaitkan dengan tetes hujan dari Tláloc sendiri.
claims.quote: More sinister offerings to appease the god and win his favour were sacrificial victims, including children, whose tears were seen as a favourable sign and linked to drops of rain from Tláloc himself.

claims.statement: Tláloc was believed to rule the other-worldly paradise of Tlalocán, where victims of floods, storms and diseases such as leprosy were received after death.
claims.statement_id: Tláloc dipercaya menguasai surga Tlalocán, tempat korban banjir, badai, dan penyakit seperti lepra diterima setelah mati.
claims.quote: Tláloc was also believed to rule the other-worldly paradise of Tlalocán where victims of floods, storms and diseases such as leprosy were received after death.

claims.statement: In later Postclassical Mexico, Tláloc was believed to live in caves that were damp and filled with magnificent treasures.
claims.statement_id: Pada masa Pascaklasik di Meksiko, Tláloc dipercaya tinggal di gua-gua yang lembap dan penuh harta indah.
claims.quote: In later Postclassical Mexico Tláloc was believed to live in caves which were suitably damp for a rain god but also filled with magnificent treasures.

claims.statement: The earliest representations of Tláloc in art belong to 1st-century BCE vases from Tlapacoya, where the god wields a lightning bolt.
claims.statement_id: Penggambaran tertua Tláloc dalam seni berasal dari vas abad ke-1 SM di Tlapacoya, tempat sang dewa memegang petir.
claims.quote: The earliest representations of Tláloc in art belong to 1st century BCE vases from Tlapacoya where the god wields a lightning bolt.

claims.statement: Tláloc is commonly depicted in the company of snakes, most often with goggled eyes and large fangs like a jaguar.
claims.statement_id: Tláloc lazim digambarkan bersama ular; ia paling sering bermata bulat besar seperti kacamata renang dan bertaring besar seperti jaguar.
claims.quote: Tláloc is commonly depicted in the company of snakes. He most often has goggled eyes and large fangs like a jaguar

claims.statement: In the various Mesoamerican cultures Tláloc appears as Dzahui for the Mixtec, Tajín for the Totonac, Chupithripeme for the Tarascan and Cocijo for the Zapotec.
claims.statement_id: Dalam berbagai budaya Mesoamerika, Tláloc muncul sebagai Dzahui bagi suku Mixtec, Tajín bagi Totonac, Chupithripeme bagi Tarasca, dan Cocijo bagi Zapotec.
claims.quote: In the various Mesoamerican cultures Tláloc appears as Dzahui for the Mixtec, Tajίn for the Totonac, Chupithripeme for the Tarascan and Cocijo for the Zapotec.

claims.statement: Tlaloc was important to the Aztecs because he was the god of vital rains needed for agriculture.
claims.statement_id: Tlaloc penting bagi bangsa Aztec karena ia dewa hujan vital yang dibutuhkan untuk pertanian.
claims.quote: Tlaloc was important to the Aztecs because he was the god of vital rains needed for agriculture.

claims.statement: Tláloc's two main identifiers are fangs and ringed eyes.
claims.statement_id: Dua penanda utama Tláloc adalah taring dan mata bercincin.
claims.quote: Tláloc's two main identifiers are fangs, along with ringed eyes.

claims.statement: In the Aztec creation myth, Tláloc was ruler of the 3rd Sun and was linked to Mázatl (Deer), the 7th day.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitos penciptaan Aztec, Tláloc adalah penguasa Matahari ke-3 dan dikaitkan dengan Mázatl (Rusa), hari ketujuh.
claims.quote: In the Aztec Creation myth Tláloc was ruler of the 3rd Sun, he was linked to Mázatl (Deer) the 7th day

claims.statement: Tláloc was born during the Creation, when Quetzalcoatl and Huitzilpochtli (or in some versions Tezcatlipoca) dismembered the reptilian monster Cipactli.
claims.statement_id: Tláloc lahir pada masa penciptaan, ketika Quetzalcoatl dan Huitzilpochtli (atau dalam beberapa versi Tezcatlipoca) mencabik-cabik monster reptil Cipactli.
claims.quote: Born during the Creation when Quetzalcoatl and Huitzilpochtli (or in some versions Tezcatlipoca) dismembered the reptilian monster Cipactli

claims.statement: Chalchiúhtlicue, a goddess of rivers, oceans and floods, is called the sister of Tláloc or, in some versions, his wife or mother.
claims.statement_id: Chalchiúhtlicue, dewi sungai, samudra, dan banjir, disebut sebagai saudari Tláloc atau, dalam beberapa versi, istri atau ibunya.
claims.quote: along with his sister Chalchiúhtlicue (or in some versions his wife or mother), herself a goddess of rivers, oceans and floods.

claims.statement: He was also the patron god of the Aztecs and their capital city, Tenochtitlan.
claims.statement_id: Ia adalah dewa pelindung bangsa Aztecs dan ibu kota Tenochtitlan.
claims.quote: He was also the patron god of the Aztecs and their capital city, Tenochtitlan.

claims.statement: He wielded Xiuhcoatl, the fire serpent, as a weapon.
claims.statement_id: Ia menggunakan Xiuhcoatl sang ular api sebagai senjatanya.
claims.quote: He wielded Xiuhcoatl, the fire serpent, as a weapon, thus also associating Huitzilopochtli with fire.

claims.statement: The Spaniards recorded the deity's name as Huichilobos.
claims.statement_id: Orang Spanyol mencatat nama dewa ini sebagai Huichilobos.
claims.quote: The Spaniards recorded the deity's name as Huichilobos.

claims.statement: Huitzilopochtli was one of the most important deities in the Aztec pantheon, and for the Méxica he was the supreme god.
claims.statement_id: Huitzilopochtli adalah salah satu dewa terpenting dalam jajaran dewa Aztec, dan bagi bangsa Méxica ia dewa tertinggi.
claims.quote: was one of the most important deities in the Aztec pantheon and for the Méxica he was the supreme god.

claims.statement: He was the god of the sun and war, considered the patron of the Aztec capital Tenochtitlán and associated with gold, warriors and rulers.
claims.statement_id: Ia dewa matahari dan perang, dianggap pelindung ibu kota Aztec Tenochtitlán, serta dikaitkan dengan emas, prajurit, dan penguasa.
claims.quote: He was the god of the sun and war, considered the patron of the Aztec capital Tenochtitlán and associated with gold, warriors and rulers.

claims.statement: It is generally agreed that his name has two elements: huītzilin, "hummingbird", and ōpōchtli, "left hand side".
claims.statement_id: Umumnya disepakati bahwa namanya terdiri atas dua unsur: huītzilin yang berarti burung kolibri dan ōpōchtli yang berarti sisi tangan kiri.
claims.quote: Generally it is agreed that there are two elements, huītzilin "hummingbird" and ōpōchtli "left hand side".

claims.statement: The name is often translated as "Left-Handed Hummingbird" or "Hummingbird of the South", because Aztec cosmology associated the south with the left hand side of the body.
claims.statement_id: Nama itu sering diterjemahkan sebagai "Kolibri Kidal" atau "Kolibri dari Selatan", karena kosmologi Aztec mengaitkan selatan dengan sisi kiri tubuh.
claims.quote: The name is often translated as "Left-Handed Hummingbird" or "Hummingbird of the South" on the basis that Aztec cosmology associated the south with the left hand side of the body.

claims.statement: Huitzilopochtli famously avenged the murder of his mother Coatlícue (or in some versions actually saved her) when he defeated his siblings, the 400 Centzonhuitznahuac and Centzonmimizcoa, on Mt. Coatepec, the snake mountain.
claims.statement_id: Huitzilopochtli terkenal membalas pembunuhan ibunya, Coatlícue (atau dalam beberapa versi justru menyelamatkannya), dengan mengalahkan saudara-saudaranya, 400 Centzonhuitznahuac dan Centzonmimizcoa, di Gunung Coatepec, gunung ular.
claims.quote: Huitzilopochtli famously avenged the murder of his mother Coatlίcue (or in some versions actually saved her) when he defeated his siblings the 400 Centzonhuitznahuac and Centzonmimizcoa on Mt. Coatepec, the snake mountain.

claims.statement: When Coatlícue's children decapitated their mother, Huitzilopochtli sprang from the corpse with all his weapons in hand and lopped off his sister Coyolxauhqui's head.
claims.statement_id: Ketika anak-anak Coatlícue memenggal ibu mereka, Huitzilopochtli melompat keluar dari jasadnya dengan semua senjata di tangan dan memenggal kepala saudarinya, Coyolxauhqui.
claims.quote: Her children were outraged at this development and attacked Coatlίcue but when they decapitated their mother Huitzilopochtli sprang from the corpse with all his weapons in hand and lopped off his sister Coyolxauhqui's head.

claims.statement: Huitzilopochtli dismembered her corpse so that her torso fell to the bottom of the mountain, and the head he slung into the skies became the moon.
claims.statement_id: Huitzilopochtli memotong-motong jasad Coyolxauhqui sehingga badannya jatuh ke kaki gunung, dan kepalanya yang ia lemparkan ke langit menjadi bulan.
claims.quote: Huitzilopochtli dismembered her corpse so that her torso fell to the bottom of the mountain and when he slung the head into the skies it became the moon.

claims.statement: Huitzilopochtli put an end to his siblings' takeover attempt and dispersed them into the heavens to become the southern and northern constellations respectively.
claims.statement_id: Huitzilopochtli menghentikan upaya perebutan kuasa saudara-saudaranya dan menyebarkan mereka ke langit sebagai rasi bintang selatan dan utara.
claims.quote: putting an end to their takeover attempt and dispersing them into the heavens to become the southern and northern constellations respectively.

claims.statement: For the Aztecs the tussle between Coyolxauhqui and Huitzilopochtli was thought to reoccur every day, which explained the daily exchange for control of the sky between the sun and moon.
claims.statement_id: Bagi bangsa Aztec, pergulatan antara Coyolxauhqui dan Huitzilopochtli dianggap terulang setiap hari, dan itu menjelaskan pergantian harian penguasa langit antara matahari dan bulan.
claims.quote: For the Aztecs the tussle between Coyolxauhqui and Huitzilopochtli was thought to reoccur everyday which explained the daily exchange for control of the sky between the sun and moon.

claims.statement: On the first half of his journey across the sky Huitzilopochtli was believed to be accompanied by the spirits of fallen warriors, who would later return to earth as hummingbirds.
claims.statement_id: Pada paruh pertama perjalanannya melintasi langit, Huitzilopochtli dipercaya ditemani arwah prajurit yang gugur, yang kelak kembali ke bumi sebagai burung kolibri.
claims.quote: Huitzilopochtli was believed to be accompanied on the first half of his journey across the sky by the spirits of fallen warriors (who would later return to earth as hummingbirds).

claims.statement: When night fell Huitzilopochtli moved through the Underworld until dawn, and he then once more travelled the skies.
claims.statement_id: Ketika malam tiba, Huitzilopochtli bergerak melalui Dunia Bawah sampai fajar, lalu kembali menempuh langit.
claims.quote: When night fell Huitzilopochtli moved through the Underworld until dawn and he then once more travelled the skies.

claims.statement: In the Aztec capital he had a wooden statue and shrine alongside that of Tláloc atop the Temple Mayor pyramid, or Hueteocalli.
claims.statement_id: Di ibu kota Aztec, ia memiliki patung kayu dan kuil di samping milik Tláloc di puncak piramida Temple Mayor atau Hueteocalli.
claims.quote: The focal point of worship to Huitzilopochtli was at the Aztec capital where he had a wooden statue and shrine alongside that of Tláloc atop the Temple Mayor pyramid or Hueteocalli.

claims.statement: Because he was such an important deity, Huitzilopochtli was the beneficiary of human sacrifices whose blood would feed and strengthen the god.
claims.statement_id: Karena begitu pentingnya, Huitzilopochtli menerima korban manusia yang darahnya dipercaya memberi makan dan menguatkan sang dewa.
claims.quote: As Huitzilopochtli was such an important deity he was the beneficiary of human sacrifices whose blood would feed and strengthen the god.

claims.statement: The Méxica especially revered Huitzilopochtli because they believed he had led them from the legendary Aztlán cave in the northwest desert on a protracted journey that eventually led to their new capital Tenochtitlán.
claims.statement_id: Bangsa Méxica sangat memuliakan Huitzilopochtli karena percaya ia memimpin mereka dari gua Aztlán yang legendaris di gurun barat laut dalam perjalanan panjang menuju ibu kota baru mereka, Tenochtitlán.
claims.quote: The Méxica, especially, revered Huitzilopochtli as they believed he had led them from the legendary Aztlán cave in the northwest desert on a protracted journey that eventually led to their new capital Tenochtitlán.

claims.statement: During this migration priests carried a huge idol of the god, who whispered directions, gave the Méxica their name and promised great wealth and prosperity if he was suitably worshipped.
claims.statement_id: Selama perpindahan itu, para imam membawa arca besar sang dewa yang membisikkan arah, memberi bangsa Méxica nama mereka, dan menjanjikan kekayaan dan kemakmuran bila ia dipuja dengan layak.
claims.quote: During this migration priests had carried a huge idol of the god who whispered directions, gave the Méxica their name and promised great wealth and prosperity if he was suitably worshipped.

claims.statement: The great war god instructed that the rebel's heart be thrown as far as possible into Lake Texcoco; where it landed would indicate the place the Méxica should build their new home, marked by an eagle sitting on a prickly-pear cactus.
claims.statement_id: Sang dewa perang memerintahkan agar jantung pemberontak dilempar sejauh mungkin ke Danau Texcoco; tempat jatuhnya menunjukkan lokasi rumah baru bangsa Méxica, yang ditandai seekor elang di atas kaktus pir berduri.
claims.quote: The great war god instructed that the rebel's heart be thrown as far as possible into Lake Texcoco and where it landed would indicate the place the Méxica should build their new home, the precise spot being marked by an eagle sitting on a prickly-pear cactus.

claims.statement: Huitzilopochtli may be depicted carrying his snake-shaped spear-thrower (atl-atl), which represents the fire-serpent Xiuhcóatl; he may also carry a shield or feathered arrows or darts and be painted with blue arms and legs.
claims.statement_id: Huitzilopochtli dapat digambarkan membawa pelontar tombak berbentuk ular (atl-atl) yang melambangkan ular api Xiuhcóatl; ia juga bisa membawa perisai atau anak panah berbulu dan dilukis dengan lengan dan kaki biru.
claims.quote: Huitzilopochtli may be depicted carrying his snake-shaped spear-thrower (atl-atl) which represents the fire-serpent Xiuhcóatl. He may also carry a shield, hold feathered arrows or darts and be painted with blue arms and legs.

claims.statement: The god could be symbolised by a hummingbird (huitzilin), whose feathers he wore in his helmet, or by an eagle sitting on a prickly pear cactus holding a snake, an image seen today on the national flag of Mexico.
claims.statement_id: Sang dewa dapat dilambangkan dengan kolibri (huitzilin), yang bulunya ia kenakan di helmnya, atau elang di atas kaktus pir berduri yang mencengkeram ular, gambar yang kini terlihat pada bendera nasional Meksiko.
claims.quote: The god could be symbolised by either a hummingbird (huitzilin) - whose feathers he wore in his helmet - or an eagle sitting on a prickly pear cactus holding a snake in one of its talons, an image seen today in the national flag of Mexico.

claims.statement: In Aztec mythology Huitzilopochtli was the son of Omecíhuatl and Ometecuhtli; in an alternative version he is the offspring of Coatlícue, the supreme earth goddess.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Aztec, Huitzilopochtli adalah putra Omecíhuatl dan Ometecuhtli; dalam versi lain ia anak Coatlícue, dewi bumi tertinggi.
claims.quote: In Aztec mythology Huitzilopochtli was the son of Omecίhuatl and Ometecuhtli, respectively, the female and male aspects of the androgynous primordial god Ometeotl. ... In an alternative version, the god is the offspring of Coatlίcue, the supreme earth goddess.

claims.statement: Huitzilopochtli was also considered the brother of the other great Mesoamerican gods Quetzalcoatl, Tezcatlipoca and Xipe Totec.
claims.statement_id: Huitzilopochtli juga dianggap saudara dewa-dewa besar Mesoamerika lainnya: Quetzalcoatl, Tezcatlipoca, dan Xipe Totec.
claims.quote: Huitzilopochtli was also considered the brother of those other great Mesoamerican gods Quetzalcoatl, Tezcatlipoca and Xipe Totec.

claims.statement: He was also celebrated in the month of Toxcatl, when an effigy (tzoalli) made from amaranth dough and dressed as Huitzilopochtli was taken to the god's temple in a great procession and then eaten.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga dirayakan pada bulan Toxcatl, ketika sebuah patung adonan amaranta (tzoalli) berpakaian Huitzilopochtli diarak ke kuilnya lalu dimakan.
claims.quote: he was also celebrated during the month of Toxcatl when an effigy or tzoalli made from dough using the amaranth plant and dressed as Huitzilopochtli was taken to the god's temple in a great procession and then eaten.

claims.statement: Originally he was of little importance to the Nahuas, but after the rise of the Aztecs, Tlacaelel reformed their religion and put him at the same level as Quetzalcoatl, Tlaloc and Tezcatlipoca, making him a solar god.
claims.statement_id: Mulanya ia kurang penting bagi bangsa Nahua, tetapi setelah bangkitnya bangsa Aztec, Tlacaelel mereformasi agama mereka dan menempatkannya sejajar dengan Quetzalcoatl, Tlaloc, dan Tezcatlipoca sebagai dewa matahari.
claims.quote: Originally, he was of little importance to the Nahuas, but after the rise of the Aztecs, Tlacaelel reformed their religion and put Huitzilopochtli at the same level as Quetzalcoatl, Tlaloc, and Tezcatlipoca, making him a solar god.

claims.statement: In the Aztec worldview the Sun is constantly chasing the Moon and stars, which is why it was so important to provide tribute for Huitzilopochtli as sustenance for the Sun.
claims.statement_id: Dalam pandangan dunia Aztec, matahari terus mengejar bulan dan bintang, dan karena itu penting memberi persembahan kepada Huitzilopochtli sebagai santapan bagi Matahari.
claims.quote: Huitzilopochtli is seen as the sun in mythology, while his many male siblings are perceived as the stars and his sister as the moon. In the Aztec worldview, this is the reason why the Sun is constantly chasing the Moon and stars. It is also why it was so important to provide tribute for Huitzilopochtli as sustenance for the Sun.

claims.statement: In one origin story, Huitzilopochtli and Quetzalcoatl together created fire, the first male and female humans, the Earth, and the Sun.
claims.statement_id: Dalam satu kisah asal-usul, Huitzilopochtli dan Quetzalcoatl bersama-sama menciptakan api, manusia laki-laki dan perempuan pertama, Bumi, dan Matahari.
claims.quote: Together, Huitzilopochtli and Quetzalcoatl created fire, the first male and female humans, the Earth, and the Sun.

claims.statement: Huitzilopochtli (Classical Nahuatl: Huītzilōpōchtli) is the solar and war deity of sacrifice in Aztec religion.
claims.statement_id: Huitzilopochtli (dalam bahasa Nahuatl Klasik: Huītzilōpōchtli) adalah dewa matahari dan perang, serta dewa pengorbanan, dalam agama Aztec.
claims.quote: Huitzilopochtli (Classical Nahuatl: Huītzilōpōchtli ... is the solar and war deity of sacrifice in Aztec religion.

claims.statement: Viracocha is the creator and supreme deity in pre-Inca and Inca mythology in the Andes.
claims.statement_id: Viracocha adalah dewa pencipta tertinggi dalam mitologi Inca di Andes.
claims.quote: Viracocha (also Wiraqocha, Huiracocha; Quechua Wiraqucha) is the creator and supreme deity in the pre-Inca and Inca mythology in the Andes region of South America.

claims.statement: According to myth, Viracocha had human appearance and was generally considered bearded.
claims.statement_id: Menurut mitos, Viracocha berwujud manusia dan umumnya digambarkan berjanggut.
claims.quote: According to the myth Viracocha had human appearance and was generally considered as bearded.

claims.statement: According to the myth he ordered the construction of Tiwanaku.
claims.statement_id: Menurut mitos, ia memerintahkan pembangunan Tiwanaku.
claims.quote: According to the myth he ordered the construction of Tiwanaku.

claims.statement: Compound names of Viracocha include Ticsi Viracocha and Contiti Viracocha and, occasionally, Kon-Tiki Viracocha, the source of the name of Thor Heyerdahl's raft.
claims.statement_id: Nama majemuk Viracocha antara lain Ticsi Viracocha dan Contiti Viracocha, serta kadang Kon-Tiki Viracocha, yang menjadi sumber nama rakit Thor Heyerdahl.
claims.quote: Such compound names include Ticsi Viracocha (T'iqsi Wiraqocha), Contiti Viracocha, and, occasionally, Kon-Tiki Viracocha (the source of the name of Thor Heyerdahl's raft).

claims.statement: Considered the creator god, he was the father of all other Inca gods and formed the earth, heavens, sun, moon and all living beings.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai dewa pencipta, ia dianggap ayah semua dewa Inca lainnya dan dialah yang membentuk bumi, langit, matahari, bulan, dan semua makhluk hidup.
claims.quote: Considered the creator god he was the father of all other Inca gods and it was he who formed the earth, heavens, sun, moon and all living beings.

claims.statement: When he finished his work he was believed to have travelled far and wide teaching humanity and bringing the civilised arts, before heading west across the Pacific, never to be seen again but promising one day to return.
claims.statement_id: Setelah menyelesaikan karyanya, ia dipercaya berkelana jauh mengajar manusia dan membawa seni peradaban, lalu menuju barat melintasi Pasifik dan tak terlihat lagi, tetapi berjanji suatu hari kembali.
claims.quote: When he finished his work he was believed to have travelled far and wide teaching humanity and bringing the civilised arts before he headed west across the Pacific, never to be seen again but promising one day to return.

claims.statement: Other names, perhaps used because the god's real name was too sacred to be spoken, included Ilya (light), Ticci (beginning) and Wiraqoca Pacayacaciq (instructor).
claims.statement_id: Nama-nama lain, yang mungkin dipakai karena nama aslinya terlalu sakral untuk diucapkan, mencakup Ilya (cahaya), Ticci (permulaan), dan Wiraqoca Pacayacaciq (pengajar).
claims.quote: These other names, perhaps used because the god's real name was too sacred to be spoken, included Ilya (light), Ticci (beginning), and Wiraqoca Pacayacaciq (instructor).

claims.statement: Human beings were believed to be Viracocha's second attempt at living creatures, as he first created a race of giants from stone in the age of darkness.
claims.statement_id: Manusia dipercaya merupakan percobaan kedua Viracocha menciptakan makhluk hidup, karena ia lebih dulu menciptakan ras raksasa dari batu pada zaman kegelapan.
claims.quote: It was believed that human beings were actually Viracocha's second attempt at living creatures as he first created a race of giants from stone in the age of darkness.

claims.statement: The giants proved unruly, so Viracocha punished them with a great flood; all but two returned to stone form, and several could still be seen at sites such as Tiahuanaco.
claims.statement_id: Para raksasa itu ternyata membangkang sehingga Viracocha menghukum mereka dengan banjir besar; semuanya kecuali dua kembali menjadi batu, dan beberapa masih terlihat di tempat seperti Tiahuanaco.
claims.quote: However, these giants proved unruly and it became necessary for Viracocha to punish them by sending a great flood. In the legend all these giants except two then returned to their original stone form and several could still be seen in much later times standing imposingly at sites such as Tiahuanaco

claims.statement: Viracocha then created men and women, this time from clay, gave them gifts such as clothes, language, agriculture and the arts, and then created all animals.
