claims.statement_id: Kemudian Viracocha menciptakan laki-laki dan perempuan, kali ini dari tanah liat, memberi mereka pakaian, bahasa, pertanian, dan seni, lalu menciptakan semua hewan.
claims.quote: Then Viracocha created men and women but this time he used clay. He also gave them such gifts as clothes, language, agriculture and the arts and then created all animals.

claims.statement: Viracocha created the sun, moon and stars and so brought light to the world; these heavenly bodies were created from islands in Lake Titicaca.
claims.statement_id: Viracocha menciptakan matahari, bulan, dan bintang sehingga membawa cahaya ke dunia; benda-benda langit itu dibuat dari pulau-pulau di Danau Titicaca.
claims.quote: Viracocha's decision to create the sun, moon and stars and so bring light to the world. These heavenly bodies were created from islands in Lake Titicaca.

claims.statement: Viracocha then set off to spread his civilizing knowledge around the world, dressed as a beggar and assuming names such as Con Ticci Viracocha (also spelt Kon-Tiki), Atun-Viracocha and Contiti Viracocha Pachayachachic.
claims.statement_id: Viracocha lalu berkelana menyebarkan pengetahuan beradab ke seluruh dunia dengan berpakaian pengemis dan memakai nama seperti Con Ticci Viracocha (juga Kon-Tiki), Atun-Viracocha, dan Contiti Viracocha Pachayachachic.
claims.quote: Viracocha then set off to spread his civilizing knowledge around the world and for this he dressed as a beggar and assumed such names as Con Ticci Viracocha (also spelt Kon-Tiki), Atun-Viracocha and Contiti Viracocha Pachayachachic.

claims.statement: On his travels he was assisted by two sons or brothers called Imaymana Viracocha and Tocapo Viracocha.
claims.statement_id: Dalam perjalanannya ia dibantu dua putra atau saudara bernama Imaymana Viracocha dan Tocapo Viracocha.
claims.quote: He was assissted on his travels by two sons or brothers called Imaymana Viracocha and Tocapo Viracocha.

claims.statement: Ending up at Manta (in Ecuador), Viracocha walked across the waters of the Pacific (in some versions he sails a raft) heading west, promising to return one day.
claims.statement_id: Setibanya di Manta (di Ekuador), Viracocha berjalan di atas perairan Pasifik (dalam beberapa versi ia berlayar dengan rakit) menuju barat sambil berjanji akan kembali suatu hari.
claims.quote: Ending up at Manta (in Ecuador), Viracocha then walked across the waters of the Pacific (in some versions he sails a raft) heading into the west but promising to return one day

claims.statement: Viracocha was worshipped by the pre-Inca of Peru before being incorporated into the Inca pantheon.
claims.statement_id: Viracocha sudah dipuja oleh bangsa pra-Inca di Peru sebelum dimasukkan ke dalam jajaran dewa Inca.
claims.quote: Viracocha was actually worshipped by the pre-Inca of Peru before being incorporated into the Inca pantheon.

claims.statement: As other Inca gods were more important for the daily life of common people, Viracocha was principally worshipped by the nobility, and then usually in times of political crisis.
claims.statement_id: Karena dewa Inca lain lebih penting bagi kehidupan sehari-hari rakyat biasa, Viracocha terutama dipuja oleh kaum bangsawan, biasanya pada masa krisis politik.
claims.quote: As other Inca gods were more important for the daily life of common people, Viracocha was principally worshipped by the nobility, and then usually in times of political crisis.

claims.statement: Worshipped at the Inca capital of Cuzco, Viracocha also had temples and statues at Caha and Urcos, and sacrifices of humans (including children) and, quite often, llamas were made to the god on important ceremonial occasions.
claims.statement_id: Di ibu kota Inca, Cuzco, Viracocha dipuja, dan juga memiliki kuil serta patung di Caha dan Urcos; korban manusia (termasuk anak-anak) dan cukup sering llama dipersembahkan pada upacara penting.
claims.quote: Worshipped at the Inca capital of Cuzco, Viracocha also had temples and statues dedicated to him at Caha and Urcos and sacrifices of humans (including children) and, quite often, llamas, were made to the god on important ceremonial occasions.

claims.statement: In art Viracocha is often depicted as an old bearded man wearing a long robe and supported by a staff.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni, Viracocha sering digambarkan sebagai lelaki tua berjanggut berjubah panjang yang ditopang tongkat.
claims.quote: In art Viracocha is often depicted as an old bearded man wearing a long robe and supported by a staff.

claims.statement: Sculpted on the lintel of a massive gateway at Tiwanaku, the god holds thunderbolts in each hand and wears a crown with rays of the sun, while his tears represent the rain.
claims.statement_id: Pada ambang gerbang besar di Tiwanaku, sang dewa dipahat memegang petir di kedua tangan dan bermahkota sinar matahari, sementara air matanya melambangkan hujan.
claims.quote: One of his earliest representations may be the weeping statue at the ruins of Tiwanaku, close to Lake Titicaca, the traditional Inca site where all things were first created. Here, sculpted on the lintel of a massive gateway, the god holds thunderbolts in each hand and wears a crown with rays of the sun whilst his tears represent the rain.

claims.statement: In the Quechuan languages, tiqsi means "origin" or "beginning", wira means fat, and qucha means lake, sea or reservoir.
claims.statement_id: Dalam rumpun bahasa Quechua, tiqsi berarti "asal" atau "permulaan", wira berarti lemak, dan qucha berarti danau, laut, atau waduk.
claims.quote: In the Quechuan languages, tiqsi means "origin" or "beginning", wira means fat, and qucha means lake, sea, or reservoir.

claims.statement: Some people state that Wiraqucha could mean "Fat (or foam) of the sea", an etymology discarded for grammatical considerations (constituent order in Quechua) at least since Inca Garcilaso.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian orang menyatakan Wiraqucha dapat berarti "lemak (atau busa) laut", tetapi etimologi ini ditinggalkan karena pertimbangan tata bahasa (urutan unsur dalam bahasa Quechua) setidaknya sejak Inca Garcilaso.
claims.quote: Some people state that Wiraqucha could mean "Fat (or foam) of the sea", etymology that has been discarded for grammatical considerations (constituent order in Quechua) at least since Inca Garcilaso.

claims.statement: Viracocha created the universe, sun, moon and stars, time (by commanding the sun to move over the sky) and civilization itself, and was worshipped as god of the sun and of storms.
claims.statement_id: Viracocha menciptakan alam semesta, matahari, bulan, bintang, waktu (dengan memerintahkan matahari bergerak di langit), dan peradaban itu sendiri, serta dipuja sebagai dewa matahari dan badai.
claims.quote: Viracocha created the universe, sun, moon, and stars, time (by commanding the sun to move over the sky) and civilization itself. Viracocha was worshipped as god of the sun and of storms.

claims.statement: Viracocha was the most important deity in the Inca pantheon, seen as the creator of all things or the substance from which all things are created, and intimately associated with the sea.
claims.statement_id: Viracocha adalah dewa terpenting dalam jajaran dewa Inca, dipandang sebagai pencipta segala sesuatu atau bahan dari mana segala sesuatu diciptakan, dan sangat lekat dengan laut.
claims.quote: Viracocha was the most important deity in the Inca pantheon and seen as the creator of all things, or the substance from which all things are created, and intimately associated with the sea.

claims.statement: According to a myth recorded by Juan de Betanzos, Viracocha rose from Lake Titicaca (or sometimes the cave of Paqariq Tampu) during the time of darkness to bring forth light.
claims.statement_id: Menurut mitos yang dicatat Juan de Betanzos, Viracocha bangkit dari Danau Titicaca (atau kadang gua Paqariq Tampu) pada masa kegelapan untuk memunculkan cahaya.
claims.quote: According to a myth recorded by Juan de Betanzos, Viracocha rose from Lake Titicaca (or sometimes the cave of Paqariq Tampu) during the time of darkness to bring forth light.

claims.statement: In that account he made mankind by breathing into stones; his first creation was brainless giants that displeased him, so he destroyed them with a flood and made better humans from smaller stones.
claims.statement_id: Dalam catatan itu, ia membuat manusia dengan menghembuskan napas ke batu; ciptaan pertamanya adalah raksasa tak berotak yang tidak menyenangkannya, sehingga ia memusnahkan mereka dengan banjir dan membuat manusia yang lebih baik dari batu yang lebih kecil.
claims.quote: He made mankind by breathing into stones, but his first creation were brainless giants that displeased him. So, he destroyed them with a flood and made humans, beings who were better than the giants, from smaller stones.

claims.statement: In one legend he had one son, Inti, and two daughters, Mama Killa and Pachamama.
claims.statement_id: Dalam satu legenda, ia memiliki satu putra, Inti, dan dua putri, Mama Killa dan Pachamama.
claims.quote: In one legend he had one son, Inti, and two daughters, Mama Killa and Pachamama.

claims.statement: In that legend he destroyed the people around Lake Titicaca with a Great Flood called Unu Pachakuti, lasting 60 days and 60 nights, saving two to bring civilization to the rest of the world.
claims.statement_id: Dalam legenda itu, ia memusnahkan orang-orang di sekitar Danau Titicaca dengan Banjir Besar bernama Unu Pachakuti selama 60 hari 60 malam, dan menyelamatkan dua orang untuk membawa peradaban ke seluruh dunia.
claims.quote: In this legend, he destroyed the people around Lake Titicaca with a Great Flood called Unu Pachakuti, lasting 60 days and 60 nights, saving two to bring civilization to the rest of the world.

claims.statement: The whiteness of Viracocha is not mentioned in the native authentic legends of the Incas, and most modern scholars therefore considered the "white god" story a post-conquest Spanish invention.
claims.statement_id: Warna kulit putih Viracocha tidak disebut dalam legenda asli bangsa Inca, sehingga sebagian besar sarjana modern menganggap kisah "dewa putih" sebagai rekaan Spanyol pascapenaklukan.
claims.quote: The whiteness of Viracocha is however not mentioned in the native authentic legends of the Incas and most modern scholars therefore had considered the "white god" story to be a post-conquest Spanish invention.

claims.statement: The Colombian myth of Bochica has a similar role as creator and civilizer as Viracocha.
claims.statement_id: Mitos Kolombia tentang Bochica memiliki peran serupa sebagai pencipta dan pembawa peradaban seperti Viracocha.
claims.quote: The Colombian myth of Bochica who has a similar role as creator and civilizer as Viracocha

claims.statement: The god's name was also assumed by the king known as Viracocha Inca (died 1438 CE), and this may also be the time when the god was formally added to the family of Inca gods.
claims.statement_id: Nama sang dewa juga dipakai oleh raja yang dikenal sebagai Viracocha Inca (wafat 1438 M), dan mungkin saat itulah sang dewa secara resmi ditambahkan ke keluarga dewa Inca.
claims.quote: The god's name was also assumed by the king known as Viracocha Inca (died 1438 CE) and this may also be the time when the god was formally added to the family of Inca gods.

claims.statement: The god was not always well received despite the knowledge he imparted, sometimes even suffering stones thrown at him.
claims.statement_id: Sang dewa tidak selalu disambut baik meskipun pengetahuan yang diberikannya, bahkan kadang dilempari batu.
claims.quote: The god was not always well received despite the knowledge he imparted, sometimes even suffering stones thrown at him.

claims.statement: Pachamama or Mama Pacha is the Andean deity representing space-time, revered by the peoples of the Andes.
claims.statement_id: Pachamama atau Mama Pacha adalah dewa Andes yang mewakili ruang-waktu dan dipuja oleh bangsa-bangsa Andes.
claims.quote: or Mama Pacha ... is the Andean deity representing space-time, revered by the peoples of the Andes.

claims.statement: The four cosmological Quechua principles claim Pachamama as their origin.
claims.statement_id: Empat prinsip kosmologi Quechua—Air, Bumi, Matahari, dan Bulan—berasal dari Pachamama.
claims.quote: The four cosmological Quechua principles—Water, Earth, Sun, and Moon—claim Pachamama as their prime origin.

claims.statement: She is considered an omnipresent deity with creative power, capable of sustaining life in the cosmos.
claims.statement_id: Ia dianggap dewa yang hadir di mana-mana dan memiliki daya cipta untuk menopang kehidupan di kosmos.
claims.quote: She is considered an omnipresent deity with creative power, capable of sustaining life in the cosmos.

claims.statement: In Inca mythology and religion, she is a "mother goddess" type deity representing the universal energy that connects everything, linked to space, time, the universe, totality, life, fertility and nature.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi dan agama Inca, ia adalah dewa bertipe "dewi ibu" yang mewakili energi universal yang menghubungkan segalanya, terkait ruang, waktu, alam semesta, totalitas, kehidupan, kesuburan, dan alam.
claims.quote: In Inca mythology and religion, she is a "mother goddess" type deity, representing the universal energy that connects everything, linked to space, time, the universe, totality, life, fertility, and nature.

claims.statement: She is attributed with the role of mother of the world, from whom the material and spiritual sustenance of human beings comes.
claims.statement_id: Ia dianggap berperan sebagai ibu dunia, tempat asal sumber penghidupan material dan spiritual manusia.
claims.quote: She is attributed with the role of mother of the world, from whom the material and spiritual sustenance of human beings comes.

claims.statement: In various myths, Pachamama is described as the wife of Pachacámac and mother of Mama Quilla (the goddess of the moon) and Inti (the god of the sun).
claims.statement_id: Dalam berbagai mitos, Pachamama digambarkan sebagai istri Pachacámac dan ibu Mama Quilla (dewi bulan) dan Inti (dewa matahari).
claims.quote: In various myths, Pachamama is described as the wife of Pachacámac and mother of Mama Quilla (the goddess of the moon) and Inti (the god of the sun).

claims.statement: Pachamama was commonly worshipped in her earthly form called Allpamama or Mama Allpa (goddess of the earth); her shrines were sacred rocks or the trunks of legendary trees, and artists depicted her as a woman bearing harvests of potatoes or coca leaves.
claims.statement_id: Pachamama umum dipuja dalam wujud duniawinya yang disebut Allpamama atau Mama Allpa (dewi bumi); kuilnya berupa batu keramat atau batang pohon legendaris, dan seniman menggambarkannya sebagai perempuan pembawa hasil panen kentang atau daun koka.
claims.quote: Pachamama was commonly worshipped in her earthly manifestation or form called Allpamama or Mama Allpa (goddess of the earth), her shrines consisted of sacred rocks or the trunks of legendary trees, and artists depicted her as a woman bearing harvests of potatoes or coca leaves.

claims.statement: Priests sacrifice offerings of llamas, cuy (guinea pigs) and elaborate miniature burned garments to her.
claims.statement_id: Para imam mempersembahkan llama, cuy (marmut), dan pakaian mini yang rumit yang dibakar kepadanya.
claims.quote: Priests sacrifice offerings of llamas, cuy (guinea pigs), and elaborate, miniature, burned garments to her.

claims.statement: She is normally a loving and generous goddess, but she can be terrible, cruel and destructive when upset or hurt, capable of destroying men and everything above or within her.
claims.statement_id: Ia biasanya dewi yang penuh kasih dan murah hati, tetapi bisa mengerikan, kejam, dan merusak ketika marah atau merasa terluka, mampu menghancurkan manusia dan segala yang ada di atas atau di dalamnya.
claims.quote: She is normally a loving and generous goddess, but she can be terrible, cruel, and destructive when she is upset or feels hurt, capable of destroying men and everything above or within her.

claims.statement: Pachamama is an ancient and primordial goddess who does not need temples or specific places of worship, although she likes springs, simply because she is everywhere and at all times.
claims.statement_id: Pachamama adalah dewi purba dan primordial yang tidak membutuhkan kuil atau tempat ibadah khusus, meskipun ia menyukai mata air, karena ia ada di mana-mana dan sepanjang waktu.
claims.quote: Pachamama is an ancient and primordial goddess who does not need temples or specific places of worship, although she likes springs, simply because she is everywhere and at all times.

claims.statement: The word Pachamama comes from the Quechua language and has two parts; the first, pacha, is a complex word meaning 'world, universe, space-time, totality, era, cosmos'.
claims.statement_id: Kata Pachamama berasal dari bahasa Quechua dan terdiri atas dua unsur; yang pertama, pacha, adalah kata kompleks yang berarti 'dunia, alam semesta, ruang-waktu, totalitas, zaman, kosmos'.
claims.quote: The word Pachamama comes from the Quechua language and is composed of two terms: Pacha: a complex word meaning 'world, universe, space-time, totality, era, cosmos'.

claims.statement: The second part, mama, means mother, but also represents the feminine principle that generates and nourishes life.
claims.statement_id: Unsur kedua, mama, berarti ibu, tetapi juga mewakili prinsip feminin yang melahirkan dan memelihara kehidupan.
claims.quote: Mama: means mother, but also represents the feminine principle that generates and nourishes life.

claims.statement: Pachamama plays the role of cosmic mother; from her fertility the cosmos is born, the earth is fertilized, and it then flourishes.
claims.statement_id: Pachamama berperan sebagai ibu kosmik; dari kesuburannya kosmos lahir, bumi disuburkan, dan kemudian berkembang.
claims.quote: Pachamama plays the role of cosmic mother; from Pachamama's fertility, the cosmos is born, the earth is fertilized, and then it flourishes.

claims.statement: Allpamama is often hungry, and if she is not nourished with offerings or is offended, she can cause a cosmic imbalance that breaks the universal harmony affecting all worlds.
claims.statement_id: Allpamama sering lapar, dan bila tidak diberi persembahan atau tersinggung, ia dapat menimbulkan ketidakseimbangan kosmik yang merusak keharmonisan semesta yang memengaruhi semua dunia.
claims.quote: Allpamama is often hungry, and if she is not nourished with offerings or if she is offended, she can cause a cosmic imbalance that breaks the universal harmony affecting all worlds

claims.statement: Pachamama and her sun-husband Inti are worshipped as benevolent deities in the area known as Tawantinsuyu, the former Inca Empire, stretching through the Andean mountains in present-day Bolivia, Ecuador, Chile, Peru, Colombia and northern Argentina.
claims.statement_id: Pachamama dan suaminya, sang matahari Inti, dipuja sebagai dewa-dewi yang murah hati di wilayah yang dikenal sebagai Tawantinsuyu, bekas Kekaisaran Inca yang membentang melintasi pegunungan Andes di Bolivia, Ekuador, Chile, Peru, Kolombia, dan Argentina utara masa kini.
claims.quote: Pachamama and her sun-husband, Inti, are worshipped as benevolent deities in the area known as Tawantinsuyu. Tawantinsuyu is the name of the former Inca Empire, and the region stretches through the Andean mountains in present-day Bolivia, Ecuador, Chile, Peru, Colombia and northern Argentina.

claims.statement: In some regions people perform a special libation known as a challa on a daily basis: they spill a little chicha on the floor for the goddess and then drink the rest.
claims.statement_id: Di beberapa daerah, orang melakukan persembahan cairan khusus bernama challa setiap hari: mereka menumpahkan sedikit chicha ke tanah untuk sang dewi, lalu meminum sisanya.
claims.quote: In some regions, people perform a special kind of libation known as a challa on a daily basis. They spill a small amount of chicha on the floor, for the goddess, and then drink the rest.

claims.statement: The central ritual to Pachamama is the Challa or Pago (payment), carried out during all of August and in many places also on the first Friday of each month.
claims.statement_id: Ritual utama bagi Pachamama adalah Challa atau Pago (pembayaran), yang dilakukan sepanjang bulan Agustus dan di banyak tempat juga pada Jumat pertama setiap bulan.
claims.quote: The central ritual to Pachamama is the Challa or Pago (payment). It is carried out during all of August, and in many places also on the first Friday of each month.

claims.statement: Through religious syncretism, the figure of the Virgin Mary was associated with that of Pachamama for many Indigenous peoples.
claims.statement_id: Melalui sinkretisme agama, sosok Perawan Maria dikaitkan dengan Pachamama oleh banyak masyarakat adat.
claims.quote: Through religious syncretism, the figure of the Virgin Mary was associated with that of Pachamama for many Indigenous peoples.

claims.statement: In the 21st century, many Indigenous peoples in South America base environmental concerns on these ancient beliefs, saying that problems arise when people take too much from nature because they are taking too much from Pachamama.
claims.statement_id: Pada abad ke-21, banyak masyarakat adat di Amerika Selatan mendasarkan kepedulian lingkungan pada kepercayaan kuno ini, dengan mengatakan bahwa masalah muncul ketika manusia mengambil terlalu banyak dari alam karena berarti mengambil terlalu banyak dari Pachamama.
claims.quote: In the 21st century, many Indigenous peoples in South America base environmental concerns in these ancient beliefs, saying that problems arise when people take too much from nature because they are taking too much from Pachamama.

claims.statement: The article infobox lists Viracocha as parent, Pacha Kamaq and Inti as consorts, and Inti and Mama Killa as offspring of Pachamama.
claims.statement_id: Kotak info Wikipedia mencantumkan Viracocha sebagai orang tua, Pacha Kamaq dan Inti sebagai pasangan, serta Inti dan Mama Killa sebagai keturunan Pachamama.
claims.quote: Parents Viracocha Consort Pacha Kamaq, Inti Offspring Inti Mama Killa

claims.statement: The Peru program at the 2015 Folklife Festival takes its name from Pachamama, which means "Mother Earth" in the native Quechua and Aymara languages.
claims.statement_id: Program Peru pada Festival Folklife 2015 memakai nama Pachamama, yang dalam bahasa asli Quechua dan Aymara berarti "Ibu Bumi".
claims.quote: The Peru program at the 2015 Folklife Festival takes its name from the Pachamama, translating to "Mother Earth" in the native Quechua and Aymara languages

claims.statement: Rufino Turpo describes the life-sustaining role of Pachamama: mother of all living beings, the core of existence, the symbol of fertility.
claims.statement_id: Rufino Turpo menguraikan peran Pachamama yang menopang kehidupan: ibu semua makhluk hidup, inti keberadaan, dan lambang kesuburan.
claims.quote: In this story, Rufino Turpo (son of the late Nazario Turpo, guardian and Pacco ritual master of the sacred Ausangate Mountain) shares the life-sustaining role of Pachamama: mother of all living beings, the core of existence, the symbol of fertility.

claims.statement: On the first day of Chajrayapuy (August) the family gathers to make a "payment" or offering to Pachamama; like people, she needs to eat and drink, and whenever chicha, beer or wine is drunk it must be shared with her.
claims.statement_id: Pada hari pertama Chajrayapuy (Agustus), keluarga berkumpul untuk membuat "pembayaran" atau persembahan kepada Pachamama; seperti manusia, ia perlu makan dan minum, dan setiap kali minum chicha, bir, atau anggur, minuman itu harus dibagikan kepadanya.
claims.quote: On the first day of Chajrayapuy (August), our family gathers to make a "payment" or offering to the Pachamama. Like us, she needs to eat and drink. Whenever we drink chicha, beer, or wine, we need to share it with her.

claims.statement: All this is offered for Pachamama to eat, and in return she provides for the people and protects them; the offering is then burned and the smoke carries the prayers.
claims.statement_id: Semua persembahan itu diberikan agar Pachamama makan, dan sebagai balasannya ia menyediakan kebutuhan dan melindungi; persembahan lalu dibakar dan asapnya membawa doa.
claims.quote: We offer all this for Pachamama to eat, and in return she provides for us and protects us. Finally, we burn the offering. Smoke rises, taking our prayers.

claims.statement: The Mother gets angry when you want to pay without respect, without knowing why.
claims.statement_id: Sang Ibu marah bila orang membayar tanpa hormat dan tanpa tahu alasannya.
claims.quote: The Mother gets angry when you want to pay without respect, without knowing why.

claims.statement: This journal article analyzes the cult of Andean Mother Earth known as Pachamama, starting from references in Peruvian chronicles of the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries.
claims.statement_id: Artikel jurnal ini menganalisis kultus Ibu Bumi Andes yang dikenal sebagai Pachamama berdasarkan rujukan dalam kronik Peru abad keenam belas dan ketujuh belas.
claims.quote: This article analyzes the cult to Andean Mother Earth known as Pachamama, starting from the references contained in those Peruvian chronicles of the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries

claims.statement: The chronicles give distinctive details about terminology, representations, beliefs and rituals of the telluric cults of the Prehispanic period, and their persistence through the first decades of colonization of the central Andes.
claims.statement_id: Kronik-kronik itu memberi rincian khas tentang istilah, penggambaran, kepercayaan, dan ritual kultus bumi pada masa pra-Hispanik, serta kelangsungannya selama beberapa dekade pertama kolonisasi Andes tengah.
claims.quote: We emphasize, in particular, the peculiarity of the details that they provide about terminology, representations, beliefs and rituals associated with telluric cults in the Prehispanic period, and their persistence throughout the first decades of colonization of the central Andes.

claims.statement: Although most consider Inti the sun god, he is viewed as a cluster of solar aspects.
claims.statement_id: Inti dipandang sebagai dewa matahari sekaligus klaster aspek surya.
claims.quote: Although most consider Inti the sun god, he is more appropriately viewed as a cluster of solar aspects, since the Inca divided his identity according to the stages of the sun.

claims.statement: The most common belief was that Inti was born of Viracocha.
claims.statement_id: Keyakinan umum menyatakan bahwa Inti dilahirkan oleh Viracocha.
claims.quote: The most common belief was that Inti was born of Viracocha, who had many titles, chief among them being the God of Creation.

claims.statement: Worshiped as a patron deity of the Inca Empire, Pachacuti is linked to his cult.
claims.statement_id: Dipuja sebagai dewa pelindung kekaisaran, pemujaannya dikaitkan dengan Pachacuti.
claims.quote: Worshiped as a patron deity of the Inca Empire, Pachacuti is often linked to the origin and expansion of the Inca Sun Cult.

claims.statement: Inti and his sister, Mama Quilla, were generally considered benevolent deities.
claims.statement_id: Inti dan saudarinya Mama Quilla umumnya dianggap sebagai dewa yang murah hati.
claims.quote: Inti and his sister, Mama Quilla (also spelled Mama Killa), the Moon goddess were generally considered benevolent deities.

claims.statement: Inti was the Inca god of the sun, considered all-powerful, but also a benevolent god capable of great generosity.
claims.statement_id: Inti adalah dewa matahari Inca yang dianggap mahakuasa, tetapi juga dewa yang murah hati dan mampu bersikap sangat dermawan.
claims.quote: Inti was the Inca god of the sun and considered all-powerful but he was also a benevolent god and capable of great generosity.

claims.statement: Inti could be angered and showed his displeasure through solar eclipses, which called for sacrifices to win back the god's good favour.
claims.statement_id: Inti dapat murka dan menunjukkan ketidaksenangannya lewat gerhana matahari, yang menuntut persembahan untuk memulihkan kembali kemurahan sang dewa.
claims.quote: However, Inti could be angered and he would demonstrate his displeasure through solar eclipses which necessitated sacrifices to win back the god's good favour.

claims.statement: Inca rulers considered themselves direct descendants of Inti, the patron of empire and military conquest.
claims.statement_id: Para penguasa Inca menganggap diri keturunan langsung Inti, pelindung kekaisaran dan penaklukan militer.
claims.quote: Inca rulers considered themselves direct descendants of Inti, the patron of empire and military conquest.

claims.statement: Inti was the sun, which in Inca mythology was created by the supreme Inca deity Viracocha from an island on Lake Titicaca.
claims.statement_id: Inti adalah matahari, yang dalam mitologi Inca diciptakan oleh dewa tertinggi Inca, Viracocha, dari sebuah pulau di Danau Titicaca.
claims.quote: Inti was the sun, which in Inca mythology was created by the supreme Inca deity Viracocha from an island on Lake Titicaca.

claims.statement: Although Viracocha was higher in status, he usually remained in the background of worldly affairs and let intermediaries such as Inti actually govern the world.
claims.statement_id: Meski Viracocha berkedudukan lebih tinggi, ia biasanya tinggal di latar belakang urusan duniawi dan membiarkan perantara seperti Inti benar-benar memerintah dunia.
claims.quote: Although Viracocha was higher in status, he usually remained in the background of worldly affairs and allowed intermediaries such as Inti to actually govern the world.

claims.statement: Inti was married to the goddess of the moon Quilla.
claims.statement_id: Inti menikah dengan Quilla, dewi bulan.
claims.quote: Inti was married to the goddess of the moon Quilla.

claims.statement: Manco Capac (previously called Ayar Manco) was believed either to have been instructed by Inti or to have actually been his son.
claims.statement_id: Manco Capac (sebelumnya bernama Ayar Manco) dipercaya diajari oleh Inti atau malah putranya.
claims.quote: Manco Capac (previously called Ayar Manco) was believed either to have been instructed by Inti or actually been his son

claims.statement: The cult of Inti only became really established in Inca cultural practices under Wiraqocha Inca (c. 1425 CE) or the 9th Inca ruler Pachacuti Inca Yupanqui (1438-1471 CE).
claims.statement_id: Kultus Inti baru benar-benar mapan dalam praktik budaya Inca pada masa Wiraqocha Inca (sekitar 1425 M) atau penguasa Inca ke-9, Pachacuti Inca Yupanqui (1438-1471 M).
claims.quote: it was not until Wiraqocha Inca (c. 1425 CE) or the 9th Inca ruler Pachacuti Inca Yupanqui (1438-1471 CE) that the cult of Inti really became established in the cultural practices of the Inca.

claims.statement: The Coricancha temple ('House of the Sun') and the Sacsahuaman sacred precinct at the Inca capital Cuzco were dedicated to Inti.
claims.statement_id: Kuil Coricancha ('Rumah Matahari') dan kawasan suci Sacsahuaman di ibu kota Inca, Cuzco, dipersembahkan kepada Inti.
claims.quote: The Coricancha temple ('House of the Sun') and Sacsahuaman sacred precinct at the Inca capital of Cuzco were dedicated to Inti.

claims.statement: Perhaps the most famous example is at Machu Picchu, where an intihuatana or 'hitching post of the sun' at the highest point of the sacred precinct was used during the solstices to connect the sun symbolically to the earth with a special cord.
claims.statement_id: Contoh paling terkenal ada di Machu Picchu, tempat intihuatana atau 'tiang penambat matahari' di titik tertinggi kawasan suci dipakai pada titik balik matahari untuk menghubungkan matahari dengan bumi secara simbolis memakai tali khusus.
claims.quote: Perhaps the most famous example is at Machu Picchu where a typical intihuatana or 'hitching post of the sun' situated at the highest point of the sacred precinct was used during the solstices to symbolically connect the sun to the earth using a special cord.

claims.statement: Inti was especially worshipped during the Inti Raymi festival, held at the winter solstice in June over several days; one of the most common sacrifices was white llamas.
claims.statement_id: Inti terutama dipuja pada festival Inti Raymi yang digelar pada titik balik matahari musim dingin bulan Juni selama beberapa hari; salah satu persembahan paling umum adalah llama putih.
claims.quote: Inti was especially worshipped during the festival of Inti Raymi held during the winter solstice in June and run over several days. One of the most common sacrifices to Inti was of white llamas

claims.statement: Inti was not often represented in Inca art, and when he was it was usually as a gold statue, a sun disk or a golden mask; gold was associated with the god because it was believed to be the sweat of the sun.
claims.statement_id: Inti jarang digambarkan dalam seni Inca, dan bila digambarkan biasanya sebagai patung emas, cakram matahari, atau topeng emas; emas dikaitkan dengan sang dewa karena dipercaya sebagai keringat matahari.
claims.quote: Inti was not often represented in Inca art but when he was it was usually as a gold statue, a sun disk or a golden mask. Gold was particularly associated with the god as it was believed that the precious metal was the sweat of the sun.

claims.statement: The statue represented Inti as a small seated boy, called Punchao (Day or Midday Sun).
claims.statement_id: Patung itu menggambarkan Inti sebagai anak kecil yang duduk, bernama Punchao (Matahari Siang atau Tengah Hari).
claims.quote: The statue represented Inti as a small seated boy, called Punchao (Day or Midday Sun).

claims.statement: In one story an eagle was attacked by buzzards and fell from the skies during a ceremony in honour of Inti in c. 1526 CE, which was thought to foretell the collapse of the Inca empire.
claims.statement_id: Dalam satu kisah, seekor elang diserang burung nasar kecil dan jatuh dari langit saat upacara untuk Inti sekitar 1526 M, yang dianggap meramalkan runtuhnya Kekaisaran Inca.
claims.quote: One curious story is when an eagle was attacked by buzzards and fell from the skies during a ceremony in honour of Inti held in c. 1526 CE which was thought to foretell the collapse of the Inca empire.

claims.statement: The god's worshippers and most of the art made in his name have long since disappeared, but Inti lives on in several present-day South American cultures.
claims.statement_id: Para pemuja sang dewa dan sebagian besar seni yang dibuat atas namanya telah lama lenyap, tetapi Inti masih hidup dalam beberapa budaya Amerika Selatan masa kini.
claims.quote: The god's worshippers and the vast majority of the art made in his name have long since disappeared but Inti lives on in several present day South American cultures.

claims.statement: The Inti Raymi festival has been revived as a great yearly festival in Cuzco, and several national flags bear an image of him as a flaming sun.
claims.statement_id: Festival Inti Raymi dihidupkan kembali sebagai festival tahunan besar di Cuzco, dan beberapa bendera nasional memuat gambarnya berupa matahari yang menyala.
claims.quote: The festival of Inti Raymi has been revived as a great yearly festival in Cuzco, several national flags bear an image of him in the form of a flaming sun

claims.statement: Other important temples were at Pisac, Ingapirca (in modern Ecuador) and on the Island of the Sun on Lake Titicaca, which Inca rulers visited once a year in pilgrimage.
claims.statement_id: Kuil penting lain berada di Pisac, Ingapirca (di Ekuador masa kini), dan di Pulau Matahari di Danau Titicaca, yang dikunjungi para penguasa Inca setahun sekali dalam ziarah.
claims.quote: Other important temples were at Pisac (north-east of Cuzco), Ingapirca (in modern Ecuador), and on the Island of the Sun on Lake Titicaca which Inca rulers visited once a year in pilgrimage.

claims.statement: Inti (Quechua: inti, literally 'sun') is the ancient Inca sun god, revered as the national patron of the Inca state.
claims.statement_id: Inti (Quechua: inti, secara harfiah 'matahari') adalah dewa matahari Inca kuno, dimuliakan sebagai pelindung nasional negara Inca.
claims.quote: Inti (Quechua: inti, lit. 'sun' ) is the ancient Inca sun god. He is revered as the national patron of the Inca state.

claims.statement: The word inti is not of Quechua origin but a loanword from Puquina.
claims.statement_id: Kata inti bukan berasal dari bahasa Quechua, melainkan kata serapan dari bahasa Puquina.
claims.quote: The word inti is not of Quechua origin but a loanword from Puquina.

claims.statement: According to myth, Inti taught Manco Cápac and his daughter Mama Ocllo the arts of civilization.
claims.statement_id: Menurut mitos, Inti mengajarkan seni peradaban kepada Manco Cápac dan putrinya, Mama Ocllo.
claims.quote: According to myth, Inti taught Manco Cápac and his daughter Mama Ocllo the arts of civilization.

claims.statement: The sun was important to the Incas, particularly highland people, because it was necessary for producing maize and other grains; the sun's heat was also thought to cause rain.
claims.statement_id: Matahari penting bagi bangsa Inca, terutama penduduk dataran tinggi, karena diperlukan untuk menghasilkan jagung dan biji-bijian lain; panas matahari juga dianggap menyebabkan hujan.
claims.quote: The sun was also important to the Incas, particularly the people of the highlands, because it was necessary for the production of crops like maize and other grains. The sun's heat was also thought to cause rain.

claims.statement: Inti's identity is also divided into three primary subcomplexes: the father, the son and the brother.
claims.statement_id: Identitas Inti juga dibagi menjadi tiga subkompleks utama, yaitu ayah, putra, dan saudara.
claims.quote: Inti's identity is also divided into three primary subcomplexes, which are the father, son, and brother.

claims.statement: The three are Apu Inti ("supreme Inti"), Churi Inti ("Son Inti", often known as "Daylight") and Inti Wawqi ("Sun brother").
claims.statement_id: Ketiganya adalah Apu Inti ("Inti tertinggi"), Churi Inti ("Inti putra", sering disebut "Cahaya Siang"), dan Inti Wawqi ("saudara matahari").
claims.quote: The first of these is Apu Inti ("supreme Inti"). He represents the father and is sometimes known as "The Lord Sun". The second is Churi Inti, or "Son Inti", who represents the son of Inti and is often known as "Daylight". The third and final division of Inti is Inti Wawqi ("Sun brother", or "Inti brother", also spelled Inti-Guauqui, Inti-Huaoqui).

claims.statement: Some sources identify the central figure of the Gateway of the Sun as Inti and others as Viracocha.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian sumber mengidentifikasi tokoh utama pada Gerbang Matahari sebagai Inti dan sebagian lain sebagai Viracocha.
claims.quote: Some sources identify the central figure of the Gateway of the Sun as Inti and others as Viracocha

claims.statement: The Sun is also depicted on the coats of arms of Bolivia and Ecuador and the historical flag of Peru; all these countries (including northern Chile and parts of Argentina) were historically part of the Inca Empire.
claims.statement_id: Matahari juga digambarkan pada lambang negara Bolivia dan Ekuador serta bendera historis Peru; semua negara itu (termasuk Chile utara dan bagian Argentina) dahulu bagian dari Kekaisaran Inca.
claims.quote: The Sun is also depicted on the coat of arms of Bolivia and coat of arms of Ecuador, the Flag of the Hispanic people, as well as the historical flag of Peru. All these countries (including the North region of Chile, Northeast and parts of Cuyo (Argentina)) were historically part of the Inca Empire.

claims.statement: The Inca ruler was considered to be the living representative of Inti.
claims.statement_id: Penguasa Inca dianggap perwakilan hidup Inti.
claims.quote: The Inca ruler was considered to be the living representative of Inti.

claims.statement: Spanish conquistadors captured a great golden disk representing Inti in 1571.
claims.statement_id: Para penakluk Spanyol merebut sebuah cakram emas besar yang melambangkan Inti pada 1571.
claims.quote: Spanish conquistadors captured a great golden disk representing Inti in 1571

claims.statement: Despite its name, original sightings of the creature described avian, not lepidopteran, features.
claims.statement_id: Meskipun dinamai Mothman, penampakan awal makhluk ini menggambarkan ciri burung dan bukan serangga.
claims.quote: Despite its name, the original sightings of the creature described avian, not lepidopteran, features.

claims.statement: The national press soon picked up the reports and helped spread the story across the United States.
claims.statement_id: Pers nasional segera mengangkat laporan itu dan membantu menyebarkan kisahnya ke seluruh Amerika Serikat.
claims.quote: The national press soon picked up the reports and helped spread the story across the United States.

claims.statement: The creature was popularized by John Keel in his book The Mothman Prophecies connecting it to the collapse of the Silver Bridge.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini dipopulerkan oleh John Keel dalam bukunya The Mothman Prophecies yang mengaitkannya dengan runtuhnya Silver Bridge.
claims.quote: The creature was later popularized by John Keel in his 1975 book The Mothman Prophecies, which claimed that there were paranormal events related to the sightings and a connection to the collapse of the Silver Bridge.

claims.statement: An annual festival in Point Pleasant is devoted to the Mothman legend.
claims.statement_id: Festival tahunan di Point Pleasant didedikasikan untuk legenda Mothman.
claims.quote: An annual festival in Point Pleasant is devoted to the Mothman legend.

claims.statement: In American folklore, Mothman is the name given to a humanoid cryptid reportedly seen around Point Pleasant, West Virginia, from November 15, 1966 to December 15, 1967.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Amerika, Mothman adalah nama untuk kriptid humanoid yang konon terlihat di sekitar Point Pleasant, West Virginia, dari 15 November 1966 hingga 15 Desember 1967.
claims.quote: In American folklore, Mothman is the name given to a humanoid cryptid that was reportedly seen around Point Pleasant, West Virginia, from November 15, 1966, to December 15, 1967.

claims.statement: The first newspaper report appeared in the Point Pleasant Register, dated November 16, 1966, titled "Couples See Man-Sized Bird ... Creature ... Something".
claims.statement_id: Laporan surat kabar pertama terbit di Point Pleasant Register tertanggal 16 November 1966 dengan judul "Couples See Man-Sized Bird ... Creature ... Something".
claims.quote: The first newspaper report was published in the Point Pleasant Register, dated November 16, 1966, titled "Couples See Man-Sized Bird ... Creature ... Something".

claims.statement: On November 15, 1966, two young couples from Point Pleasant, Roger and Linda Scarberry and Steve and Mary Mallette, told police they had seen a large black creature whose eyes "glowed red" at the side of the road near "the TNT area", the site of a former World War II munitions plant.
claims.statement_id: Pada 15 November 1966, dua pasangan muda dari Point Pleasant, Roger dan Linda Scarberry serta Steve dan Mary Mallette, memberi tahu polisi bahwa mereka melihat makhluk hitam besar bermata "menyala merah" di tepi jalan dekat "area TNT", bekas pabrik amunisi Perang Dunia II.
claims.quote: On November 15, 1966, two young couples from Point Pleasant-Roger and Linda Scarberry, Steve and Mary Mallette-told police they had seen a large black creature whose eyes "glowed red", standing at the side of the road near "the TNT area", the site of a former munitions plant from World War II.

claims.statement: Linda Scarberry described it as a "slender, muscular man" about seven feet tall with white wings, but she could not make out its face because of the hypnotic effect of its eyes.
claims.statement_id: Linda Scarberry menggambarkannya sebagai "lelaki langsing berotot" setinggi sekitar tujuh kaki dengan sayap putih, tetapi ia tidak dapat melihat wajahnya karena efek hipnotis dari matanya.
claims.quote: Linda Scarberry described it as a "slender, muscular man" about seven feet (2.1 m) tall with white wings. However, she was unable to discern its face due to the hypnotic effect of its eyes.

claims.statement: The witnesses claimed they sped away at 100 miles per hour, reporting that the creature took flight and kept pace with their car, making a screeching sound during the pursuit.
claims.statement_id: Para saksi mengaku melaju kabur dengan kecepatan 100 mil per jam, dan melaporkan bahwa makhluk itu terbang dan mengimbangi mobil mereka sambil mengeluarkan suara melengking selama pengejaran.
claims.quote: Distressed, the witnesses claimed they sped away at 100 miles per hour (160 km/h), reporting that the creature took flight and kept pace with their car, making a screeching sound during the pursuit.

claims.statement: Newell Partridge said that when he aimed a flashlight at a creature in a nearby field, its eyes glowed "like bicycle reflectors".
claims.statement_id: Newell Partridge mengatakan bahwa ketika ia menyorotkan senter ke makhluk di ladang terdekat, matanya menyala "seperti reflektor sepeda".
claims.quote: Newell Partridge told Johnson that when he aimed a flashlight at a creature in a nearby field, its eyes glowed "like bicycle reflectors".

claims.statement: The source of the legend is believed to have originated from sightings of out-of-migration sandhill cranes or herons, or possibly the misidentification of barred owls.
claims.statement_id: Sumber legenda ini diyakini berasal dari penampakan bangau sandhill yang tersesat dari jalur migrasi atau bangau, atau mungkin salah identifikasi burung hantu barred.
claims.quote: The source of the legend is believed to have originated from sightings of out-of-migration sandhill cranes or herons, or possibly the misidentification of barred owls.

claims.statement: The comic book influence of Batman and the villain Killer Moth is believed to have influenced the coinage of the name "Mothman" in local newspapers.
claims.statement_id: Pengaruh komik Batman dan penjahat Killer Moth diyakini memengaruhi pemberian nama "Mothman" di surat kabar lokal.
claims.quote: While the villain Killer Moth did not appear in the show, the comic book influence of both him and Batman is believed to have influenced the coinage of the name "Mothman" in the local newspapers.

claims.statement: After the collapse of the Silver Bridge on December 15, 1967 and the deaths of 46 people, a legend arose connecting the Mothman sightings to the bridge collapse.
claims.statement_id: Setelah runtuhnya Silver Bridge pada 15 Desember 1967 yang menewaskan 46 orang, muncul legenda yang menghubungkan penampakan Mothman dengan runtuhnya jembatan itu.
claims.quote: Following the December 15, 1967, collapse of the Silver Bridge and the deaths of 46 people, the incident gave rise to a legend that connected the Mothman sightings to the bridge collapse.

claims.statement: More speculative hypotheses (such as those of ufologists, paranormal authors and cryptozoologists) suggest the Mothman could be an alien, a supernatural manifestation or a previously unknown species of animal.
claims.statement_id: Hipotesis yang lebih spekulatif (misalnya dari ufolog, penulis paranormal, dan kriptozoolog) menyebut Mothman bisa jadi alien, wujud supranatural, atau spesies hewan yang belum dikenal.
claims.quote: More speculative hypotheses (such as those proposed by ufologists, paranormal authors, and cryptozoologists) suggest the Mothman could be an alien, a supernatural manifestation, or a previously unknown species of animal.

claims.statement: Nickell attributes the Mothman stories to misidentifications of barred owls, suggesting the "glowing eyes" were actually eyeshine, a phenomenon common in many animals.
claims.statement_id: Nickell mengaitkan kisah Mothman dengan salah identifikasi burung hantu barred, dan menduga "mata menyala" Mothman sebenarnya fenomena pantulan cahaya mata (eyeshine) yang umum pada banyak hewan.
claims.quote: Nickell attributes the Mothman stories to misidentifications of barred owls, suggesting that the Mothman's "glowing eyes" were actually the phenomenon of eyeshine, common in many animals

claims.statement: Brunvand found elements in common between many Mothman reports and much older folktales, suggesting that something real may have triggered the scares and become interwoven with existing folklore.
claims.statement_id: Brunvand menemukan unsur yang sama antara banyak laporan Mothman dan dongeng yang jauh lebih tua, yang mengisyaratkan bahwa sesuatu yang nyata mungkin memicu kepanikan dan menyatu dengan cerita rakyat yang ada.
claims.quote: Brunvand found elements in common among many Mothman reports and much older folktales, suggesting that something real may have triggered the scares and become interwoven with existing folklore.

claims.statement: In his 1975 book Keel claimed Point Pleasant residents experienced precognitions, including premonitions of the collapse of the Silver Bridge, UFO sightings, visits from inhuman or threatening men in black, and other alleged phenomena.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bukunya tahun 1975, Keel mengklaim penduduk Point Pleasant mengalami prekognisi, termasuk firasat runtuhnya Silver Bridge, penampakan UFO, kunjungan pria tak manusiawi atau mengancam (men in black), dan fenomena lain yang diklaim.
claims.quote: In his 1975 book, Keel claimed that Point Pleasant residents experienced precognitions, including premonitions of the collapse of the Silver Bridge, UFO sightings, visits from inhuman or threatening men in black, and other alleged phenomena.

claims.statement: The Mothman legend has become a major source of tourism for Point Pleasant.
claims.statement_id: Legenda Mothman telah menjadi sumber utama pariwisata bagi Point Pleasant.
claims.quote: The Mothman legend has become a major source of tourism for Point Pleasant.

claims.statement: A 12-foot-tall metallic statue of the creature, by artist and sculptor Bob Roach, was unveiled in 2003, and the Mothman Museum and Research Center opened in 2006.
claims.statement_id: Patung logam setinggi 12 kaki karya seniman dan pematung Bob Roach diresmikan pada 2003, dan Mothman Museum and Research Center dibuka pada 2006.
claims.quote: A 12-foot-tall (3.7 m) metallic statue of the creature, created by artist and sculptor Bob Roach, was unveiled in 2003. The Mothman Museum and Research Center opened in 2006.

claims.statement: The city held its first Annual Mothman Festival in 2002.
claims.statement_id: Kota itu menyelenggarakan Festival Mothman tahunan yang pertama pada 2002.
claims.quote: The city held its first Annual Mothman Festival in 2002.

claims.statement: The Mothman Prophecies was adapted decades later into a 2002 film starring Richard Gere.
claims.statement_id: The Mothman Prophecies diadaptasi beberapa dekade kemudian menjadi film tahun 2002 yang dibintangi Richard Gere.
claims.quote: The Mothman Prophecies was adapted decades later into a 2002 film starring Richard Gere.

claims.statement: The 2018 video game Fallout 76 features the Mothman as a central figure.
claims.statement_id: Gim video Fallout 76 (2018) menampilkan Mothman sebagai tokoh sentral.
claims.quote: The 2018 video game Fallout 76 features the Mothman as a central figure

claims.statement: Small Town Monsters has released two documentaries about Mothman, The Mothman of Point Pleasant in 2017 and The Mothman Legacy in 2020.
claims.statement_id: Small Town Monsters merilis dua film dokumenter tentang Mothman: The Mothman of Point Pleasant (2017) dan The Mothman Legacy (2020).
claims.quote: Small Town Monsters has released two documentaries about Mothman, The Mothman of Point Pleasant in 2017 and The Mothman Legacy in 2020.

claims.statement: Mothman is one of several legendary West Virginia monsters, along with Bat Boy and the Flatwoods Monster; persistent sightings began in November 1966 and totalled 26 over a one-year span.
claims.statement_id: Mothman adalah salah satu dari beberapa monster legendaris West Virginia, bersama Bat Boy dan Flatwoods Monster; penampakan bertahan dimulai November 1966 dan berjumlah 26 dalam setahun.
claims.quote: Mothman is one of several legendary West Virginia monsters, along with Bat Boy and the Flatwoods Monster. Persistent sightings began in November 1966, and totaled 26 over a one-year span.

claims.statement: Reports of a large, winged creature with glowing red eyes were centered in the Point Pleasant area, usually in or near a vast abandoned munitions facility known as the TNT plant.
claims.statement_id: Laporan tentang makhluk bersayap besar bermata merah menyala terpusat di sekitar Point Pleasant, biasanya di dalam atau dekat fasilitas amunisi terbengkalai yang luas yang dikenal sebagai pabrik TNT.
claims.quote: The reports of a large, winged creature with glowing red eyes were centered in the Point Pleasant area, usually in or near a vast, abandoned munitions facility known as the TNT plant.

claims.statement: As sightings increased, so did reports of other strange phenomena; disruption of telephones, police dispatch radios, televisions and automobiles was rumored, along with numerous UFO reports.
claims.statement_id: Seiring bertambahnya penampakan, bertambah pula laporan fenomena aneh lain; gangguan pada telepon, radio polisi, televisi, dan mobil dikabarkan terjadi, serta banyak laporan kemunculan UFO.
claims.quote: As sightings increased, so did reports of other strange phenomena. Disruption of electronic devices such as telephones, police dispatch radios, and televisions, as well as automobiles, were rumored, and there were numerous reports of UFO appearances.

claims.statement: In one popular theory, the Mothman's advent and the subsequent Silver Bridge disaster were linked to a 200-year-old curse attributed to Shawnee Chief Cornstalk, who led his people at the Battle of Point Pleasant and was later murdered there.
claims.statement_id: Dalam satu teori populer, kedatangan Mothman dan bencana Silver Bridge berikutnya dikaitkan dengan kutukan berusia 200 tahun yang dikaitkan dengan Kepala Suku Shawnee Cornstalk, yang memimpin pasukan di Battle Point of Pleasant dan kemudian dibunuh di sana.
claims.quote: In one popular theory, the Mothman's advent and the subsequent Silver Bridge disaster were linked to a 200-year-old curse attributed to Shawnee Chief Cornstalk who led the Indians at the Battle Point of Pleasant and who later was murdered there.

claims.statement: Sightings of the Mothman diminished after the Silver Bridge collapse.
claims.statement_id: Penampakan Mothman menurun setelah runtuhnya Silver Bridge.
claims.quote: Sightings of the Mothman diminished after the Silver Bridge collapse.

claims.statement: From 2011 and as recently as 2020, a Mothman-like figure has been seen numerous times in the Chicago area.
claims.statement_id: Sejak 2011 hingga sedini 2020, sosok mirip Mothman dilaporkan terlihat berkali-kali di kawasan Chicago.
claims.quote: Beginning in 2011, and as recently as 2020, a Mothman-like figure has been seen numerous times in the Chicago area.

claims.statement: The young Breece D'J Pancake published a 1966 letter in the Huntington Herald Dispatch arguing that Mothman was in fact a California condor.
claims.statement_id: Breece D'J Pancake muda menerbitkan surat tahun 1966 di Huntington Herald Dispatch yang berargumen bahwa Mothman sebenarnya burung kondor California.
claims.quote: Young Breece D'J Pancake, before he became celebrated as a short story writer, published a 1966 letter in the Huntington Herald Dispatch arguing that Mothman was in fact a California condor.

claims.statement: The headlights glanced off something in the dark: a six-foot-tall, man-shaped thing with shining red eyes staring from a body without an obvious head or neck.
claims.statement_id: Lampu depan mobil menyorot sesuatu di kegelapan: benda berbentuk manusia setinggi enam kaki, dengan mata merah menyala yang menatap dari tubuh tanpa kepala atau leher yang jelas.
claims.quote: There the headlights glanced off something in the dark: a six-foot-tall, man-shaped thing. Shining red eyes stared back at them from a body without an obvious head or neck.

claims.statement: Spooked, the couples sped away, only to see the thing following them on silent, unmoving wings.
claims.statement_id: Ketakutan, pasangan itu kabur, tetapi melihat benda itu mengikuti mereka dengan sayap yang senyap dan tak bergerak.
claims.quote: Spooked, the couples sped away, only to see the thing following them on silent, unmoving wings.

claims.statement: According to Joe Nickell, an author and investigator with the Committee for Skeptical Inquiry, the original Mothman likely owes its existence to a more mundane yet no less interesting culprit: an owl.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Joe Nickell, penulis dan penyelidik Committee for Skeptical Inquiry, Mothman asli kemungkinan besar berasal dari penyebab yang lebih biasa namun tak kalah menarik: seekor burung hantu.
claims.quote: Yet according to Joe Nickell, an author and investigator with the Committee for Skeptical Inquiry, the original Mothman likely owes its existence to a more mundane-though no less interesting-culprit: an owl.

claims.statement: Barred Owls have a dramatic crimson eyeshine due to the amount of blood vessels around the eye.
claims.statement_id: Burung hantu Barred memiliki pantulan cahaya mata merah tua yang mencolok karena banyaknya pembuluh darah di sekitar mata.
claims.quote: Barred Owls have a dramatic crimson eyeshine due to the amount of blood vessels around the eye.

claims.statement: Paranormal writers played up the otherworldly aspects of the sightings and reshaped the legend; current artistic interpretations often cast Mothman as demonic or, more understandably, insect-like.
claims.statement_id: Penulis paranormal menonjolkan sisi gaib dari penampakan itu dan membentuk ulang legendanya; tafsir artistik masa kini sering menggambarkan Mothman sebagai iblis atau, yang lebih masuk akal, mirip serangga.
claims.quote: Paranormal writers played up the otherworldly aspects of the sightings, reinterpreting and reshaping the legend to suit their needs. Current artistic interpretations of Mothman often cast it as demonic or, more understandably, insect-like.

claims.statement: Nickell grew interested in the Mothman case after looking into the similar Flatwoods Monster.
claims.statement_id: Nickell tertarik pada kasus Mothman setelah menyelidiki Flatwoods Monster yang serupa.
claims.quote: Nickell grew interested in the Mothman case after looking into the similar Flatwoods Monster

claims.statement: The wendigo is part of the traditional belief system of several Algonquian-speaking peoples including the Ojibwe and Cree.
claims.statement_id: Wendigo adalah bagian dari sistem kepercayaan tradisional suku-suku Algonquian-speaking termasuk Ojibwe dan Cree.
claims.quote: The wendigo is part of the traditional belief system of several Algonquian-speaking peoples, including the Ojibwe, the Saulteaux, the Cree, the Naskapi, and the Innu.

claims.statement: The wendigo is often said to be a malevolent spirit who may possess human beings.
claims.statement_id: Wendigo sering digambarkan sebagai roh jahat yang mampu merasuki manusia.
claims.quote: The wendigo is often said to be a malevolent spirit, sometimes depicted as a creature with human-like characteristics, who may possess human beings.

claims.statement: It is said to cause its victims insatiable hunger, the desire to eat other humans, and propensity to commit murder.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini menyebabkan rasa lapar kanibal tak terpuaskan dan dorongan untuk membunuh.
claims.quote: It is said to cause its victims a feeling of insatiable hunger, the desire to eat other humans, and the propensity to commit murder.

claims.statement: In some representations, the wendigo is described as a giant humanoid with a heart of ice signaled by foul stench or chill.
claims.statement_id: Dalam beberapa penggambaran, wendigo dilukiskan sebagai sosok raksasa berhati es dengan bau busuk atau hawa dingin tiba-tiba.
claims.quote: In some representations, the wendigo is described as a giant humanoid with a heart of ice, whose approach is signaled by a foul stench or sudden unseasonable chill.

claims.statement: The wendigo is a mythological creature or evil spirit originating from Algonquian folklore.
claims.statement_id: Wendigo adalah makhluk mitologis atau roh jahat yang berasal dari cerita rakyat Algonquian.
claims.quote: is a mythological creature or evil spirit originating from Algonquian folklore.

claims.statement: The English word wendigo is partly a borrowing from Cree (wīhtikōw) and partly from Ojibwe (wiindigoo), both Algonquian languages.
claims.statement_id: Kata Inggris wendigo sebagian merupakan serapan dari bahasa Cree (wīhtikōw) dan sebagian dari bahasa Ojibwe (wiindigoo), keduanya bahasa Algonquian.
claims.quote: The contemporary English word wendigo is a loanword from multiple origins. It is partially a borrowing from Cree (wīhtikōw ) and partially a borrowing from Ojibwe (wiindigoo ), both Algonquian languages.

claims.statement: The form wendigo was popularized in English by Algernon Blackwood, who in 1910 published the novella The Wendigo.
claims.statement_id: Bentuk wendigo dipopulerkan dalam bahasa Inggris oleh Algernon Blackwood, yang pada 1910 menerbitkan novela The Wendigo.
claims.quote: The form wendigo was popularized in the English language by Algernon Blackwood, who in 1910 published the novella The Wendigo.

claims.statement: Common to all these cultures is the view that the wendigo is a malevolent, cannibalistic, supernatural being, strongly associated with the north, winter, cold, famine and starvation.
claims.statement_id: Pandangan yang sama di semua budaya itu adalah bahwa wendigo makhluk gaib jahat pemakan manusia, yang sangat dikaitkan dengan utara, musim dingin, hawa dingin, kelaparan, dan paceklik.
claims.quote: common to all these cultures is the view that the wendigo is a malevolent, cannibalistic, supernatural being. They were strongly associated with the north, winter, cold, famine, and starvation.

claims.statement: In Ojibwe, Eastern Cree, Westmain Swampy Cree, Naskapi and Innu lore, wendigos are often described as giants many times larger than human beings.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Ojibwe, Cree Timur, Cree Rawa Westmain, Naskapi, dan Innu, wendigo sering digambarkan sebagai raksasa yang berkali-kali lipat lebih besar daripada manusia.
claims.quote: In Ojibwe, Eastern Cree, Westmain Swampy Cree, Naskapi, and Innu lore, wendigos are often described as giants that are many times larger than human beings

claims.statement: Whenever a wendigo ate another person it would grow in proportion to the meal, so it could never be full.
claims.statement_id: Setiap kali wendigo memakan seseorang, ia tumbuh sebanding dengan santapannya sehingga tidak pernah kenyang.
claims.quote: Whenever a wendigo ate another person, it would grow in proportion to the meal it had just eaten, so it could never be full.

claims.statement: The wendigo is seen as the embodiment of gluttony, greed and excess.
claims.statement_id: Wendigo dipandang sebagai perwujudan kerakusan, keserakahan, dan kelebihan.
claims.quote: The wendigo is seen as the embodiment of gluttony, greed, and excess.

claims.statement: A wendigo need not lose the human's powers of cognition or speech, and in some depictions may communicate with prospective victims or even threaten or taunt them.
claims.statement_id: Wendigo tidak harus kehilangan daya pikir atau bicara manusia, dan dalam sebagian gambaran ia dapat berkomunikasi dengan calon korbannya, bahkan mengancam atau mengejek mereka.
claims.quote: A wendigo need not lose the human's powers of cognition or speech and in some depictions may clearly communicate with its prospective victims or even threaten or taunt them.

claims.statement: A folk story collected in the early 20th century by Lottie Chicogquaw Marsden, an ethnographer of the Chippewas of Rama First Nation, shows a wendigo using tools, surviving partial dismemberment and practising autocannibalism.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah cerita rakyat yang dikumpulkan pada awal abad ke-20 oleh Lottie Chicogquaw Marsden, etnografer Chippewas of Rama First Nation, menampilkan wendigo yang memakai alat, mampu bertahan setelah tubuhnya sebagian terpotong, dan memakan dirinya sendiri.
claims.quote: A specimen of folk story collected in the early 20th century by Lottie Chicogquaw Marsden, an ethnographer of the Chippewas of Rama First Nation, in which a wendigo also exhibits tool use, an ability to survive partial dismemberment, and autocannibalism

claims.statement: In that story a big Windigo stole a boy but did not eat him right away because the boy was too thin, so he travelled with him waiting till he got fat.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita itu, seorang Windigo besar menculik seorang anak laki-laki tetapi tidak langsung memakannya karena anak itu terlalu kurus, sehingga ia membawanya berkelana menunggu anak itu gemuk.
claims.quote: One time long ago a big Windigo stole an Indian boy, but the boy was too thin, so the Windigo didn't eat him up right away, but he travelled with the Indian boy waiting for him till he'd get fat.

claims.statement: At the end of the story the people killed the Windigo and cut him to pieces; that was the end of this Giant Windigo.
claims.statement_id: Pada akhir cerita, orang-orang membunuh Windigo itu dan memotongnya menjadi beberapa bagian; itulah akhir Windigo raksasa itu.
claims.quote: The Indians then killed him and cut him to pieces. This was the end of this Giant Windigo.

claims.statement: In some traditions humans overpowered by greed could turn into wendigos, so the myth encouraged cooperation and moderation; other sources say wendigos were created when a human resorted to cannibalism to survive.
claims.statement_id: Dalam sebagian tradisi, manusia yang dikuasai keserakahan dapat menjadi wendigo, sehingga mitos ini mendorong kerja sama dan kesederhanaan; sumber lain menyebut wendigo tercipta ketika manusia memakan sesamanya demi bertahan hidup.
claims.quote: In some traditions, humans overpowered by greed could turn into wendigos; the myth thus served as a method of encouraging cooperation and moderation. Other sources say wendigos were created when a human resorted to cannibalism to survive.

claims.statement: Humans could also turn into wendigos by being in contact with them for too long.
claims.statement_id: Manusia juga dapat menjadi wendigo karena terlalu lama berhubungan dengan mereka.
claims.quote: Humans could also turn into wendigos by being in contact with them for too long.

claims.statement: Among the Assiniboine, Cree and Ojibwe a satirical ceremonial dance is sometimes performed during famine to reinforce the seriousness of the wendigo taboo.
claims.statement_id: Di kalangan Assiniboine, Cree, dan Ojibwe, tarian upacara satir kadang dipentaskan pada masa paceklik untuk menegaskan keseriusan pantangan wendigo.
claims.quote: Among the Assiniboine, the Cree, and the Ojibwe, a satirical ceremonial dance is sometimes performed during times of famine to reinforce the seriousness of the wendigo taboo.

claims.statement: The last known wendigo ceremony in the United States was held at Lake Windigo on Star Island of Cass Lake, within the Leech Lake Indian Reservation in northern Minnesota.
claims.statement_id: Upacara wendigo terakhir yang diketahui di Amerika Serikat dilakukan di Lake Windigo di Star Island, Cass Lake, dalam Reservasi Indian Leech Lake di Minnesota utara.
claims.quote: The last known wendigo ceremony conducted in the United States was at Lake Windigo of Star Island of Cass Lake, within the Leech Lake Indian Reservation in northern Minnesota.

claims.statement: In modern psychiatry the disorder known as "Wendigo psychosis" is characterized by symptoms such as an intense craving for human flesh and fear of becoming a cannibal, and is described as a culture-bound syndrome.
claims.statement_id: Dalam psikiatri modern, gangguan yang dikenal sebagai "psikosis wendigo" dicirikan oleh gejala seperti nafsu kuat terhadap daging manusia dan ketakutan menjadi kanibal, dan digambarkan sebagai sindrom terikat budaya.
claims.quote: In modern psychiatry, the disorder known as "Wendigo psychosis" is characterized by symptoms such as an intense craving for human flesh and fear of becoming a cannibal. Wendigo psychosis is described as a culture-bound syndrome.

claims.statement: Some researchers argued that Wendigo psychosis was essentially a fabrication, the result of naive anthropologists taking stories at face value without observation.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian peneliti berpendapat bahwa psikosis wendigo pada dasarnya rekaan, hasil antropolog naif yang menelan mentah-mentah cerita tanpa pengamatan.
claims.quote: Some researchers argued that, essentially, Wendigo psychosis was a fabrication, the result of naïve anthropologists taking stories related to them at face value without observation.

claims.statement: Others cited several credible eyewitness accounts by Algonquians and others as evidence that wendigo psychosis was a factual historical phenomenon.
claims.statement_id: Peneliti lain mengutip beberapa kesaksian saksi mata yang kredibel dari orang Algonquian dan lainnya sebagai bukti bahwa psikosis wendigo adalah fenomena sejarah yang nyata.
claims.quote: Others cited several credible eyewitness accounts by Algonquians and others, as evidence that wendigo psychosis was a factual historical phenomenon.

claims.statement: As a concept the wendigo can apply to any person, idea or movement infected by a corrosive drive toward self-aggrandizing greed and excessive consumption, traits that sow disharmony and destruction if left unchecked.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai konsep, wendigo dapat merujuk pada orang, gagasan, atau gerakan mana pun yang terjangkit dorongan merusak berupa keserakahan yang mementingkan diri dan konsumsi berlebihan, sifat yang menabur ketidakselarasan dan kehancuran bila dibiarkan.
claims.quote: As a concept, the wendigo can apply to any person, idea, or movement infected by a corrosive drive toward self-aggrandizing greed and excessive consumption, traits that sow disharmony and destruction if left unchecked.

claims.statement: The wechuge is a similar being in the legends of the Athabaskan people of the Northwest Pacific Coast; it too is cannibalistic but is characterized as enlightened with ancestral insights.
claims.statement_id: Wechuge adalah makhluk serupa dalam legenda bangsa Athabaskan di Pesisir Pasifik Barat Laut; ia juga kanibal, tetapi dicirikan sebagai tercerahkan dengan wawasan leluhur.
claims.quote: The wechuge is a similar being that appears in the legends of the Athabaskan people of the Northwest Pacific Coast. It too is cannibalistic; however, it is characterized as enlightened with ancestral insights.

claims.statement: The infobox lists the sub-grouping as Algonquian, with origin region Canada and United States.
claims.statement_id: Kotak info mencantumkan subkelompok Algonquian dengan wilayah asal Kanada dan Amerika Serikat.
claims.quote: Sub grouping Algonquian Origin Region Canada United States

claims.statement: Comparable forms have existed in English since 1714 (Whitego).
claims.statement_id: Bentuk yang sebanding sudah ada dalam bahasa Inggris sejak 1714 (Whitego).
claims.quote: Comparable forms are in English since 1714 (Whitego).

claims.statement: One of the first appearances of a character inspired by or named after a wendigo in non-Indigenous literature is Algernon Blackwood's 1910 novella The Wendigo, distinct from the wendigo of traditional lore.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu kemunculan pertama tokoh yang terinspirasi atau dinamai wendigo dalam sastra non-Pribumi adalah novela The Wendigo karya Algernon Blackwood tahun 1910, yang berbeda dari wujudnya dalam cerita rakyat tradisional.
claims.quote: one of the first appearances of a character inspired by, or named after, a wendigo in non-Indigenous literature is Algernon Blackwood's 1910 novella The Wendigo.

claims.statement: These works set the template for later portrayals in popular culture, at times even replacing the Native American lore.
claims.statement_id: Karya-karya itu menjadi cetak biru bagi penggambaran budaya populer berikutnya, kadang bahkan menggantikan cerita rakyat Pribumi Amerika.
claims.quote: These works set the template for later portrayals in popular culture, at times even replacing the Native American lore.

claims.statement: In 1973 a character inspired by the Wendigo appeared in American comic books published by Marvel Comics, first in The Incredible Hulk #162 (April 1973).
claims.statement_id: Pada 1973 tokoh yang terinspirasi Wendigo muncul dalam komik Amerika terbitan Marvel Comics, pertama kali dalam The Incredible Hulk #162 (April 1973).
claims.quote: In 1973 a character inspired by the Wendigo appeared in American comic books published by Marvel Comics. ... It first appeared in The Incredible Hulk #162 (April 1973)

claims.statement: The interactive horror video game Until Dawn (2015) features multiple Wendigos as central antagonists.
claims.statement_id: Gim horor interaktif Until Dawn (2015) menampilkan beberapa Wendigo sebagai antagonis utama.
claims.quote: The interactive horror video game Until Dawn (2015) features multiple Wendigos as central antagonists

claims.statement: In the 2021 film Antlers by Scott Cooper, the wendigo is portrayed as a deer-like creature with a glowing heart.
claims.statement_id: Dalam film Antlers (2021) karya Scott Cooper, wendigo digambarkan sebagai makhluk mirip rusa dengan jantung bercahaya.
claims.quote: the 2021 film Antlers by Scott Cooper, where the wendigo is portrayed as a deer-like creature with a glowing heart

claims.statement: The dictionary entry defines wiindigoo as windigo: a winter cannibal monster.
claims.statement_id: Entri kamus mendefinisikan wiindigoo sebagai windigo: monster kanibal musim dingin.
claims.quote: wiindigoo na windigo: a winter cannibal monster

claims.statement: The Wendigo is a voracious monster of the First Nations of Canada and Plains Indians culture who appears, under other names, in the stories of many Native American Nations across North America.
claims.statement_id: Wendigo adalah monster rakus dari budaya Bangsa-Bangsa Pertama Kanada dan Indian Dataran yang muncul, dengan nama lain, dalam kisah banyak bangsa Pribumi Amerika di seluruh Amerika Utara.
claims.quote: The Wendigo is a voracious monster of the First Nations of Canada and Plains Indians culture who appears, under other names, in the stories of many Native American Nations across North America.

claims.statement: According to the Chippewa, the Wendigo was once a human who could never be satisfied, marked by excessive selfishness and greed; such people were thought to eventually become the human-eating monster with a heart of ice who preys upon people.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Chippewa, Wendigo dulunya manusia yang tak pernah puas dan bercirikan keegoisan dan keserakahan berlebihan; orang seperti itu dipercaya akhirnya menjadi monster pemakan manusia berhati es yang memangsa orang.
claims.quote: According to the Chippewa, the Wendigo was once a human who could never be satisfied and was characterized by excessive selfishness and greed. Such people were thought to eventually become the human-eating monster with a heart of ice who preys upon people.

claims.statement: The creature is depicted as an emaciated beast with large horns that is never satiated no matter how much it eats, and so is doomed to wander constantly, failing to satisfy its need for comfort.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini digambarkan sebagai binatang kurus kering bertanduk besar yang tak pernah kenyang berapa pun yang dimakannya, sehingga terus mengembara dan gagal memenuhi kebutuhannya akan kenyamanan.
claims.quote: The creature is depicted as an emaciated beast with large horns who is never satiated no matter how much it eats and so is doomed to wander about constantly trying and failing to satisfy its need for comfort.

claims.statement: The Chippewa origin tale of the monster is echoed by other Nations and reinforces the concept generally held by Native Americans that the needs of the community come before those of the individual.
claims.statement_id: Kisah asal-usul monster dari Chippewa digaungkan bangsa lain dan memperkuat gagasan umum di kalangan Pribumi Amerika bahwa kebutuhan komunitas didahulukan daripada kebutuhan individu.
claims.quote: The Chippewa origin tale of the monster is echoed by other Nations and serves to reinforce the concept generally held by Native Americans that the needs of the community come before those of the individual.

claims.statement: The Flying Head is similar to the Wendigo in that it is also an insatiable monster that feeds on human flesh, and it originates in the legends of the Iroquois Nation.
claims.statement_id: Kepala Terbang (Flying Head) mirip Wendigo karena juga monster yang tak pernah puas dan memakan daging manusia, dan berasal dari legenda bangsa Iroquois.
claims.quote: The Flying Head (or Flying Heads) is similar to the Wendigo in that it is also an insatiable monster that feeds on human flesh. The creature originates in the legends of the Iroquois Nation

claims.statement: Taking the role of a trickster, he is also one of the most important characters of West African, African-American and Caribbean folklore.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai penipu, ia juga salah satu tokoh terpenting dalam cerita rakyat Afrika Barat, Afrika-Amerika, dan Karibia.
claims.quote: Taking the role of a trickster, he is also one of the most important characters of West African, African-American and Caribbean folklore.

claims.statement: Anansi is best known for his ability to outsmart and triumph over more powerful opponents through cunning, creativity and wit.
claims.statement_id: Anansi dikenal luas atas kemampuannya mengelabui dan mengalahkan lawan tangguh berbekal kecerdikan dan akal muslihat.
claims.quote: Anansi is best known for his ability to outsmart and triumph over more powerful opponents through his use of cunning, creativity and wit.

claims.statement: Anansi is depicted in many ways and under many names, from "Ananse", "Kwaku Ananse" and "Anancy" to New World iterations such as "Ba Anansi", "Kompa Nanzi", "Nanzi", "Nancy", "Aunt Nancy" and "Sis' Nancy", though he is always male in his stories.
claims.statement_id: Anansi digambarkan dengan banyak cara dan nama, dari "Ananse", "Kwaku Ananse", dan "Anancy" hingga bentuk Dunia Baru seperti "Ba Anansi", "Kompa Nanzi", "Nanzi", "Nancy", "Aunt Nancy", dan "Sis' Nancy", meskipun dalam kisahnya ia selalu laki-laki.
claims.quote: Anansi is depicted in many different ways and with different names, from "Ananse", "Kwaku Ananse", and "Anancy", to his New World iterations, such as "Ba Anansi", "Kompa Nanzi" and/or "Nanzi", "Nancy", "Aunt Nancy", and "Sis' Nancy", even though he is always depicted as a male in his stories.

claims.statement: Anansi has representations including an anthropomorphic spider with a human face or human with spider-like features such as eight legs.
