claims.quote: The man reveals that he is the deity Sakra and prevents the hare from being burned by the fire. Then he takes him to live on the moon for eternity so that his selflessness can be witnessed by the world.

claims.statement: In Japan the hare of this tale is the Jeweled Hare or the Jade Hare, with the symbolic meanings of charity and longevity.
claims.statement_id: Di Jepang, hare dalam kisah ini adalah Hare Permata atau Hare Giok dan bermakna simbolis kedermawanan dan umur panjang.
claims.quote: In Japan this is the Jeweled Hare or the Jade Hare and has the symbolic meanings of charity and longevity.

claims.statement: In Chinese culture the hare in the moon is said to pound medicine in a mortar and pestle, but in Korea and Japan he pounds sweet rice to make mochi, which gives the hare an association with the New Year, when eating mochi has a special place.
claims.statement_id: Dalam budaya Tiongkok hare di bulan dikatakan menumbuk obat dengan lesung dan alu, tetapi di Korea dan Jepang ia menumbuk beras manis untuk membuat mochi. Ini memberi hare itu kaitan dengan Tahun Baru, ketika makan mochi punya tempat khusus dalam perayaan.
claims.quote: In Chinese culture the hare in the moon is said to pound medicine in a mortar and pestle, but in Korea and Japan, he pounds sweet rice to make mochi treats. This gives the hare an association with the New Year, when eating mochi has a special place in the festivities.

claims.statement: The hare in the moon is usually depicted as white.
claims.statement_id: Hare di bulan biasanya digambarkan berwarna putih.
claims.quote: The hare in the moon is usually depicted as white.

claims.statement: This tale, retold by the Zen monk-poet Ryokan (c. 1758–1831), draws on an old Chinese legend of a rabbit who lives in the moon, and it is one of many Jataka tales, stories of Shakyamuni Buddha's previous lives that illustrate acts of selflessness.
claims.statement_id: Kisah ini, yang dituturkan ulang penyair-biksu Zen Ryokan (sekitar 1758–1831), bersumber dari legenda Tiongkok kuno tentang kelinci yang tinggal di bulan. Kisah ini salah satu dari banyak Jataka, cerita kehidupan lampau Buddha Shakyamuni yang menggambarkan tindakan tanpa pamrih.
claims.quote: This tale, retold by Zen monk-poet Ryokan (c. 1758–1831), draws on an old Chinese legend of a rabbit who lives in the moon. It is one of many Jataka tales, stories of Shakyamuni Buddha’s previous lives that illustrate acts of selflessness.

claims.statement: Then he made the rabbit whole again and, gathering the dead body up in his arms, took it and laid it to rest in the palace of the moon.
claims.statement_id: Lalu ia memulihkan kelinci itu dan, sambil memangku tubuh yang telah mati dalam pelukannya, membawanya dan membaringkannya di istana bulan.
claims.quote: Then he made the rabbit whole again and gathering the dead body up in his arms, took it and laid it to rest in the palace of the moon.

claims.statement: In the month of Zip the feast Ihcil Ixchel was celebrated by physicians and shamans (hechiceros), and divination stones and medicine bundles containing little idols of "the Goddess of medicine whom they called Ixchel" were brought forward.
claims.statement_id: Pada bulan Zip, pesta Ihcil Ixchel dirayakan para tabib dan dukun (hechiceros); batu ramalan dan bungkusan obat berisi berhala-berhala kecil "Dewi pengobatan yang mereka sebut Ixchel" dikeluarkan.
claims.quote: In the month of Zip, the feast Ihcil Ixchel was celebrated by the physicians and shamans (hechiceros), and divination stones as well as medicine bundles containing little idols of "the Goddess of medicine whom they called Ixchel" were brought forward.

claims.statement: Ixchel or Ix Chel is the 16th-century name of the aged jaguar goddess of midwifery and medicine in ancient Maya culture, and she corresponds to Toci, an Aztec earth goddess inhabiting the sweatbath.
claims.statement_id: Ixchel atau Ix Chel adalah nama abad ke-16 bagi dewi jaguar tua kebidanan dan pengobatan dalam budaya Maya kuno. Ia sepadan dengan Toci, dewi bumi Aztec yang mendiami pemandian uap.
claims.quote: Ixchel or Ix Chel is the 16th-century name of the aged jaguar goddess of midwifery and medicine in ancient Maya culture. She corresponds to Toci, an Aztec earth goddess inhabiting the sweatbath.

claims.statement: In the 1500s Diego de Landa called Ixchel "the Goddess of making children" and also mentioned her as the goddess of medicine.
claims.statement_id: Pada tahun 1500-an, Diego de Landa menyebut Ixchel "Dewi pembuat anak"; ia juga menyebutnya dewi pengobatan.
claims.quote: In the 1500s, Diego de Landa called Ixchel "the Goddess of making children". He also mentioned her as the goddess of medicine

claims.statement: Ixchel was already known to the Classical Maya; as Taube has demonstrated, she corresponds to Goddess O of the Dresden Codex, an aged woman with jaguar ears.
claims.statement_id: Ixchel sudah dikenal bangsa Maya Klasik. Seperti ditunjukkan Taube, ia sepadan dengan Dewi O dalam Kodeks Dresden, seorang wanita tua bertelinga jaguar.
claims.quote: Ixchel was already known to the Classical Maya. As Taube has demonstrated, she corresponds to Goddess O of the Dresden Codex, an aged woman with jaguar ears.

claims.statement: The name Ixchel was in use in 16th-century Yucatán and among the Poqom in the Baja Verapaz; its meaning is not certain, but if it originated in Yucatán, chel could mean "rainbow".
claims.statement_id: Nama Ixchel dipakai di Yucatán abad ke-16 dan di kalangan Poqom di Baja Verapaz. Maknanya tidak pasti; bila nama itu berasal dari Yucatán, chel dapat berarti "pelangi".
claims.quote: The name Ixchel was in use in 16th-century Yucatán and amongst the Poqom in the Baja Verapaz. Its meaning is not certain. Assuming that the name originated in Yucatán, chel could mean "rainbow".

claims.statement: Ix Chel's Classic name glyph has yet to be identified; several names may have been used for the goddess, not necessarily including her late Yucatec and Poqom name, and her codical name is now generally rendered "Chak Chel".
claims.statement_id: Glif nama Klasik Ix Chel belum teridentifikasi. Sangat mungkin beberapa nama dipakai untuk sang dewi, dan itu belum tentu mencakup namanya yang muncul belakangan di Yucatec dan Poqom. Nama kodeksnya kini umumnya dibaca "Chak Chel".
claims.quote: Ix Chel's Classic name glyph remains to be identified. It is quite possible that several names were in use to refer to the goddess, and these need not necessarily have included her late Yucatec and Poqom name. Her codical name is now generally rendered as "Chak Chel".

claims.statement: In the past it was common to take Ix Chel as the Yucatec name of the moon goddess because of a shared association with human fertility and procreation, but the identification is questionable because colonial and ethnographic sources give no direct evidence that Ixchel was a moon goddess.
claims.statement_id: Dahulu lazim menganggap Ix Chel sebagai nama Yucatec bagi dewi bulan karena kesamaan kaitan dengan kesuburan dan prokreasi manusia. Namun identifikasi itu diragukan, sebab sumber kolonial dan etnografis tidak memberi bukti langsung bahwa Ixchel dewi bulan.
claims.quote: In the past, it was common to take Ix Chel as the Yucatec name of the moon goddess because of a shared association with human fertility and procreation. The identification is questionable, however, since (1) colonial and ethnographical sources provide no direct evidence to show that Ixchel was a moon goddess

claims.statement: An entwined serpent serves as Ixchel's headdress, crossed bones may adorn her skirt, and instead of human hands and feet she sometimes has claws.
claims.statement_id: Seekor ular yang melilit menjadi hiasan kepala Ixchel, tulang bersilang dapat menghiasi roknya, dan alih-alih tangan dan kaki manusia ia kadang bercakar.
claims.quote: An entwined serpent serves as Ixchel's headdress, crossed bones may adorn her skirt, and instead of human hands and feet, she sometimes has claws.

claims.statement: Being a jaguar goddess, the Classic Ixchel (or "Chak Chel") could equally be imagined as a fearsome female warrior equipped with shield and spear.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai dewi jaguar, Ixchel masa Klasik (atau "Chak Chel") dapat pula dibayangkan sebagai prajurit perempuan yang menakutkan, bersenjata perisai dan tombak.
claims.quote: Being a jaguar goddess, the Classic Ixchel (or 'Chak Chel') could equally be imagined as a fearsome female warrior equipped with shield and spear

claims.statement: The Madrid Codex (30b) assimilates Goddess O to a rain deity with rain pouring from her armpits and abdomen, while the Dresden Codex includes her in almanacs dedicated to the rain deities (Chaacs) and typically has her invert a water jar.
claims.statement_id: Kodeks Madrid (30b) menyamakan Dewi O dengan dewa hujan, dengan hujan mengalir dari ketiak dan perutnya, sedangkan Kodeks Dresden memasukkannya dalam almanak bagi dewa-dewa hujan (para Chaac) dan lazim menampilkannya menuangkan kendi air.
claims.quote: The Madrid Codex (30b) assimilates Goddess O to a rain deity, with rain pouring from her arm-pits and abdomen, while the Dresden Codex includes her in almanacs dedicated to the rain deities (Chaacs) and typically has her invert a water jar.

claims.statement: Ixchel figures in a Verapaz myth related by Las Casas in which she and her spouse Itzamna had thirteen sons, two of whom created heaven and earth and all that belongs to it; no other myth of Ixchel has been preserved.
claims.statement_id: Ixchel muncul dalam mitos Verapaz yang dituturkan Las Casas: bersama suaminya, Itzamna, ia memiliki tiga belas putra, dua di antaranya menciptakan langit, bumi, dan segala isinya. Tidak ada mitos lain tentang Ixchel yang terlestarikan.
claims.quote: Ixchel figures in a Verapaz myth related by Las Casas, according to which she, together with her spouse, Itzamna, had thirteen sons, two of whom created heaven and earth and all that belongs to it. No other myth figuring Ixchel has been preserved.

claims.statement: In the early 16th century Maya women seeking a fruitful marriage would travel to the sanctuary of Ix Chel on the island of Cozumel, the most important place of pilgrimage after Chichen Itza, where a priest hidden in a large statue would give oracles.
claims.statement_id: Pada awal abad ke-16, perempuan Maya yang ingin pernikahan subur melakukan perjalanan ke tempat suci Ix Chel di Pulau Cozumel, tempat ziarah terpenting setelah Chichen Itza, di lepas pantai timur Semenanjung Yucatán. Di sana seorang imam yang bersembunyi di dalam patung besar memberikan ramalan.
claims.quote: In the early 16th century, Maya women seeking to ensure a fruitful marriage would travel to the sanctuary of Ix Chel on the island of Cozumel, the most important place of pilgrimage after Chichen Itza, off the east coast of the Yucatán peninsula. There, a priest hidden in a large statue would give oracles.

claims.statement: For childbirth women turned to sorceresses (hechizeras), who placed under the bed an idol of a "demon" called Ixchel, who they said was the goddess of making creatures.
claims.statement_id: Untuk persalinan, perempuan mendatangi para dukun (hechizeras) yang menaruh di bawah ranjang sebuah berhala "setan" bernama Ixchel, yang menurut mereka adalah dewi pembuat anak.
claims.quote: Para sus partos acudian a las hechizeras, las quales les hazian creer de sus mentiras y les ponian debaxo de la cama un idolo de un demonio, llamado Ixchel, que dezian era la diosa de hazer las criaturas.

claims.statement: They brought out their medicine bundles with many trinkets and little idols of the goddess of medicine whom they called Ixchel, hence the feast was called Ihcil-Ixchel.
claims.statement_id: Mereka mengeluarkan bungkusan obat berisi banyak pernak-pernik dan berhala kecil dewi pengobatan yang mereka sebut Ixchel, sehingga pesta itu dinamai Ihcil-Ixchel.
claims.quote: sacavan los emboltorios de su medicina en que traian muchas niñerias y sendos dollillos de la diosa de la medicina que llamavan Ixchel, y asi a esta fiesta llamavan Ihcil-Ixchel

claims.statement: Together with Zamna a goddess considered the mother of the gods was worshipped in Yucatan; she was called Xchel or Ixchel.
claims.statement_id: Bersama Zamna, di Yucatan dipuja seorang dewi yang dianggap ibu para dewa; ia disebut Xchel atau Ixchel.
claims.quote: Conjointement avec Zamna on adorait au Yucatan une déesse qui passait pour la mère des dieux; on l'appelait Xchel ou Ixchel.

claims.statement: According to the grammar of P. Beltran, Ixchel (better Xchel) is simply the feminine of Chel.
claims.statement_id: Menurut tata bahasa P. Beltran, Ixchel (lebih tepat Xchel) hanyalah bentuk feminin dari Chel.
claims.quote: Ixchel, mieux Xchel, suivant la grammaire du P. Beltran, est tout simplement le féminin de Chel

claims.statement: God O, or Ix Chel, is the goddess of rainbows (according to this source).
claims.statement_id: Dewa O, atau Ix Chel, adalah dewi pelangi (menurut sumber ini).
claims.quote: God O, or Ix Chel, is the goddess of rainbows.

claims.statement: In her typical form Ix Chel is a fanged, clawed, dilapidated crone, but she also has a more benevolent form in which she occasionally represents fertility and childbirth and is pictured as youthful and beautiful.
claims.statement_id: Dalam wujud lazimnya, Ix Chel adalah perempuan renta bertaring dan bercakar. Namun, selaras dengan sifat ganda makhluk Maya, ia juga punya wujud yang lebih ramah: kadang ia melambangkan kesuburan dan persalinan, dan dalam konteks itu digambarkan muda dan cantik.
claims.quote: In her typical form, Ix Chel is a fanged, clawed, and dilapidated crone. However, in conjunction with the duplicity of Maya beings, Ix Chel also has a more benevolent form. She occasionally represents fertility and childbirth and, in these contexts, she is pictured as youthful and beautiful.

claims.statement: On the island of Cozumel, shrines to the Virgin Mary and the goddess Ixchel are interchangeable and often one and the same.
claims.statement_id: Di Pulau Cozumel, kuil-kuil bagi Perawan Maria dan dewi Ixchel dapat saling tertukar dan sering kali satu dan sama.
claims.quote: On the island of Cozumel shrines to the Virgin Mary and the goddess Ixchel are interchangeable and, often, one and the same.

claims.statement: In the 2006 movie Apocalypto, Ixchel is muttered by a Maya mother in a scene where she is forced to cross a river and her children are left behind.
claims.statement_id: Dalam film Apocalypto (2006), nama Ixchel diucapkan lirih oleh seorang ibu Maya dalam adegan ketika ia dipaksa menyeberangi sungai dan anak-anaknya tertinggal.
claims.quote: In the 2006 movie Apocalypto, Ixchel is muttered by a Maya mother in a scene where she is forced to cross a river and her children are left behind.

claims.statement: Ixchel is playable in Smite as a mage, the second Maya goddess to feature in Smite after Awilix.
claims.statement_id: Ixchel dapat dimainkan dalam Smite sebagai penyihir (mage). Ia dewi Maya kedua dalam Smite, setelah Awilix.
claims.quote: Ixchel is playable in Smite as a mage. She is the second Maya goddess to feature in Smite, after Awilix.

claims.statement: The word jackalope is a portmanteau of jackrabbit and antelope.
claims.statement_id: Kata jackalope adalah gabungan (portmanteau) dari jackrabbit dan antelope.
claims.quote: The word jackalope is a portmanteau of jackrabbit and antelope.

claims.statement: In the 1930s Douglas Herrick and his brother, hunters with taxidermy skills, popularized the American jackalope by grafting deer antlers onto a jackrabbit carcass and selling it to a local hotel in Douglas, Wyoming.
claims.statement_id: Pada 1930-an, Douglas Herrick dan saudaranya, pemburu yang terampil membuat awetan taksidermi, mempopulerkan jackalope Amerika dengan menempelkan tanduk rusa pada bangkai jackrabbit dan menjual hasilnya kepada sebuah hotel setempat di Douglas, Wyoming.
claims.quote: In the 1930s, Douglas Herrick and his brother, hunters with taxidermy skills, popularized the American jackalope by grafting deer antlers onto a jackrabbit carcass and selling the combination to a local hotel in Douglas, Wyoming.

claims.statement: Researchers suggest that at least some of the tales of horned hares were inspired by sightings of rabbits infected with the Shope papilloma virus.
claims.statement_id: Para peneliti menduga sebagian cerita tentang hare bertanduk terinspirasi oleh penampakan kelinci yang terinfeksi virus papiloma Shope.
claims.quote: Researchers suggest that at least some of the tales of horned hares were inspired by sightings of rabbits infected with the Shope papilloma virus.

claims.statement: Folklorists see the jackalope as one of a group of tall-tale animals, known as fearsome critters, common to North American culture since the turn of the twentieth century; these fabulous beasts appear in tall tales and suit comic hoaxes by entrepreneurs seeking attention for their own or the region's fortune.
claims.statement_id: Para folklorwan memandang jackalope sebagai salah satu kelompok hewan cerita bualan, yang dikenal sebagai fearsome critters, yang lazim dalam budaya Amerika Utara sejak pergantian abad ke-20. Binatang-binatang ajaib ini muncul dalam cerita bualan dan cocok untuk tipuan jenaka oleh pengusaha yang mencari perhatian bagi keuntungan pribadi atau daerahnya.
claims.quote: Folklorists see the jackalope as one of a group of tall tale animals, known as fearsome critters, common to North American culture since the turn of the twentieth century. These fabulous beasts appear in tall tales and lend themselves to comic hoaxes by entrepreneurs who seek attention for their own personal or the region's fortune.

claims.statement: The jackalope is a mythical animal of North American folklore described as a jackrabbit with antelope horns.
claims.statement_id: Jackalope adalah hewan mitos dalam cerita rakyat Amerika Utara yang digambarkan sebagai jackrabbit bertanduk antelop.
claims.quote: The jackalope is a mythical animal of North American folklore described as a jackrabbit with antelope horns.

claims.statement: Stuffed and mounted, jackalopes are found in many bars and other places in the United States, and stores catering to tourists sell jackalope postcards and other paraphernalia.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bentuk awetan, jackalope ditemukan di banyak bar dan tempat lain di Amerika Serikat; toko untuk wisatawan menjual kartu pos jackalope dan pernak-pernik lain.
claims.quote: Stuffed and mounted, jackalopes are found in many bars and other places in the United States; stores catering to tourists sell jackalope postcards and other paraphernalia

claims.statement: In 2005 the Wyoming legislature considered a bill to make the jackalope the state's official mythological creature; it passed the House 45–12 but the session ended before the Senate could take it up, and it died.
claims.statement_id: Pada 2005, legislatur Wyoming mempertimbangkan rancangan undang-undang untuk menjadikan jackalope makhluk mitologis resmi negara bagian. RUU itu lolos di DPR dengan selisih 45–12, tetapi sidang berakhir sebelum Senat membahasnya sehingga RUU itu gugur.
claims.quote: In 2005, the legislature of Wyoming considered a bill to make the jackalope the state's official mythological creature. It passed the House by a 45–12 margin, but the session ended before the Senate could take up the bill, which died.

claims.statement: A 13th-century Persian work depicts a rabbit with a single horn, like a unicorn, and in Europe the horned rabbit appeared in Medieval and Renaissance folklore in Bavaria (the wolpertinger) and elsewhere.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah karya Persia abad ke-13 menggambarkan kelinci bertanduk tunggal seperti unicorn. Di Eropa, kelinci bertanduk muncul dalam cerita rakyat Abad Pertengahan dan Renaisans di Bavaria (wolpertinger) dan tempat lain.
claims.quote: A 13th-century Persian work depicts a rabbit with a single horn, like a unicorn. In Europe, the horned rabbit appeared in Medieval and Renaissance folklore in Bavaria (the wolpertinger) and elsewhere.

claims.statement: These early scientific texts described and illustrated the hybrids as though they were real creatures, but by the end of the 18th century scientists generally rejected the idea of horned hares as a biological species.
claims.statement_id: Teks-teks ilmiah awal itu menguraikan dan menggambarkan hibrida tersebut seolah makhluk nyata, tetapi pada akhir abad ke-18 para ilmuwan umumnya menolak gagasan hare bertanduk sebagai spesies biologis.
claims.quote: These early scientific texts described and illustrated the hybrids as though they were real creatures, but by the end of the 18th century scientists generally rejected the idea of horned hares as a biological species.

claims.statement: In Central America mythological references to a horned rabbit creature are found in Huichol legends, whose oral tradition has passed down tales of a horned rabbit and of the deer getting horns from the rabbit.
claims.statement_id: Di Amerika Tengah, rujukan mitologis pada makhluk kelinci bertanduk terdapat dalam legenda Huichol. Tradisi lisan Huichol mewariskan kisah tentang kelinci bertanduk dan tentang rusa yang mendapat tanduk dari kelinci itu.
claims.quote: In Central America, mythological references to a horned rabbit creature can be found in Huichol legends. The Huichol oral tradition has passed down tales of a horned rabbit and of the deer getting horns from the rabbit.

claims.statement: The New York Times attributes the American jackalope's origin to a 1932 hunting outing involving Douglas Herrick (1920–2003) of Douglas, Wyoming.
claims.statement_id: The New York Times mengaitkan asal jackalope Amerika dengan sebuah acara berburu tahun 1932 yang melibatkan Douglas Herrick (1920–2003) dari Douglas, Wyoming.
claims.quote: The New York Times attributes the American jackalope's origin to a 1932 hunting outing involving Douglas Herrick (1920–2003) of Douglas, Wyoming.

claims.statement: The first jackalope the brothers put together was sold for $10 to Roy Ball, who displayed it in Douglas' La Bonte Hotel; the mounted head was stolen in 1977.
claims.statement_id: Jackalope pertama yang dirakit kedua bersaudara itu dijual seharga $10 kepada Roy Ball, yang memajangnya di La Bonte Hotel di Douglas. Kepala awetan itu dicuri pada 1977.
claims.quote: The first jackalope the brothers put together was sold for $10 to Roy Ball, who displayed it in Douglas' La Bonte Hotel. The mounted head was stolen in 1977.

claims.statement: The jackalope became a popular local attraction in Douglas, where the Chamber of Commerce issues Jackalope Hunting Licenses to tourists, good for the one-day official jackalope season on June 31 (a nonexistent date), from midnight to 2 a.m.
claims.statement_id: Jackalope menjadi atraksi lokal populer di Douglas, tempat Kamar Dagang menerbitkan Lisensi Berburu Jackalope bagi wisatawan. Tanda itu berlaku untuk berburu pada musim jackalope resmi yang hanya satu hari: 31 Juni (tanggal yang tidak ada karena Juni hanya 30 hari), dari tengah malam hingga pukul 2 pagi.
claims.quote: The jackalope became a popular local attraction in Douglas, where the Chamber of Commerce issues Jackalope Hunting Licenses to tourists. The tags are good for hunting during official jackalope season, which occurs for only one day: June 31 (a nonexistent date as June has 30 days), from midnight to 2 a.m.

claims.statement: Jackalopes are said to be so dangerous that hunters are advised to wear stovepipes on their legs to keep from being gored.
claims.statement_id: Jackalope dikatakan begitu berbahaya sehingga pemburu dianjurkan memakai pipa cerobong di kaki agar tidak ditanduk.
claims.quote: Jackalopes are said to be so dangerous that hunters are advised to wear stovepipes on their legs to keep from being gored.

claims.statement: According to legend the jackalope can imitate the human voice; in the Old West, when cowboys sang around campfires at night, jackalopes could be heard mimicking them or singing along, usually as a tenor.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, jackalope dapat menirukan suara manusia. Pada masa Wild West, ketika koboi berkumpul di api unggun dan bernyanyi di malam hari, jackalope terdengar menirukan suara mereka atau ikut bernyanyi, biasanya sebagai tenor.
claims.quote: The jackalope can imitate the human voice, according to legend. During the days of the Old West, when cowboys gathered by the campfires singing at night, jackalopes could be heard mimicking their voices or singing along, usually as a tenor.

claims.statement: One of the ways to catch a jackalope is to entice it with whiskey, the jackalope's beverage of choice.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu cara menangkap jackalope adalah memikatnya dengan wiski, minuman favoritnya.
claims.quote: One of the ways to catch a jackalope is to entice it with whiskey, the jackalope's beverage of choice.

claims.statement: It is said that jackalopes, the rare Lepus antilocapra, breed only during lightning flashes and that their antlers make the act difficult despite the hare's reputation for fertility.
claims.statement_id: Dikatakan bahwa jackalope, Lepus antilocapra yang langka, hanya berkembang biak saat kilat menyambar dan bahwa tanduknya mempersulit hal itu meskipun hare terkenal subur.
claims.quote: It is said that jackalopes, the rare Lepus antilocapra, breed only during lightning flashes and that their antlers make the act difficult despite the hare's reputation for fertility.

claims.statement: According to Dorson, in Mythical Creatures of the North Country (1969), historian Walker D. Wyman acknowledged the Alkali Area Jackalope of the western United States but doubted it predated the Jack-pine Jackalope of Minnesota and Wisconsin.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dorson, dalam Mythical Creatures of the North Country (1969), sejarawan Walker D. Wyman mengakui adanya apa yang ia sebut Jackalope Area Alkali di Amerika Serikat bagian barat, tetapi meragukan bahwa ia lebih tua daripada Jackalope Jack-pine di Minnesota dan Wisconsin.
claims.quote: According to Dorson, in Mythical Creatures of the North Country (1969), historian Walker D. Wyman acknowledged the existence of what he called the Alkali Area Jackalope of the western United States. However, he expressed doubt that it predated the Jack-pine Jackalope of Minnesota and Wisconsin

claims.statement: The underlying legend of the jackalope, which the Wyoming taxidermists were building on, may be related to similar stories in other cultures and other historical times.
claims.statement_id: Legenda dasar jackalope, yang dikembangkan para taksidermis Wyoming, mungkin berkaitan dengan cerita serupa dalam budaya dan masa sejarah lain.
claims.quote: The underlying legend of the jackalope, upon which the Wyoming taxidermists were building, may be related to similar stories in other cultures and other historical times.

claims.statement: Among the books featuring the jackalope is Juan and the Jackalope: A Children's Book in Verse by Rudolfo Anaya.
claims.statement_id: Salah satunya adalah Juan and the Jackalope: A Children's Book in Verse karya Rudolfo Anaya.
claims.quote: Among them is Juan and the Jackalope: A Children's Book in Verse by Rudolfo Anaya.

claims.statement: A short story, "Jackalope Wives" by Ursula Vernon, has been nominated for a 2014 Nebula Award.
claims.statement_id: Cerpen "Jackalope Wives" karya Ursula Vernon dinominasikan untuk Nebula Award 2014.
claims.quote: A short story, "Jackalope Wives" by Ursula Vernon, has been nominated for a 2014 Nebula Award.

claims.statement: Ralph and Douglas Herrick, taxidermists in Douglas, Wyoming, admitted to conjuring up the American jackalope we know today; after a hunting trip they happened to notice a dead jackrabbit lying next to a pair of antlers on the floor of their taxidermy shop.
claims.statement_id: Ralph dan Douglas Herrick, taksidermis di Douglas, Wyoming, mengaku telah menciptakan jackalope Amerika yang kita kenal sekarang. Sepulang berburu, kedua Herrick itu kebetulan melihat jackrabbit mati tergeletak di samping sepasang tanduk di lantai bengkel taksidermi mereka.
claims.quote: Ralph and Douglas Herrick, taxidermists in Douglas, Wyoming, admitted to conjuring up the American jackalope that we know today. After returning from a hunting trip, the Herrick Brothers serendipitously noticed a dead jackrabbit lying next to a pair of antlers on the floor of their taxidermy shop.

claims.statement: Over time Douglas, Wyoming, became known as the Jackalope Capital of the World and eventually put up an 8-foot jackalope statue in the city center.
claims.statement_id: Seiring waktu, Douglas, Wyoming, dikenal sebagai Ibu Kota Jackalope Dunia dan akhirnya memasang patung jackalope setinggi 8 kaki di pusat kota.
claims.quote: Over time, Douglas, Wyoming, became known as the Jackalope Capital of the World, and eventually put up an 8-foot jackalope statue in the city center.

claims.statement: Jackalopes are seen in art, gas stations, and occasionally even in bills brought up by state legislatures.
claims.statement_id: Jackalope terlihat dalam seni, di pom bensin, dan kadang bahkan menjadi bahan rancangan undang-undang yang diajukan legislatur negara bagian.
claims.quote: We see jackalopes in art, gas stations, and occasionally even featured in bills brought up by state legislatures.

claims.statement: A White Lady (or woman in white) is a type of female ghost, typically dressed in a white dress or similar garment, reportedly seen in rural areas and associated with local legends of tragedy.
claims.statement_id: White Lady (atau perempuan berbaju putih) adalah jenis hantu perempuan, biasanya berbalut gaun putih atau pakaian serupa, yang dilaporkan terlihat di daerah pedesaan dan dikaitkan dengan legenda tragedi setempat.
claims.quote: A White Lady (or woman in white) is a type of female ghost, typically dressed in a white dress or similar garment, reportedly seen in rural areas and associated with local legends of tragedy.

claims.statement: Although the details differ, many White Lady traditions share recurring themes of untimely death, grief, betrayal, or unfulfilled love.
claims.statement_id: Meskipun rinciannya berbeda, banyak tradisi White Lady memiliki tema berulang: kematian dini, duka, pengkhianatan, atau cinta yang tak terpenuhi.
claims.quote: Although the details differ, many White Lady traditions share recurring themes of untimely death, grief, betrayal, or unfulfilled love.

claims.statement: In numerous accounts the White Lady is believed to be the spirit of a woman who died through murder, suicide, accident, or abandonment; some legends portray her as a silent apparition or an omen of misfortune, others describe her asking travelers for help before mysteriously disappearing.
claims.statement_id: Dalam banyak kisah, White Lady dipercaya sebagai roh perempuan yang meninggal karena pembunuhan, bunuh diri, kecelakaan, atau ditinggalkan. Sebagian legenda menggambarkannya sebagai penampakan bisu atau pertanda malapetaka, sementara yang lain menceritakan perjumpaan ketika ia meminta bantuan pengelana sebelum lenyap secara misterius.
claims.quote: In numerous accounts, the White Lady is believed to be the spirit of a woman who died through murder, suicide, accident, or abandonment. Some legends portray her as a silent apparition or an omen of misfortune, while others describe encounters in which she asks travelers for assistance before mysteriously disappearing.

claims.statement: White Ladies are called Dames blanches in French; one legend says the surroundings of Montmorency Falls near Quebec City are haunted by a white lady, said to be the spirit of a young French-Canadian woman whose fiancé was killed fighting the British in the Battle of Beauport.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bahasa Prancis, White Lady disebut Dames blanches. Sebuah legenda menyebut kawasan sekitar Air Terjun Montmorency dekat Kota Quebec dihantui seorang white lady, yang dikatakan roh perempuan muda Prancis-Kanada yang tunangannya tewas dalam pertempuran melawan Inggris di Pertempuran Beauport.
claims.quote: White Ladies are called Dames blanches in French. One legend claims that the surroundings of Montmorency Falls near Quebec City are haunted by a white lady. It is said to be the spirit of a young French-Canadian woman whose fiancé was killed while fighting against the British in the Battle of Beauport.

claims.statement: White Lady legends are found in many countries around the world, and common to many are an accidental or impending death, murder, or suicide, and themes of loss, betrayal by a husband or fiancé, and unrequited love.
claims.statement_id: Legenda White Lady ditemukan di banyak negara. Umum pada banyak legenda itu adalah kematian karena kecelakaan atau yang akan datang, pembunuhan, atau bunuh diri, serta tema kehilangan, dikhianati suami atau tunangan, dan cinta tak berbalas.
claims.quote: White Lady legends are found in many countries around the world. Common to many of these legends is an accidental or impending death, murder, or suicide and the theme of loss, betrayed by a husband or fiancé, and unrequited love.

claims.statement: In popular medieval legend a White Lady is fabled to appear by day as well as by night in a house in which a family member is soon to die, and they also appear within photos just before or after death.
claims.statement_id: Dalam legenda populer abad pertengahan, White Lady dikisahkan muncul siang maupun malam di sebuah rumah tempat anggota keluarga akan segera meninggal. Mereka juga dikatakan tampak dalam foto sesaat sebelum atau sesudah kematian.
claims.quote: In popular medieval legend, a White Lady is fabled to appear by day as well as by night in a house in which a family member is soon to die. They also appear within photos just before or after death.

claims.statement: Called Dama Branca or Mulher de Branco in Portuguese, the Brazilian Lady in White is said to be the ghost of a young woman who died of childbirth or violent causes, appearing as a pale woman in a long white dress or sleeping gown; usually speechless, she will occasionally recount her misfortunes.
claims.statement_id: Disebut Dama Branca atau Mulher de Branco dalam bahasa Portugis, Perempuan Berbaju Putih Brasil dikatakan hantu perempuan muda yang meninggal karena persalinan atau sebab kekerasan. Menurut legenda, ia tampak sebagai perempuan pucat bergaun putih panjang atau baju tidur. Meski biasanya membisu, kadang ia menceritakan nasib malangnya.
claims.quote: Called Dama Branca or Mulher de Branco in Portuguese, the Brazilian Lady in White is said to be the ghost of a young woman who died of childbirth or violent causes. According to legend, she appears as a pale woman in a long white dress or a sleeping gown. Although usually speechless, she will occasionally recount her misfortunes.

claims.statement: Luís da Câmara Cascudo's Dicionário do Folclore Brasileiro proposes that the ghost is related to the violent deaths of young white women murdered by their fathers or husbands in an "honor" killing.
claims.statement_id: Dicionário do Folclore Brasileiro karya Luís da Câmara Cascudo mengusulkan bahwa hantu itu berkaitan dengan kematian keras perempuan muda berkulit putih yang dibunuh ayah atau suaminya dalam pembunuhan "demi kehormatan".
claims.quote: Luís da Câmara Cascudo's Dicionário do Folclore Brasileiro (Brazilian Folklore Dictionary) proposes that the ghost is related to the violent deaths of young white women who were murdered by their fathers or husbands in an "honor" killing.

claims.statement: The most famous white lady of Estonia is said to reside in Haapsalu Castle; according to the legend a canon fell in love with her, she hid in the castle disguised as a choir boy, and was discovered when the Bishop of Ösel-Wiek visited, then immured in the chapel wall for her crime.
claims.statement_id: White lady paling terkenal di Estonia dikatakan bersemayam di Kastil Haapsalu. Menurut legenda, seorang kanon jatuh cinta padanya sehingga ia bersembunyi di kastil dengan menyamar sebagai penyanyi koor laki-laki, tetapi ketahuan ketika Uskup Ösel-Wiek mengunjungi Haapsalu dan kemudian ditembok di dinding kapel karena kejahatannya.
claims.quote: The most famous white lady of Estonia is said to reside in Haapsalu Castle. According to the legend, a canon fell in love with her, so she hid in the castle disguised as a choir boy, but she was discovered when the Bishop of Ösel-Wiek visited Haapsalu and subsequently immured in the wall of the chapel for her crime.

claims.statement: The best-known White Lady of the Czech Republic is the ghost of Perchta of Rožmberk at Rožmberk Castle.
claims.statement_id: White Lady paling terkenal di Republik Ceko adalah hantu Perchta dari Rožmberk di Kastil Rožmberk.
claims.quote: The best-known White Lady of the Czech Republic is the ghost of Perchta of Rožmberk at Rožmberk Castle.

claims.statement: White Ladies are called Witte Wiwer in northern Germany and Weiße Frauen in Standard German, and stories of white lady ghosts are associated with residential castles of the Hohenzollern family.
claims.statement_id: White Lady disebut Witte Wiwer di Jerman utara dan Weiße Frauen dalam bahasa Jerman baku. Kisah hantu white lady dikaitkan dengan kastil-kastil kediaman keluarga Hohenzollern.
claims.quote: White Ladies are called Witte Wiwer in northern Germany and Weiße Frauen in Standard German. Stories of white lady ghosts are associated with residential castles of the Hohenzollern family.

claims.statement: A white lady ghost, said to be a harbinger of death and misfortune, was claimed to be seen in the Berliner Schloss in 1598 shortly before the death of John George of Brandenburg, and again in 1618, 1625, up until 1940.
claims.statement_id: Hantu white lady, yang dikatakan pertanda kematian dan malapetaka, diklaim terlihat di Berliner Schloss pada 1598 tak lama sebelum kematian John George dari Brandenburg, dan lagi pada 1618, 1625, hingga 1940.
claims.quote: A white lady ghost, said to be a harbinger of death and misfortune, was claimed to be seen in the Berliner Schloss in 1598 shortly before the death of John George of Brandenburg, and again in 1618, 1625, up until 1940.

claims.statement: In Hungarian mythology a white lady was the ghost of a girl or young woman who died violently, usually young women who committed suicide, were murdered, or died while imprisoned.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Hungaria, white lady adalah hantu gadis atau perempuan muda yang meninggal secara kekerasan; biasanya perempuan muda yang bunuh diri, dibunuh, atau meninggal dalam tahanan.
claims.quote: In Hungarian mythology, a white lady was the ghost of a girl or young woman that died violently; usually, young women who committed suicide, were murdered, or died while imprisoned.

claims.statement: White Ladies, indigenously known as kaperosa, are popular ghost story topics in the Philippines; the most prominent is the White Lady of Balete Drive in Quezon City, said to be the ghost of a long-haired woman in a white dress who, according to legend, died in a car accident driving along Balete Drive.
claims.statement_id: White Lady, yang secara asli dikenal sebagai kaperosa, adalah topik cerita hantu populer di Filipina. Yang paling menonjol adalah White Lady dari Balete Drive di Quezon City, yang dikatakan hantu perempuan berambut panjang bergaun putih yang menurut legenda tewas dalam kecelakaan mobil saat menyetir di Balete Drive.
claims.quote: White Ladies, indigenously known as kaperosa, are popular ghost story topics in the Philippines. ... The most prominent one is the White Lady of Balete Drive in Quezon City. It is said that it is the ghost of a long-haired woman in a white dress who, according to legend, died in a car accident while driving along Balete Drive.

claims.statement: The White Lady of Balete Drive in Quezon City is the most prominent, but many sources have said a reporter manufactured this legend in the 1950s as a combination of multiple stories from the area.
claims.statement_id: White Lady dari Balete Drive di Quezon City adalah yang paling menonjol, tetapi banyak sumber mengatakan seorang wartawan merekayasa legenda ini pada 1950-an sebagai gabungan beberapa cerita dari kawasan itu.
claims.quote: The most prominent one is the White Lady of Balete Drive in Quezon City. ... Many sources have said a reporter manufactured this legend in the 1950s as a combination of multiple stories from the area.

claims.statement: A popular legend has been associated for centuries with the ruins of Rouelbeau Castle in Meinier, canton of Geneva, centering on a nameless woman, supposedly the first wife of the knight Humbert de Choulex, who led the castle's construction in a swampy area at the beginning of the 14th century.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah legenda populer sejak berabad-abad dikaitkan dengan reruntuhan Kastil Rouelbeau di kotapraja Meinier, kanton Jenewa. Legenda itu berpusat pada perempuan tanpa nama, yang konon istri pertama ksatria Humbert de Choulex, yang memimpin pembangunan kastil di area berawa pada awal abad ke-14.
claims.quote: A popular legend has been associated for centuries with the ruins of Rouelbeau Castle in today's municipality of Meinier in the canton of Geneva. It centers around a woman without a name, supposedly the first wife of the knight Humbert de Choulex, under whose leadership the castle was constructed in a swampy area at the beginning of the 14th century.

claims.statement: Vrouwen in wit, or "Witte Wieven" in local dialects, are mythical creatures of Low Saxon origin best known in the eastern and northern Netherlands; sometimes called witte joffers ("white maidens"), they can have a benevolent and malevolent nature.
claims.statement_id: Vrouwen in wit (jamak dari vrouw in wit), atau "Witte Wieven" dalam dialek setempat, adalah makhluk mitos berasal Saxon Rendah yang paling dikenal di Belanda timur dan utara. Kadang disebut witte joffers ("gadis putih"), mereka dapat bersifat baik dan jahat.
claims.quote: Vrouwen in wit (plural of vrouw in wit), or "Witte Wieven" as these women are called in local dialects, are mythical creatures of Low Saxon origin and so most known in the eastern and northern parts of the Netherlands. Sometimes referred to as witte joffers ("white maidens"), they can have a benevolent and malevolent nature.

claims.statement: At Charles Fort (Ireland) there is the story of a white lady, the ghost of a young woman who died on her wedding night.
claims.statement_id: Di Charles Fort (Irlandia) ada kisah white lady, hantu perempuan muda yang meninggal pada malam pernikahannya.
claims.quote: In Charles Fort (Ireland), there is the story of a white lady, the ghost of a young woman that died on her wedding night.

claims.statement: WHITE LADY, a lady dressed in white fabled in popular medieval legend to appear by day as well as at night in a house before the death of some member of the family, was regarded as the ghost of some deceased ancestress.
claims.statement_id: WHITE LADY: seorang perempuan berbaju putih yang dikisahkan dalam legenda populer abad pertengahan muncul siang maupun malam di sebuah rumah sebelum kematian salah satu anggota keluarga; dianggap hantu leluhur perempuan yang telah meninggal.
claims.quote: WHITE LADY, a lady dressed in white fabled in popular mediæval legend to appear by day as well as at night in a house before the death of some member of the family; was regarded as the ghost of some deceased ancestress.

claims.statement: In Mesoamerica generally, the bat is often associated with night, death, and sacrifice.
claims.statement_id: Di Mesoamerika secara umum kelelawar diasosiasikan dengan malam, kematian, dan pengorbanan.
claims.quote: In Mesoamerica generally, the bat is often associated with night, death, and sacrifice.

claims.statement: The twins had to spend the night in the House of Bats, where they squeezed themselves into their own blowguns in order to defend themselves from the circling bats.
claims.statement_id: Pahlawan kembar harus bermalam di House of Bats untuk melindungi diri dari kelelawar yang berputar.
claims.quote: The twins had to spend the night in the House of Bats, where they squeezed themselves into their own blowguns in order to defend themselves from the circling bats.

claims.statement: Hunahpu stuck his head out of his blowgun to see if the sun had risen and Camazotz immediately snatched off his head and carried it to the ballcourt to be hung up as the ball to be used by the gods in their next ballgame.
claims.statement_id: Camazotz memenggal kepala Hunahpu dan membawanya ke lapangan bola dewa.
claims.quote: Hunahpu stuck his head out of his blowgun to see if the sun had risen and Camazotz immediately snatched off his head and carried it to the ballcourt to be hung up as the ball to be used by the gods in their next ballgame.

claims.statement: However, the Classic bat spirit is rarely, if ever, part of a narrative context, nor does it appear to play the role assigned to it by the Popol Vuh.
claims.statement_id: Roh kelelawar era Klasik jarang berada dalam konteks narasi Popol Vuh.
claims.quote: However, the Classic bat spirit is rarely, if ever, part of a narrative context, nor does it appear to play the role assigned to it by the Popol Vuh.

claims.statement: In the Late Post-Classic Maya mythology of the Popol Vuh, Camazotz (alternate spellings Cama-Zotz, Sotz, Zotz) is a bat spirit at the service of the lords of the underworld.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Maya Pasca-Klasik Akhir dalam Popol Vuh, Camazotz (ejaan lain Cama-Zotz, Sotz, Zotz) adalah roh kelelawar yang melayani para penguasa dunia bawah.
claims.quote: In the Late Post-Classic Maya mythology of the Popol Vuh, Camazotz ... (alternate spellings Cama-Zotz, Sotz, Zotz) is a bat spirit at the service of the lords of the underworld.

claims.statement: Camazotz is formed from the Kʼicheʼ words kame, meaning 'death', and sotz', meaning 'bat'.
claims.statement_id: Camazotz dibentuk dari kata Kʼicheʼ kame yang berarti 'kematian' dan sotz' yang berarti 'kelelawar'.
claims.quote: Camazotz is formed from the Kʼicheʼ words kame, meaning "death", and sotz', meaning "bat".

claims.statement: In the Popol Vuh, Camazotz are the bat-like spirits encountered by the Maya Hero Twins Hunahpu and Xbalanque during their trials in the underworld of Xibalba.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Popol Vuh, Camazotz adalah roh mirip kelelawar yang ditemui Kembar Pahlawan Maya, Hunahpu dan Xbalanque, selama ujian mereka di dunia bawah Xibalba.
claims.quote: In the Popol Vuh, Camazotz are the bat-like spirits encountered by the Maya Hero Twins Hunahpu and Xbalanque during their trials in the underworld of Xibalba.

claims.statement: In Classic Maya iconography, the (leaf-nosed) bat, exhaling unhealthy vapours, is often depicted as a person's nahual or way-spirit bringing disease over an enemy.
claims.statement_id: Dalam ikonografi Maya Klasik, kelelawar (berhidung daun) yang mengembuskan uap tak sehat sering digambarkan sebagai nahual atau roh pendamping seseorang yang membawa penyakit kepada musuh.
claims.quote: In Classic Maya iconography, the (leaf-nosed) bat, exhaling unhealthy vapours, is often depicted as a person's nahual or way-spirit bringing disease over an enemy.

claims.statement: Brady and Coltman dispute the earlier scholarly view that interpreted Maya bat imagery as representations of Camazotz; Maya bat imagery appears in different forms and contexts, so scholars should distinguish among them.
claims.statement_id: Brady dan Coltman membantah pandangan ilmiah terdahulu yang menafsirkan citra kelelawar Maya sebagai penggambaran Camazotz; citra kelelawar Maya muncul dalam beragam bentuk dan konteks sehingga para ahli perlu membedakannya.
claims.quote: Brady and Coltman dispute the earlier scholarly view that interpreted Maya bat imagery as representations of Camazotz. Maya bat imagery appears in different forms and contexts, so scholars should distinguish among those representations.

claims.statement: The name Camazotz translates to either 'death bat' or 'snatch bat'; this deity appears in the Popol Vuh and is still a very prominent figure in the continuing Maya religion.
claims.statement_id: Nama Camazotz diterjemahkan sebagai 'kelelawar maut' atau 'kelelawar perenggut'. Dewa ini muncul dalam Popol Vuh dan masih menjadi tokoh yang sangat menonjol dalam agama Maya yang berlanjut.
claims.quote: The name Camazotz translates to either ‘death bat’ or ‘snatch bat’. This deity appears in the Popol Vuh and is still a very prominent figure in the continuing Maya religion.

claims.statement: Camazotz is described as an anthropomorphized leaf-nosed bat, and the god is also commonly depicted holding a sacrificial knife in one hand and a human heart or sacrificial victim in the other.
claims.statement_id: Camazotz digambarkan sebagai kelelawar berhidung daun yang berwujud manusia; sang dewa juga lazim digambarkan memegang pisau korban di satu tangan dan jantung manusia atau korban di tangan lain.
claims.quote: Camazotz is described as an anthropomorphized leaf-nosed bat. ... The god is also commonly depicted holding a sacrificial knife in one hand and a human heart or sacrificial victim in the other.

claims.statement: The Zapotecs believed bats represented night, death, and sacrifice, likely because the bats inhabited the caves around the sacred cenotes, which the Mesoamericans believed were portals to the underworld.
claims.statement_id: Bangsa Zapotec percaya kelelawar melambangkan malam, kematian, dan pengorbanan, kemungkinan karena kelelawar menghuni gua-gua di sekitar cenote suci yang dipercaya orang Mesoamerika sebagai gerbang ke dunia bawah.
claims.quote: The Zapotecs believed bats represented night, death, and sacrifice. This was likely due to the fact that the bats would inhabit the caves around the sacred cenotes, which the Mesoamericans believed were portals to the underworld.

claims.statement: Later in the Popol Vuh, a messenger from the underworld in the form of a humanoid bat (believed to be Camazotz) appears to broker a deal between humanity and Lord Tohil, the patron god of the K’iche’.
claims.statement_id: Kemudian dalam Popol Vuh, seorang utusan dari dunia bawah berwujud kelelawar mirip manusia (diyakini Camazotz) muncul untuk menengahi kesepakatan antara umat manusia dan Tuan Tohil, dewa pelindung bangsa K’iche’.
claims.quote: Later in the Popol Vuh, a messenger from the underworld in the form of a humanoid bat (believed to be Camazotz) appears to broker a deal between humanity and Lord Tohil, the patron god of the K’iche’.

claims.statement: At the end of the nineteenth century, Eduard Seler identified the bats on a ceramic vessel excavated by Erwin Dieseldorff at Chama, Guatemala, as the camazotz, or death bat, of the K’iche’ Maya myth, the Popol Vuh; the attribution was never critically reviewed.
claims.statement_id: Pada akhir abad ke-19, Eduard Seler mengidentifikasi kelelawar pada bejana keramik yang digali Erwin Dieseldorff di situs Chama, Guatemala, sebagai camazotz atau kelelawar maut dari mitos Maya K’iche’, Popol Vuh; atribusi itu tidak pernah ditinjau secara kritis.
claims.quote: At the end of the nineteenth century, Eduard Seler identified the bats depicted on a ceramic vessel excavated by Erwin Dieseldorff at the site of Chama, Guatemala, as the camazotz, or death bat, from the K’iche’ Maya myth, the Popol Vuh. The attribution was never critically reviewed.

claims.statement: The authors located no ancient depictions of the Hero Twins in the chamber of the camazotz, which calls into question the salience of this scene for the ancient Maya.
claims.statement_id: Para penulis tidak menemukan penggambaran kuno Kembar Pahlawan di ruang camazotz, yang mempertanyakan arti penting adegan ini bagi bangsa Maya kuno.
claims.quote: We have located no ancient depictions of the Hero Twins in the chamber of the camazotz, which calls into question the salience of this scene for the ancient Maya.

claims.statement: The authors argue that the identification with the camazotz should be dropped altogether and that the associations proposed by Seler need to be rethought.
claims.statement_id: Para penulis berpendapat bahwa identifikasi dengan camazotz sebaiknya ditinggalkan sama sekali dan bahwa asosiasi yang diusulkan Seler perlu dipikirkan ulang.
claims.quote: We argue that the identification with the camazotz should be dropped altogether and that the associations proposed by Seler need to be rethought.

claims.statement: The last and largest category of bat roles is wahy beings, which most epigraphers now think were bestial forms of personified diseases.
claims.statement_id: Kategori peran terakhir dan terbesar bagi kelelawar adalah makhluk wahy, yang menurut sebagian besar epigraf kini adalah wujud hewani dari penyakit yang dipersonifikasikan.
claims.quote: The last and largest category is wahy beings, which most epigraphers now think were bestial forms of personified diseases.

claims.statement: At 7:15 p.m. on September 12, 1952, in Flatwoods, brothers Edward and Fred May, accompanied by their friend Tommy Hyer, reported seeing a bright object cross the sky before landing on the property of farmer G. Bailey Fisher.
claims.statement_id: Pada pukul 19.15 tanggal 12 September 1952 di Flatwoods, bersaudara Edward dan Fred May bersama teman mereka Tommy Hyer melaporkan melihat benda terang melintasi langit sebelum mendarat di tanah milik petani G. Bailey Fisher.
claims.quote: At 7:15 p.m. on September 12, 1952, in Flatwoods, brothers Edward and Fred May, accompanied by their friend Tommy Hyer, reported seeing a bright object cross the sky before landing on the property of farmer G. Bailey Fisher.

claims.statement: Lemon said he aimed a flashlight in that direction and momentarily saw a tall 'man-like figure with a round, red face surrounded by a pointed, hood-like shape'.
claims.statement_id: Sorotan lampu memperlihatkan sosok tinggi berwajah merah bulat berkerudung lancip.
claims.quote: Lemon said he aimed a flashlight in that direction and momentarily saw a tall "man-like figure with a round, red face surrounded by a pointed, hood-like shape".

claims.statement: The witnesses further claimed that the figure possessed 'small, claw-like hands', clothing-like folds, and 'a head that resembled the ace of spades'.
claims.statement_id: Saksi menyatakan sosok itu memiliki tangan bercakar kecil dan kepala mirip kartu sekop.
claims.quote: The witnesses further claimed that the figure possessed "small, claw-like hands", clothing-like folds, and "a head that resembled the ace of spades".

claims.statement: In 2000, paranormal investigator Joe Nickell suggested that the light was a meteor, while the creature may have been a barn owl perched in a tree whose shadows made it appear as a large humanoid figure.
claims.statement_id: Pada 2000 Joe Nickell menduga cahaya itu adalah meteor dan makhluk tersebut adalah burung hantu.
claims.quote: In 2000, paranormal investigator Joe Nickell suggested that the light was a meteor, while the creature may have been a barn owl perched in a tree whose shadows made it appear as a large humanoid figure.

claims.statement: The Flatwoods monster, also known as the Braxton County monster, Braxie, or the Phantom of Flatwoods, is an alleged humanoid reportedly sighted in Flatwoods, West Virginia, on September 12, 1952.
claims.statement_id: Monster Flatwoods, juga dikenal sebagai monster Braxton County, Braxie, atau Hantu Flatwoods, adalah makhluk mirip manusia yang diduga dan dilaporkan terlihat di Flatwoods, West Virginia, pada 12 September 1952.
claims.quote: The Flatwoods monster, also known as the Braxton County monster, Braxie, or the Phantom of Flatwoods, is an alleged humanoid reportedly sighted in Flatwoods, West Virginia, on September 12, 1952.

claims.statement: The alleged humanoid was said to have stood about 10 feet (3 m) tall; a large pointed 'hood-like shape' surrounded a round, blood-red face, and eyelike features emitted a greenish-orange light, while the body was purportedly either dark black or green.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk yang diduga mirip manusia itu dikatakan setinggi sekitar 10 kaki (3 m); bentuk seperti tudung runcing besar mengelilingi wajah bulat merah darah, dan bagian mirip mata memancarkan cahaya hijau-oranye, sedangkan tubuhnya konon hitam pekat atau hijau.
claims.quote: The alleged humanoid was said to have stood at a height of about 10 feet (3 m). A large pointed "hood-like shape" surrounded a round, blood-red face, and eyelike features emitted a greenish-orange light. The body was purportedly either dark black or green.

claims.statement: According to the story, when the alleged entity made a hissing sound and 'glided toward the group', Lemon screamed and dropped his flashlight, causing all the witnesses to run away.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kisahnya, ketika makhluk itu mendesis dan 'meluncur ke arah kelompok', Lemon menjerit dan menjatuhkan senternya sehingga semua saksi lari.
claims.quote: According to the story, when the alleged entity made a hissing sound and "glided toward the group", Lemon screamed and dropped his flashlight, causing all the witnesses to run away.

claims.statement: The group said they had smelled a 'pungent mist' and some later reported nausea; soon after, Mrs. May noticed an oily film on the boys' faces, their throats became swollen, and a doctor was called to examine them.
claims.statement_id: Kelompok itu mengaku mencium 'kabut menyengat' dan sebagian kemudian melaporkan mual; tak lama kemudian Nyonya May melihat lapisan berminyak di wajah anak-anak itu, tenggorokan mereka membengkak, dan dokter dipanggil memeriksa mereka.
claims.quote: The group said they had smelled a "pungent mist", and some later reported nausea. A short time thereafter, Mrs. May noticed an oily film on the boys' faces. Their throats became swollen, and a doctor was called to examine them.

claims.statement: After investigating the case in 2000, Joe Nickell of the Committee for Skeptical Inquiry concluded that the bright light was most likely a meteor, the pulsating red light likely an aircraft navigation or hazard beacon, and various aspects of the being resembled the anatomical features of an owl.
claims.statement_id: Setelah menyelidiki kasus ini pada 2000, Joe Nickell dari Committee for Skeptical Inquiry menyimpulkan bahwa cahaya terang di langit kemungkinan besar meteor, cahaya merah berdenyut kemungkinan lampu navigasi atau lampu peringatan pesawat, dan berbagai ciri makhluk itu menyerupai ciri anatomi burung hantu.
claims.quote: After investigating the case in 2000, Joe Nickell of the Committee for Skeptical Inquiry concluded that the bright light in the sky reported by the witnesses on September 12 was most likely a meteor, that the pulsating red light was likely an aircraft navigation or hazard beacon, and that various aspects of the being described by witnesses resembled the anatomical features of an owl.

claims.statement: According to former news editor Holt Byrne, newspaper stories were carried throughout the country, radio broadcasts were carried on large networks, and hundreds of phone calls were received from all parts of the country.
claims.statement_id: Menurut mantan editor berita Holt Byrne, berita surat kabar tersebar ke seluruh negeri, siaran radio dibawakan jaringan besar, dan ratusan telepon diterima dari berbagai penjuru negeri.
claims.quote: According to former news editor Holt Byrne, "newspaper stories were carried throughout the country, radio broadcasts were carried on large networks, and hundreds of phone calls were received from all parts of the country".

claims.statement: In television, the second episode of the 2019 History Channel series Project Blue Book, titled 'The Flatwoods Monster', is based on the Flatwoods incident.
claims.statement_id: Dalam televisi, episode kedua serial History Channel tahun 2019 Project Blue Book, berjudul 'The Flatwoods Monster', didasarkan pada kejadian Flatwoods.
claims.quote: In television, the second episode of the 2019 History Channel series Project Blue Book, titled "The Flatwoods Monster", is based on the Flatwoods incident.

claims.statement: The legend of the Braxton County or Flatwoods Monster arose near dusk on September 12, 1952, when local youths were startled from a game of football by a fireball streaking across the sky that fell to earth just beyond a hillside at Flatwoods.
claims.statement_id: Legenda Monster Braxton County atau Flatwoods muncul menjelang senja pada 12 September 1952, ketika sekelompok pemuda setempat terkejut dari permainan sepak bola oleh bola api yang melesat di langit dan jatuh tepat di balik sebuah lereng di Flatwoods.
claims.quote: The legend of the Braxton County or Flatwoods Monster arose near dusk on September 12, 1952, when a group of local youths were startled from a game of football by a fireball streaking across the sky. The fireball fell to earth just beyond a hillside at Flatwoods.

claims.statement: Turning their own flashlight in that direction, they saw a large man-like creature nearly 12 feet tall and about four feet wide, which floated toward them without making a sound.
claims.statement_id: Mengarahkan senter mereka ke sana, mereka melihat makhluk besar mirip manusia setinggi hampir 12 kaki dan selebar sekitar empat kaki; tanpa suara, makhluk itu melayang ke arah mereka.
claims.quote: Turning their own flashlight in that direction, they saw a large man-like creature nearly 12 feet tall and about four feet wide. Making no sound, it floated toward them.

claims.statement: The creature had a red face and bright green clothing hanging in folds below the waist; its head was shaped like the ace of spades and an almost sickening metallic odor emanated from its body. The witnesses quickly fled the scene.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk itu berwajah merah dan berpakaian hijau terang yang menggantung berlipat di bawah pinggang; kepalanya berbentuk kartu sekop, dan dari tubuhnya tercium bau logam yang hampir memualkan. Para saksi segera melarikan diri.
claims.quote: The creature had a red face and bright green clothing, which hung in folds below the waist. Its head was shaped like the ace of spades and there was an almost sickening metallic odor emanating from its body. The witnesses quickly fled the scene.

claims.statement: The witnesses quickly fled the scene; a later investigation found only a lingering odor, two large skid marks, and trampled grass.
claims.statement_id: Para saksi segera melarikan diri. Penyelidikan kemudian hanya menemukan bau yang tersisa, dua bekas seretan besar, dan rumput yang terinjak.
claims.quote: The witnesses quickly fled the scene. A later investigation found only a lingering odor, two large skid marks, and trampled grass.

claims.statement: Although the Monster has never reappeared, Flatwoods celebrated its 50th anniversary with a community festival in 2002, and an annual convention is now held in Flatwoods.
claims.statement_id: Meski sang monster tidak pernah muncul lagi, Flatwoods merayakan ulang tahun ke-50 dengan festival komunitas pada 2002, dan kini konvensi tahunan digelar di Flatwoods.
claims.quote: Although the Monster has never reappeared, Flatwoods celebrated its 50th anniversary with a community festival in 2002. An annual convention is now held in Flatwoods.

claims.statement: Over the years the Flatwoods Monster has developed a sizable following, taking its place alongside Mothman, Batboy, Grafton Monster, and other West Virginia legends of the bizarre; a museum dedicated to the subject is now located on the Main Street of Sutton.
claims.statement_id: Seiring waktu Monster Flatwoods memiliki pengikut yang cukup besar dan menempati tempat di samping Mothman, Batboy, Grafton Monster, dan legenda aneh West Virginia lainnya; sebuah museum yang didedikasikan untuknya kini berada di Main Street, Sutton.
claims.quote: Over the years the Flatwoods Monster has developed a sizable following, taking its place alongside Mothman, Batboy, Grafton Monster, and other West Virginia legends of the bizarre. A museum dedicated to the subject is now located on the Main Street of Sutton.

claims.statement: According to Bartlett, the figure was perched atop a broken stone wall.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Bartlett sosok itu bertengger di atas dinding batu yang rusak.
claims.quote: According to Bartlett, the figure was perched atop a broken stone wall.

claims.statement: The three teenagers each produced sketches of what they claimed to have seen.
claims.statement_id: Tiga remaja masing-masing menggambar sketsa mengenai apa yang mereka lihat.
claims.quote: The three teenagers each produced sketches of what they claimed to have seen.

claims.statement: Skeptic Joe Nickell suggested that a snowy owl could account for the reported sightings.
claims.statement_id: Penyelidik Joe Nickell menduga burung hantu salju dapat menjelaskan penampakan itu.
claims.quote: Skeptic Joe Nickell suggested that a snowy owl could account for the reported sightings.

claims.statement: Police said that the descriptions provided by the teenagers were 'probably nothing more than a school vacation hoax'.
claims.statement_id: Polisi menyatakan gambaran para remaja itu kemungkinan hanya lelucon liburan sekolah.
claims.quote: Police said that the descriptions provided by the teenagers were "probably nothing more than a school vacation hoax".

claims.statement: The Dover Demon is a cryptid reportedly sighted on April 21–22, 1977, in Dover, Massachusetts, a town approximately 15 miles (24 km) southwest of Boston.
claims.statement_id: Dover Demon adalah kriptid yang dilaporkan terlihat pada 21–22 April 1977 di Dover, Massachusetts, kota sekitar 15 mil (24 km) di barat daya Boston.
claims.quote: The Dover Demon is a cryptid reportedly sighted on April 21–22, 1977, in Dover, Massachusetts, a town approximately 15 miles (24 km) southwest of Boston.

claims.statement: While driving along Farm Street in Dover on April 21, 1977, seventeen-year-old William 'Bill' Bartlett reported seeing an unknown being about 4 feet (1.2 m) tall, which he claimed had glowing orange eyes, no visible nose or mouth, and a watermelon-shaped head.
claims.statement_id: Saat berkendara di Farm Street, Dover, pada 21 April 1977, William 'Bill' Bartlett (17) melaporkan melihat makhluk tak dikenal setinggi sekitar 4 kaki (1,2 m) yang menurutnya bermata oranye menyala, tanpa hidung atau mulut yang terlihat, dan berkepala berbentuk semangka.
claims.quote: While driving along Farm Street in Dover, Massachusetts on April 21, 1977, seventeen-year-old William "Bill" Bartlett reported seeing an unknown being approximately 4 feet (1.2 m) tall, which he claimed possessed glowing orange eyes, lacked a visible nose or mouth, and had a watermelon-shaped head.

claims.statement: That same evening, 15-year-old John Baxter reported seeing something similar on Miller Hill Road; the following night, another 15-year-old, Abby Brabham, claimed to have encountered the being on Springdale Avenue.
claims.statement_id: Pada malam yang sama, John Baxter (15) melaporkan melihat sesuatu yang serupa di Miller Hill Road; malam berikutnya Abby Brabham (15) mengaku bertemu makhluk itu di Springdale Avenue.
claims.quote: That same evening, 15-year-old John Baxter reported seeing something similar on Miller Hill Road. The following night, another 15-year-old, Abby Brabham, claimed to have encountered the being on Springdale Avenue.

claims.statement: A local news report noted that the locations of the alleged sightings, plotted on a map, formed a straight line extending more than 2 miles (3.2 km); the sightings did not become public until the first half of May.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah laporan berita lokal mencatat bahwa lokasi dugaan penampakan, bila diplot di peta, membentuk garis lurus sepanjang lebih dari 2 mil (3,2 km); penampakan itu baru diketahui publik pada paruh pertama Mei.
claims.quote: A local news report noted that the locations of the alleged sightings, when plotted on a map, formed a straight line extending for more than 2 miles (3.2 km). The sightings did not become public until the first half of May.

claims.statement: Although none of the witnesses reported seeing a UFO, the sightings were investigated by the Mutual UFO Network and other associated organizations.
claims.statement_id: Meski tak satu pun saksi melaporkan melihat UFO, penampakan itu diselidiki oleh Mutual UFO Network dan organisasi terkait lainnya.
claims.quote: Although none of the witnesses reported seeing a UFO, the sightings were investigated by the Mutual UFO Network and other associated organizations.

claims.statement: Some explanations have proposed that what the witnesses may have actually seen was a foal or moose calf.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian penjelasan mengusulkan bahwa yang sebenarnya dilihat para saksi mungkin anak kuda atau anak moose.
claims.quote: Some explanations have proposed that what the witnesses may have actually seen was a foal or moose calf.

claims.statement: Skeptic Joe Nickell suggested that a snowy owl could account for the reported sightings, speculating that the owl's plumage may have reflected the yellow headlights of older automobiles, producing the peach-colored appearance Bartlett described.
claims.statement_id: Skeptis Joe Nickell menyarankan bahwa burung hantu salju dapat menjelaskan penampakan itu; ia menduga bulunya memantulkan lampu depan kuning mobil lama sehingga tampak berwarna persik seperti yang digambarkan Bartlett.
claims.quote: Skeptic Joe Nickell suggested that a snowy owl could account for the reported sightings. He speculated that the owl's plumage may have reflected the yellow headlights of older automobiles, producing the peach-colored appearance described by Bartlett.

claims.statement: Late on the nights of April 21 and 22, 1977, four students from Dover-Sherborn High School (enrollment just under 500) shared an incredible experience in three apparently unconnected incidents; their ages ranged from 15 to 18.
claims.statement_id: Pada larut malam 21 dan 22 April 1977, empat siswa Dover-Sherborn High School (jumlah siswa kurang dari 500) mengalami pengalaman luar biasa dalam tiga kejadian yang tampaknya tak berhubungan; usia mereka 15 sampai 18 tahun.
claims.quote: Late on the nights of April 21st and 22nd, 1977, four students from Dover-Sherborn High School (total enrollment just under 500) all shared an incredible experience, but in three (apparently unconnected) incidents. Their ages ranged from 15 to 18.

claims.statement: According to this account, Bill Bartlett, 17, was driving with some friends and suddenly saw, though nobody else in the car did, a bizarre creature at the roadside: short but with a huge head, white or peach in color, big eyes and no other facial features, and a very thin neck and limbs.
claims.statement_id: Menurut tulisan ini, Bill Bartlett (17) berkendara bersama beberapa teman dan tiba-tiba melihat, tanpa terlihat oleh orang lain di mobil, makhluk aneh di tepi jalan: pendek tetapi berkepala besar, berwarna putih atau persik, bermata besar tanpa ciri wajah lain, dengan leher dan anggota badan sangat kurus.
claims.quote: The first came when Bill Bartlett, 17, was rolling in his sweet Volkswagen with some friends. Suddenly he saw — though nobody else in the car did — a bizarre creature on the side of the road: short but with a huge head, white or peach in color, big eyes and no other facial features, and very thin neck and limbs.

claims.statement: Two hours later, John Baxter (15) was walking home when he met a silhouette walking toward him; he called out, the creature ran away across a ditch, and John then got a good look: a huge double-lobed head like a peanut, and skinny arms and legs with long fingers.
claims.statement_id: Dua jam kemudian, John Baxter (15) yang berjalan pulang bertemu siluet yang berjalan ke arahnya; ia berseru, makhluk itu lari melintasi parit, dan John melihatnya dengan jelas: kepala besar berlobus dua seperti kacang, serta lengan dan kaki kurus berjari panjang.
claims.quote: Two hours later, John Baxter (15) was walking home when he encountered a silhouette walking toward him. He called out, and the creature ran away across a ditch, and John then caught his first good look at it. It had a huge double-lobed head like a peanut, and skinny arms and legs with long fingers

claims.statement: Bartlett (today a professional artist) and Baxter both drew sketches of what they saw, and the sketches were strikingly similar: a small thin creature with a huge double-lobed head, tiny body, and shockingly skinny neck and limbs, with no facial features except glowing eyes reflecting the headlights.
claims.statement_id: Bartlett (kini seniman profesional) dan Baxter sama-sama menggambar sketsa apa yang mereka lihat, dan sketsa itu sangat mirip: makhluk kecil kurus berkepala besar berlobus dua, bertubuh mungil, berleher dan anggota badan sangat kurus, tanpa ciri wajah selain mata menyala yang memantulkan lampu.
claims.quote: Bartlett (today a professional artist) and Baxter both drew sketches of what they saw, and they were strikingly similar. A small thin creature with a huge double-lobed head, tiny body, and shockingly skinny neck and limbs — and no features on its face except glowing eyes, reflecting the headlights.

claims.statement: There is no physical evidence that anything happened at all, just the testimony of these four young people.
claims.statement_id: Tidak ada bukti fisik bahwa sesuatu terjadi sama sekali, hanya kesaksian keempat anak muda itu.
claims.quote: We have no physical evidence that anything happened at all; just the testimony of these four young people.

claims.statement: Despite police searches and the participation of four researchers from five different UFO and Fortean organizations, including [cryptozoologist] Loren Coleman, no evidence was ever found.
claims.statement_id: Meski ada pencarian polisi dan keterlibatan empat peneliti dari lima organisasi UFO dan Fortean berbeda, termasuk [kriptozoolog] Loren Coleman, tidak pernah ditemukan bukti.
claims.quote: Despite police searches and the participation of four researchers from five different UFO and Fortean organizations, including [cryptozoologist] Loren Coleman, no evidence was ever found.

claims.statement: Dunning argues that if it happened to four people in town in just 24 hours, it must be a very compelling illusion, yet the illusion never fooled anyone before or since.
claims.statement_id: Dunning berpendapat bahwa jika hal itu terjadi pada empat orang dalam 24 jam, ilusinya pasti sangat meyakinkan, namun ilusi itu tidak pernah menipu siapa pun sebelum maupun sesudahnya.
claims.quote: But if it happened to four people in town in just 24 hours, it must be a very compelling illusion. Yet the illusion never fooled anyone, ever, before or since.

claims.statement: In 2009, the Dover Demon was featured in an episode of the American horror television series Lost Tapes, which aired on Animal Planet.

claims.quote: Skinwalkers are out to do others harm, and are regarded as the most dangerous type of witches. Witches are not seen as supernatural beings; rather, they harness the power of evil.

claims.statement: In Navajo culture a skinwalker is a form of witch that can possess an animal or change its shape to look like an animal; the Navajo call this witch yee naaldlooshii, translated 'with it, he goes on all fours'.

claims.statement: Skinwalkers usually appear as bears, cougars, coyotes, dogs, foxes, or wolves but can take any animal's shape; they choose a shape for the abilities they need, such as claws, stealth, speed, strength, and teeth, and may transform into another animal to elude pursuit.

claims.quote: Skinwalkers usually appear as bears, cougars, coyotes, dogs, foxes, or wolves, but can take any animal’s shape. claims.quote: Because they cause harm and mischief, skinwalkers are often blamed for troubles. Fear of them led to the Navajo Witch Purge of 1878, in which forty suspected witches were killed.
